https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary_zh: 马金德-达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定暂停联邦层面的招聘，并称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境，尤其是求职青年的处境毫不在意。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs. The organisation said the decision contradicted the All Progressives Congress (APC)’s promises on job creation and raised concerns about the government’s commitment to addressing unemployment. In a press statement dated November 17, 2026, and signed by its Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Nnanna Ihediwa, the campaign organisation described the recruitment freeze as an indication of what it called the shortcomings of the Tinubu administration’s economic policies. It also expressed concern that the embargo could precede possible mass retrenchment in the public service under the guise of fiscal discipline, particularly if Tinubu secured re-election in 2027. The organisation cited World Bank estimates that approximately 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, arguing that restricting federal recruitment would further limit employment opportunities for young people. The MDPCO also rejected the Presidency’s explanation that the embargo was intended to consolidate public service reforms and enable the government to properly determine personnel requirements for the 2027 budget. It argued that the government should instead focus on expanding the economy, harnessing the country’s human and natural resources, and creating employment opportunities. The campaign organisation further faulted comments attributed to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, describing Nigerians complaining about hunger and hardship as lazy. According to the statement, the 2027 general election would provide Nigerians an opportunity to assess the economic direction of the country and decide on the leadership they want. It contrasted the Federal Government’s recruitment policy with what it described as employment-generating initiatives under Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde. The organisation said Makinde’s administration had expanded economic opportunities in Oyo State through public and private sector initiatives, particularly in agriculture, infrastructure, education, transportation and other critical sectors. It specifically highlighted the establishment of the Oyo State Agribusiness Development Agency (OYSADA), which it said had transformed traditional farm settlements into modern agro-industrial hubs. Other initiatives cited included investments in power generation, aviation, road infrastructure, water resources, revenue reforms and improvements in the public workforce. The campaign organisation said Makinde’s proposed RESET Nigeria Agenda was anchored on expanding economic opportunities, reducing waste without weakening public institutions, maintaining fiscal discipline without restricting employment, and pursuing economic stability without undermining citizens’ livelihoods. It said the agenda offered an alternative economic direction ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The organisation urged Nigerians to consider Makinde, who is the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election, arguing that his administration’s development approach in Oyo State could be replicated at the national level. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队就联邦招聘禁令指责蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body_zh:
第一层 马金德－达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定禁止联邦政府机构招聘，称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境缺乏体谅，尤其是对正在寻找工作的年轻人。该组织表示，这项决定与进步大会党（APC）关于创造就业岗位的承诺相悖，并引发人们对政府解决失业问题承诺的担忧。

在一份日期为2026年11月17日、由其战略传播主任理查德·恩南纳·伊赫迪瓦签署的新闻声明中，该竞选组织称冻结招聘凸显了其所称的蒂努布政府经济政策的缺陷。它还担忧，这项禁令可能先于公共部门可能发生的大规模裁员，而裁员将以财政纪律为名，尤其是在蒂努布于2027年成功连任的情况下。该组织援引世界银行的估算称，每年约有350万名尼日利亚人进入劳动力市场，并认为限制联邦招聘将进一步减少年轻人的就业机会。

MDPCO还驳斥了总统府关于实施招聘禁令旨在巩固公共服务改革、使政府能够妥善确定2027年预算人员需求的解释。它认为，政府转而应当专注于扩大经济，开发国家的人力和自然资源，并创造就业机会。

该竞选组织还批评了据称出自APC总统竞选委员会主任、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里参议员的言论，称他把抱怨饥饿和困苦的尼日利亚人描述为懒惰。

声明表示，2027年大选将为尼日利亚人提供一次机会，以评估国家经济的发展方向，并决定他们希望由谁领导。该组织将联邦政府的招聘政策与其所称的奥约州州长塞伊·马金德推行的就业创造举措进行了对比。该组织说，马金德政府通过公共和私营部门的举措扩大了奥约州的经济机会，尤其是在农业、基础设施、教育、交通运输及其他关键领域。

该组织特别提到成立奥约州农业综合发展局（OYSADA），并称该机构已把传统农庄转变为现代农工业中心。列举的其他举措包括对发电、航空、道路基础设施、水资源、税收改革和公共 workforce 改善的投资。

该竞选组织表示，马金德提出的“重置尼日利亚议程”以扩大经济机会、在不削弱公共机构的情况下减少浪费、在不限制就业的情况下维持财政纪律，以及在不损害公民生计的情况下追求经济稳定为基础。它称，在2027年总统选举前夕，该议程提供了一条替代性的经济发展道路。

该组织敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选中考虑马金德。他是联盟人民运动（APM）的总统候选人。该组织认为，他在奥约州采用的发展方式可以在全国范围内复制。

此处表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

He questioned how the current Finance Minister could have secured Ghana's exit from the IMF programme if his management of the economy was not better than that of Mr Ofori-Atta.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ato-forson-h.summary_zh: 教育部长兼塔马利南方选区议员哈鲁纳·伊德里苏表示，财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松管理加纳经济的表现优于其前任肯·奥福里-阿塔。“议长先生，当时担任财政部长的肯·奥福里-阿塔与如今担任财政部长的卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士之间的辩论仍在继续。他质疑，如果现任财政部长的经济管理表现不比奥福里-阿塔先生更好，他怎么可能推动加纳退出国际货币基金组织项目。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ato-forson-h.body: Education Minister and Tamale South MP, Haruna Iddrisu, says Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has performed better in managing Ghana's economy than his predecessor, Ken Ofori-Atta. He argued that improvements in key economic indicators, Ghana's exit from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) programme and upgrades in the country's credit ratings demonstrate the difference in economic management under the two ministers. Contributing to the debate on the 2027 Budget Statement in Parliament on Wednesday, November 18, Mr Iddrisu said the comparison between the two finance ministers should be settled in favour of Dr Ato Forson. “Mr. Speaker, the debate is ongoing there between former Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta at the time versus Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson, Finance Minister today. Mr. Speaker, let it be settled. And indeed, it is a settled debate that Dr Ato Forson wins the debate when it comes to any measure or any judgment of the management of the economy,” he said. He questioned how the current Finance Minister could have secured Ghana's exit from the IMF programme if his management of the economy was not better than that of Mr Ofori-Atta. Mr Iddrisu also cited credit rating assessments by Standard & Poor's, Fitch and Moody's, saying the agencies had upgraded Ghana's ratings from CCC+ to B with a stable outlook. On inflation, he said the rate declined from 23.8 per cent in 2024 to 5.5 per cent in October 2026 under Dr Ato Forson. He compared this with the previous administration's record, noting that inflation fell from 15.4 per cent in 2016 to 9.4 per cent by the end of 2018 under Mr Ofori-Atta. He said the economic indicators provided sufficient evidence to support his position that Dr Ato Forson had performed better in managing the economy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ato-forson-h.title_zh: 阿托·福尔松管理经济的能力强于奥福里-阿塔
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ato-forson-h.body_zh: 教育部长兼塔马利南选区议员哈鲁纳·伊德里苏表示，财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士管理加纳经济的表现优于其前任肯·奥福里-阿塔。他认为，关键经济指标的改善、加纳退出国际货币基金组织（IMF）计划以及该国信用评级上调，证明了两位部长在经济管理方面所取得的差异。11月18日星期三，他在议会关于2027年预算陈述的辩论中发言说，对两位财政部长的比较应以卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士胜出作为结论。他说：“议长，辩论仍在进行，对手是时任前财政部长肯·奥福里-阿塔先生与现任财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士。议长，请就此作出定论。事实上，就经济管理的任何衡量标准或评价而言，卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士都已赢得这场辩论，这是已有定论的。”他质疑，如果现任财政部长对经济的管理不优于奥福里-阿塔先生，他怎么可能促成加纳退出IMF计划。伊德里苏先生还引用了标准普尔、惠誉和穆迪的信用评级评估，称这些机构已将加纳的评级从CCC+上调至B，展望稳定。关于通货膨胀，他说在卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士任内，通胀率从2024年的23.8%降至2026年10月的5.5%。他将这一表现与上一届政府的成绩作比较，指出在奥福里-阿塔先生任内，通胀率从2016年的15.4%降至2018年底的9.4%。他说，经济指标提供了充分证据，支持他关于卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士管理经济表现更好的立场

WoPU said the gesture reflected Tinubu’s willingness to prioritise forgiveness and national harmony over confrontation.

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/conv.body: Working People United (WoPU) has commended President Bola Tinubu for granting clemency to the 78 individuals arrested in connection with the attack on his presidential convoy in Abuja, describing the decision as an act of statesmanship, magnanimity and compassionate leadership. In a statement by its National Coordinator-General, Prince Williams Akporeha, the group said the President’s decision demonstrated his commitment to national unity, reconciliation and peace despite the gravity of the incident. WoPU said the gesture reflected Tinubu’s willingness to prioritise forgiveness and national harmony over confrontation. According to the statement, “President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has once again demonstrated the depth of his compassion, fatherly disposition, and unwavering commitment to the welfare of all Nigerians. The group described the decision as a demonstration of the President’s belief in second chances and peaceful coexistence, adding that it would help prevent the incident from deepening divisions in the country. WoPU said the gesture was consistent with the objectives of the Renewed Hope Agenda, which seeks to build an inclusive, prosperous and stable Nigeria. It urged Nigerian youths to emulate the President’s example by embracing dialogue, patience and responsible civic engagement. The movement also cautioned young people against allowing themselves to be used by individuals or groups seeking to promote violence and instability for political interests. “It is imperative for Nigerian youths to remain vigilant and responsible. They must resist every attempt by unscrupulous elements to use them as instruments of violence, lawlessness, and political disruption. “The future of our nation lies in peaceful participation, constructive engagement, and unwavering faith in democratic institutions,” the statement added. The group also urged youths to appreciate the administration’s policies and reforms, which it said were designed to promote long-term economic growth, social stability and national development. It reaffirmed its support for the Tinubu administration’s reforms and developmental initiatives, expressing confidence that the Renewed Hope Agenda would deliver positive outcomes for workers, entrepreneurs, artisans, professionals and other Nigerians. WoPU, a civic and socio-political movement comprising workers, traders, artisans, professionals, entrepreneurs and grassroots stakeholders across the country, said it would continue to mobilise support for the President’s vision of a prosperous and united Nigeria beyond 2027. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/conv.title_zh: 车队遇袭：西非人民联合党赞扬蒂努布赦免78名嫌疑人
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/conv.body_zh: 劳动人民 united 运动（WoPU）赞扬博拉·蒂努布总统对78名因袭击其位于阿布贾的总统车队而被捕人员给予赦免，称这一决定体现了政治家风范、宽宏大量和富有同理心的领导风格。该组织全国协调总干事威廉姆斯·阿克波雷哈亲王在声明中说，尽管事件性质严重，总统的决定仍表明他致力于国家团结、和解与和平。WoPU表示，这一举动反映出蒂努布愿意把宽恕和国家和谐置于对抗之上。声明称：“博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统再次展现了其深厚的同理心、父亲般的情怀，以及对全体尼日利亚人福祉坚定不移的承诺。该组织称，这项决定体现了总统对第二次机会与和平共处的信念，并将有助于防止该事件加剧国内分歧。WoPU表示，这一举动与“更新希望议程”的目标一致，该议程旨在建设一个包容、繁荣且稳定的尼日利亚。该组织敦促尼日利亚青年以总统为榜样，接受对话、保持耐心并负责任地参与公民事务。该运动还告诫年轻人，不要让自己被企图以政治利益为名煽动暴力和局势不稳的个人或团体利用。声明补充道：“尼日利亚青年必须保持警惕并承担责任。他们必须抵制不法分子企图利用他们充当暴力、违法和政治破坏工具的一切图谋。“我们国家的未来在于和平参与、建设性互动，以及对民主制度坚定不移的信任。”该组织还敦促青年支持并认同本届政府的政策和改革，称这些政策和改革旨在促进长期经济增长、社会稳定和国家发展。它重申支持蒂努布政府的改革和发展倡议，并相信“更新希望议程”将为劳动者、创业者、手艺人、专业人士及其他尼日利亚人带来积极成果。WoPU是一个由全国劳动者、商人、手艺人、专业人士、创业者和基层利益相关者组成的公民与社会政治运动。该组织表示，将继续动员各方支持总统建设繁荣、团结尼日利亚的愿景，并将其延续至2027年以后。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title: In Akwa Ibom, residents say major agricultural project worsens road condition
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary: When Governor Umo Eno stood before dignitaries on 29 April to commission Akwa Ibom State’s new agricultural equipment leasing facility at Ekpri Nsukara in Uyo, the state capital, the project was presented as a symbol of the administration’s ambition to transform farming.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary_zh: 4月29日，阿夸伊博姆州州长乌莫·埃诺在州首府乌约的埃克普里·恩苏卡拉为该州新落成的农业设备租赁设施揭幕时，该项目被作为政府推动农业转型的雄心的象征。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: When Governor Umo Eno stood before dignitaries on 29 April to commission Akwa Ibom State’s new agricultural equipment leasing facility at Ekpri Nsukara in Uyo, the state capital, the project was presented as a symbol of the administration’s ambition to transform farming. The facility, built on the grounds of the long-abandoned Akwa Ibom State Agriculture Development Programme (AKADEP) Farm, was intended to put modern agricultural machinery within the reach of farmers and help drive food production under the agricultural component of the administration’s ARISE Agenda. But a few metres away from the gleaming facility, another story was unfolding. A community road known as Ekpri Nsukara/ Ikot Okoidio, painstakingly maintained by residents, had become a muddy, waterlogged passage. Sections of the road had been washed away. Some families had become cut off, with no vehicular access to their homes. When it rains, residents say they wait for hours before floodwater recedes for them to leave their homes. The bad road has caused some residents to abandon their cars. Many trek to the main road to board public transport. For some parents, rain has become a reason to keep children at home. And for residents who had initially welcomed the government’s arrival, the irony is painful since the project they believed would bring development to their neighbourhood has, according to them, made an existing environmental problem worse. PREMIUM TIMES visited the area in late July and again on 2 September. The condition of the road had deteriorated further during the period. The newspaper also found incomplete sections of the drainage system, new drains destroyed by floodwaters, an unconnected existing drain and sections of the outfall drainage that had not been backfilled. Our investigation also raises questions about how the drainage contractor was selected, whether the work was subjected to the environmental safeguards required by law, and whether the state government adequately disclosed procurement information for a project involving billions of naira in public funds. Residents said the large expanse of uncultivated farmland also served an environmental function of absorbing some of the water moving through the area. According to the community, that changed in August 2024 when the state government notified them of its intent to develop the site. Construction began in 2025 leading to the fencing of the facility as work progressed. The 2025 revised budget provided N160 million jointly for the renovation of the mechanic workshop at the facility and the procurement of safety gear and work outfits. The 2026 approved budget went much further with a N1.5 billion appropriated for the “Construction of Equipment Leasing Yard at Ekpri Nsukara-Uyo,” under the Ministry of Agriculture. The project was eventually commissioned by Mr Eno on 29 April. During an earlier inspection of the facility in February, Mr Eno publicly praised the work . “I am so proud of what this young female engineer has done. She has done very well, and I am told by Hensek that this is the best concrete road in this state,” the governor said, according to reports of the inspection. At the commissioning, reports identified the engineer as Alorye Ewa, managing director of Hansie Building Services Limited, and described her as the project engineer. Mr Eno said Ms Ewa was selected through the ARISE Procurement Portal based on her perceived competence. That assertion is now one of the questions at the centre of the project. The flooding problem in the community was not new. Inyang Victor, a public servant who said he had lived in the area for 11 years, told PREMIUM TIMES that residents had spent years managing the water problem themselves. “We have tried in many ways to make this place habitable,” he said. According to Mr Victor, residents contributed money to buy laterite, construct makeshift drainage channels and undertake other remedial work. Earlier this year, he said, residents bought laterite, used cement bags to reinforce vulnerable portions and channelled water away from the road. “The road was manageable although we still needed intervention,” he said. The Akwa Ibom State Government later initiated a drainage and road project for the community. Residents had expected the new project to solve their problem. Mr Victor said workers eventually constructed drains from the main road towards the community but stopped before completing the system. “To encourage the workers, the community was very supportive. Personally, I bought the workers bags of water many times,” he said. He said many of the labourers were women who carried construction materials manually. But, according to him, the workers disappeared around the time of the commissioning of the equipment leasing facility. “The day before the Ibom Leasing Company project was commissioned by the governor, all the workers left. We thought perhaps they wanted to attend the event and they would return but they never did.” Since then, residents say the consequences have become severe, destroying the road they had. Okon Williams, the caretaker of the street, said he had spent more than N800,000 of his personal funds constructing and maintaining a drainage system before the government project. He believes the new drainage system has failed to properly channel the volume of water because it was poorly done. “The flood water no longer pass through the drains, it now moves into the streets and houses. It has destroyed the roads,” Mr Williams said. He said residents could spend three to four hours waiting for floodwater to recede after heavy rain. He said the problem was particularly troubling because the community is close to the seat of government. “We are at the back of Government House. Would it be right that we live close to Government House yet we suffer this much?” Mr Williams also questioned the construction process. He said residents repeatedly asked for the identity of the company executing the outfall drainage but could not obtain an answer. He said they did not see any heavy machinery at the site, and that much of the work was done manually. Residents also alleged that some construction activities continued late into the night although PREMIUM TIMES could not independently establish the hours during which all phases of the work were undertaken. The consequences are beyond one area. PREMIUM TIMES observed that Ambassador Kufre Akang’s Street had become cut off from Ekpri Nsukara/Ikot Okoidio Street. Residents said they now park their vehicles elsewhere and use public transportation before trekking home. Mary Williams, who said she has lived in the community for over five years, said residents’ efforts to maintain the road had been wiped out. “Before the holiday, when it rains, we are unable to allow our children go to school because of the risk,” she said. She said the flooding had made the road unusable. “We no longer use our vehicles because the road has been destroyed. We now trek out and use public transport.” She asked rhetorically what would be the consequence if a resident required urgent medical attention. Another resident, Amarachi Anyanwu, who said she had lived in the area for three years, said she had never experienced flooding of this magnitude. “Going to work is very difficult. You have to trek out. Taking the children to school has been a challenge. When it rains, they miss classes,” she said. A resident, Emmanuel Udofia, described the road as so bad that residents could become trapped during emergencies. “Now, water is flowing recklessly, destroying the road more. I am only afraid about emergencies.” When PREMIUM TIMES contacted Uwem Etim, chief of staff to the village head and adviser to the Ekpri Nsukara Village Council, he confirmed that the village council had received complaints about the emerging flood challenge in the community. He said the village head, Emem Asikpo, had previously undertaken grading and minor erosion-control interventions but that the scale of the flooding had gone beyond the community’s capacity. “We solicited for the government to come to our aid so that property and lives would not be destroyed,” Mr Etim said. “I know the governor loves us and is trying. But please, he should expedite action.” One of the most revealing features observed by PREMIUM TIMES was the failure to connect an existing community drainage channel to the newly constructed drain. The community resident, Mr Victor, said a resident had constructed the old drain before the government intervention. According to him, the project workers broke part of the old drain during construction but did not complete the connection to the new system. PREMIUM TIMES observed that the old drain did not appear to connect to the new drain. Instead, water emerging from the old channel was left without a clear termination into the new drainage system. Residents said they had complained during construction and were told the connection would subsequently be made. They are now concerned that reconnecting the channels will require breaking into the new concrete structure which they said is about six inches thick. This becomes a concern because a drainage capacity, reinforcement, slope, connections, discharge point and relationship with existing waterways determine whether it safely conveys stormwater or moves the problem from one location to another. At some sections inspected by PREMIUM TIMES, the outfall drainage had not been backfilled. The newspaper also observed that the drainage serving the area from the equipment facility towards the community primary and secondary school appeared better executed than portions of the outfall drainage. At the outfall drain, instead of safely conveying water away from the developed site, the poorly executed or incomplete sections appear to have concentrated water into vulnerable portions of the community. In some locations, the increased flow was already cutting gullies into the soil. Residents also raised questions about the materials used in parts of the drainage. PREMIUM TIMES observed sections of broken drainage where reinforcement appeared to consist of three lines of 10mm rods. Residents alleged that sections requiring stronger reinforcement had not been constructed accordingly. Despite the observations, the Akwa Ibom State Government has not provided to this newspaper the project’s approved drawings, bills of quantities, technical specifications and an independent engineering assessment to establish that the construction breached approved specifications. The absence of the contractor’s project signboard at the site further complicated efforts to establish basic information about the project. Under standard public works practice, project signboards ordinarily provide members of the public with information about the contractor, client and basic description of the project. At the time of PREMIUM TIMES’ visits, there was no such signboard identifying the contractor handling the outfall drainage. The identity of the contractor became another mystery. Residents said Amitec Construction handled the drainage from the entrance of the equipment leasing facility towards the community school, while another company handled the outfall drainage. PREMIUM TIMES contacted Secretary and Head of Legal and Community Relations of Amitec Construction, Peter Umoru. Mr Umoru confirmed that Amitec handled the drainage from the facility entrance towards the community school. He denied that his company was responsible for the drainage works blamed by residents for the flooding around Ikot Okoidio and Ekpri Nsukara. That left the identity of the outfall contractor unresolved publicly. But independent sources within the Ministry of Works and Agriculture told PREMIUM TIMES that Hansie Building Services Limited was the contractor responsible for the outfall drainage and that the company was also awarded the equipment leasing facility.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 在阿夸伊博姆州，居民称大型农业项目使道路状况恶化
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 4月29日，州长 Umo Eno 出席位于首府 Uyo 的 Ekpri Nsukara，为阿夸伊博姆州新农业设备租赁设施揭幕时，在场的政要将该项目称为州政府推动农业转型的雄心之作。该设施建在长期废弃的阿夸伊博姆州农业发展计划（AKADEP）农场 grounds 上，旨在让农民能够使用现代农业机械，并在州政府 ARISE 议程的农业组成部分下推动粮食生产。然而，就在距这座光鲜亮丽设施几米之外，另一幕故事正在发生。一条名为 Ekpri Nsukara/Ikot Okoidio 的社区道路由居民精心维护，如今却变得泥泞、积水。部分路段已被冲毁，一些家庭与外界隔绝，车辆无法进入家门。居民称，每逢下雨，他们必须等待数小时，等洪水退去后才能离开家中。糟糕的道路使一些居民不再使用汽车。许多人步行前往主干道乘坐公共交通。对一些父母而言，雨水已成了让孩子留在家里的理由。而对于最初欢迎政府到来的居民来说，这种讽刺令人痛心，因为据他们所知，原本以为能给社区带来发展的项目，反而使现有的环境问题更加严重。PREMIUM TIMES 于7月底前往该地区采访，并于9月2日再次到访。在此期间，道路状况进一步恶化。该报还发现排水系统部分路段尚未完工，新修的水沟被洪水冲毁，一条原有水沟没有接入新系统，排水出口的部分沟渠也没有回填。我们的调查还提出了若干问题：排水工程承包商是如何选定的，工程是否遵守法律规定的环境保障措施，以及州政府是否充分披露了一项耗资数十亿奈拉公共资金项目的采购信息。居民称，大片未开垦农田原本也发挥着环境功能，能够吸收流经该地区的部分水量。据社区方面称，这种状况在2024年8月发生了变化，当时州政府通知他们有意开发该地块。工程于2025年开工，随着施工推进，设施逐步被围挡起来。2025年修订预算共同拨款1.6亿奈拉，用于翻修该设施的机械维修车间以及采购安全装备和工作服。2026年获批预算进一步扩大规模，在农业部名下为“Ekpri Nsukara-Uyo 设备租赁场地建设”拨款15亿奈拉。该项目最终于4月29日由 Eno 先生揭幕。此前在2月视察该设施时，Eno 先生公开称赞了工程进展。据有关视察的报道，州长说：“我为这位年轻女工程师所做的工作感到非常自豪。她做得非常好，Hensek 告诉我，这是本州最好的混凝土道路。”在揭幕活动中，报道将这位工程师列为 Hansie Building Services Limited 董事总经理 Alorye Ewa，并称其为项目工程师。Eno 先生表示，Ewa 女士因其被认为具备的能力而通过 ARISE 采购门户获选。这一说法如今已成为该项目的核心疑点之一。该社区的积水问题并非新近出现。自称已在此地区居住11年的公务员 Inyang Victor 告诉 PREMIUM TIMES，居民多年来一直自行处理水患问题。“我们尝试了许多办法，想让这个地方适宜居住，”他说。据 Victor 先生介绍，居民曾集资购买红土、修建临时排水沟，并开展其他补救工作。今年早些时候，他说，居民购买红土，用水泥袋加固易损路段，并将水引离道路。“道路当时还能通行，尽管仍需要政府干预，”他说。阿夸伊博姆州政府后来为该社区启动了排水和道路工程。居民原本期待新项目能解决他们的问题。Victor 先生说，工人最终从主干道开始朝社区方向修建水沟，但系统尚未完工就停工了。“为了鼓励工人，社区提供了大力支持。就我个人而言，我曾多次给工人购买成袋的水，”他说。他说，许多劳工是女性，她们靠手工作业搬运建筑材料。但据他称，在设备租赁设施揭幕前后，工人突然消失了。“Ibom Leasing Company 项目由州长揭幕的前一天，所有工人都离开了。我们以为也许他们想参加活动，之后还会回来，但他们再也没有回来。”此后，居民称后果变得严重，他们原有的道路也被毁坏。街道管理员 Okon Williams 说，在政府工程开工前，他已花费超过80万奈拉个人资金修建和维护排水系统。他认为，新排水系统未能妥善引流，是因为施工质量差。“洪水不再流经水沟，而是流进街道和房屋。道路已经被毁掉了，”Williams 先生说。他说，大雨过后，居民可能需要等待三至四个小时，洪水才会退去。他说，这一问题尤其令人不安，因为社区离政府所在地很近。“我们就在政府大楼后面。住在政府大楼附近，却要遭受这么多苦难，这样合理吗？”Williams 先生还对施工流程提出质疑。他说，居民多次询问承建排水出口工程的公司身份，却始终没有得到答复。他说，施工现场没有看到任何重型机械，大部分作业都是人工完成的。居民还声称，一些施工作业持续到深夜，不过 PREMIUM TIMES 无法独立核实工程各阶段的具体施工时间。后果波及不止一个区域。PREMIUM TIMES 观察到，Ambassador Kufre Akang 街已与 Ekpri Nsukara/Ikot Okoidio 街隔绝。居民称，如今他们把车停在别处，先乘坐公共交通，再步行回家。自称在该社区住了五年多的 Mary Williams 表示，居民维护道路的努力付诸东流。“假期前一下雨，我们就无法让孩子去上学，因为存在风险，”她说。她说，积水已使道路无法通行。“我们不再使用车辆，因为道路已经毁了。现在我们步行外出，再乘坐公共交通。”她反问，如果居民需要紧急就医，后果会怎样。另一名居民 Amarachi Anyanwu 称，她已在此地居住三年，但从未经历过如此严重的积水。“去上班非常困难。你得步行出去。送孩子上学也很成问题。下雨时，他们会缺课，”她说。居民 Emmanuel Udofia 形容道路糟糕到居民可能在紧急情况下受困。“现在，水四处乱流，进一步破坏道路。我只担心发生紧急情况。”PREMIUM TIMES 联系村长幕僚长、Ekpri Nsukara 村委员会顾问 Uwem Etim 后，他证实村委员会已经收到有关社区新出现积水问题的投诉。他说，村长 Emem Asikpo 此前曾进行道路找平和小规模侵蚀控制，但积水规模已超出社区应对能力。“我们请求政府前来援助，以免财产和生命遭到破坏，”Etim 先生说。“我知道州长关心我们，也在努力解决问题。但请他加快行动。”PREMIUM TIMES 观察到的最能揭示问题的情况之一，是一条现有社区排水沟未能接入新建水沟。社区居民 Victor 先生说，政府介入前，一名居民修建了那条旧水沟。据他介绍，施工人员施工时破坏了部分旧水沟，却没有完成与新系统的连接。PREMIUM TIMES 观察到，旧水沟似乎并未接入新水沟。相反，从旧沟流出的水没有明确的出口接入新排水系统。居民称，他们曾在施工期间提出投诉，对方答复称之后会完成连接。如今，他们担心重新连接两条沟渠需要凿开新的混凝土结构，而该结构据称厚约六英寸。这一点之所以令人担忧，是因为排水能力、结构加固、坡度、连接方式、排放点以及与现有水道的关系，共同决定排水系统能否安全输送雨水，还是只会把问题从一个地点转移到另一个地点。在 PREMIUM TIMES 检查的部分路段，排水出口尚未回填。该报还观察到，从设备设施通往社区小学和中学的排水工程，其施工质量似乎好于排水出口的部分沟渠。在排水出口处，施工不当或尚未完工的路段似乎把水流集中到社区的易损区域。在一些地点，增大的水流已经开始在土壤中冲刷出沟壑。居民还对部分排水工程所用材料提出疑问。PREMIUM TIMES 观察到部分破损排水沟的加固材料似乎由三排10毫米钢筋构成。居民声称，本应采用更强加固措施的路段并未按此施工。尽管观察到了这些问题，阿夸伊博姆州政府仍未向该报提供获批图纸、工程量清单、技术规格以及用于确认施工违反获批规格的独立工程评估。施工现场缺少承包商项目标牌，进一步增加了查明项目基本信息的难度。按照公共工程惯例，项目标牌通常会向公众提供承包商、客户和项目基本说明等信息。PREMIUM TIMES 两次到访时，现场均没有标明排水出口工程承包商身份的标牌。承包商身份由此成了另一个谜团。居民称，Amitec Construction 承接了从设备租赁设施入口通往社区学校的排水工程，另有公司负责排水出口工程。PREMIUM TIMES 联系了 Amitec Construction 法务与社区关系秘书兼负责人 Peter Umoru。Umoru 先生确认，Amitec 承接了从设施入口通往社区学校的排水工程。他否认公司负责居民归咎于 Ikot Okoidio 和 Ekpri Nsukara 周边积水的排水工程。因此，排水出口工程承包商的身份仍未公开查明。不过，尼日利亚工程部与农业部内部的消息人士告诉 PREMIUM TIMES，Hansie Building Services Limited 是排水出口工程的承包商，该公司同时获得了设备租赁设施项目。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.title: Tinubu expands 2027 campaign appearances to 19 states, FCT
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.summary: President Bola Tinubu has expanded his planned appearances at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rallies from 12 states to 19 states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) ahead of the 2027 general elections. Tinubu was initially scheduled to attend rallies in only 12 states, with other party leaders expected to represent him at campaign events in the remaining states. The revised timetable now formally includes the three states among the locations for his personal campaign appearances.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.summary_zh: 在2027年大选前，博拉·蒂努巴总统将其计划出席的进步大会党（APC）总统竞选集会从12个州扩大到19个州及联邦首都辖区（FCT）。蒂努巴最初仅计划出席12个州的集会，其他党派领导人预计将代表他参加其余州的竞选活动。修订后的日程正式将这3个州列为他亲自参加竞选活动的地点。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.body: President Bola Tinubu has expanded his planned appearances at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rallies from 12 states to 19 states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) ahead of the 2027 general elections. The revised campaign timetable lists 20 locations where the president is expected to attend rallies between October 24, 2026, and January 13, 2027, according to TheCable, which reported that the schedule was released by APC National Publicity Secretary, Felix Morka. The revised itinerary adds Katsina, Taraba, Abuja, Gusau, Owerri and Ilorin to the president’s initial campaign trail, while also incorporating Akwa Ibom, Jigawa and Kebbi, where he has already attended rallies. Tinubu was initially scheduled to attend rallies in only 12 states, with other party leaders expected to represent him at campaign events in the remaining states. However, he has made appearances in several states outside the original schedule. On November 6, the president visited Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, where he attended an APC rally and inaugurated projects executed by Governor Umo Eno’s administration. He followed this with a campaign rally in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, on November 7. Tinubu also attended the party’s rallies in Dutse, Jigawa State, on November 10, and Birnin Kebbi, Kebbi State, on November 17. The revised timetable now formally includes the three states among the locations for his personal campaign appearances. Under the updated schedule, Tinubu is expected to attend rallies in Katsina on December 2, Kano on December 17, Jalingo on December 19, Abuja on December 21, Gusau on December 28 and Owerri on December 30. The president is also scheduled to visit Yola, Adamawa State, on January 4; Sokoto on January 5; Ilorin, Kwara State, on January 8; Asaba, Delta State, on January 11; and Lagos on January 13. Other states listed for his personal appearances include Kaduna, Oyo, Borno and Enugu. The revised timetable also changes the dates of some rallies in the original calendar. The Bauchi rally, initially scheduled for November 29 with Tinubu expected to attend, has been moved to December 1, although the new timetable does not indicate a presidential appearance. The Sokoto rally has been shifted from December 5 to January 5, 2027, while the Asaba rally moves from December 12 to January 11. The Lagos rally, expected to serve as the campaign’s major closing event, has also been rescheduled from January 9 to January 13. The updated calendar lists 37 rallies across the 36 states and the FCT, with Tinubu expected to personally attend 20 of them. The North-West has the highest number of states on the president’s revised campaign itinerary, with seven: Kaduna, Jigawa, Kebbi, Katsina, Kano, Zamfara and Sokoto. The North-East and South-South follow with three states each. The North-East states are Borno, Taraba and Adamawa, while the South-South states are Akwa Ibom, Rivers and Delta. The North-Central, South-West and South-East have two states each: Plateau and Kwara; Oyo and Lagos; and Enugu and Imo, respectively. Tinubu had indicated during the inauguration of the APC Presidential Campaign Council in Abuja that he would not attend every campaign rally, citing the need to balance political engagements with his responsibilities as president. He, however, pledged to make time to engage Nigerians directly as party leaders take the campaign to states and local government areas. https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription India is imposing an effective duty of 162.5% on bulk Scotch imports amid an ongoing dispute over the India-UK trade agreement, raising concerns among liquor companies as the levy exceeds the 150% charged before the agreement, according to eight sources and a government document. The India-UK trade agreement, implemented in July, halved tariffs on Scotch to 75%. Businesses and the British government had hailed the move as a major win for companies such as Pernod Ricard and Diageo, which import Scotch in bulk and blend it to make popular products for India’s USD 65-billion liquor market. However, in the first major dispute linked to the trade agreement, Indian investigators have argued that companies are using incorrect customs classifications for bulk Scotch concentrates, which are treated as raw materials used to make drinks such as blended whiskies. Since May, such imports have been classified under a newly created customs category for “compound alcoholic preparations”, which attracts a 150% t tariff, according to Indian investigators. These imports are then subject to a consumption tax, taking the total duty to 162.5% , according to a government document reviewed by Reuters and eight sources, including industry executives and customs agents familiar with the matter. As the dispute continues, thousands of litres of bulk Scotch in more than 80 shipping containers belonging to Pernod, Diageo and Bacardi remain stuck at ports, Reuters reported last week. Under a provisional release arrangement pending investigation, 75% of the goods’ value must be paid upfront, with the remaining amount covered by bank guarantees, the sources said. “Industry has already reduced prices of Scotch products in the market when the India-UK pact kicked in, and now they are faced with higher duties again,” said a source in the liquor importing business. Pernod, which owns UK-based Chivas Brothers, Diageo and several other Indian companies believe that both bulk and bottled Scotch imports should be taxed at 75% under the trade agreement. The British government has repeatedly said in statements that it is working with New Delhi to resolve the issue, while India has said the dispute will be settled soon. Pernod and Diageo have moved to arrange bank guarantees and other funding to secure the release of their blocked containers and ensure business continuity. Bacardi is still deciding its next steps, three of the sources said. Shares of Diageo in London and Pernod in France fell following the Reuters report, declining 1.5% and 1.25%, respectively. India is Pernod’s biggest global market by volume, and the company, along with Diageo, dominates the Indian spirits market. Diageo declined to comment, while Pernod and Bacardi did not respond to queries. The Indian Finance Ministry and the tax authority also did not respond. Long-running tariff disputes have been a sore point for foreign investors and have affected companies such as Volkswagen and Samsung. Indian officials say they are only enforcing the law, but executives say they are often caught off guard by the way New Delhi classifies imports. Mumbai-listed companies Radico Khaitan, Allied Blenders and Distillers, and Tilaknagar Industries also import bulk Scotch and are under scrutiny, along with Pernod and Diageo. Smaller companies could face greater pressure in arranging bank guarantees, as they may need to provide collateral. Such guarantees also have to be reported as contingent liabilities. “We have no alternative at this stage,” said an Indian executive, referring to a possible disruption in the market due to a shortage of bulk Scotch. “Meeting the production requirements is extremely critical, even though bank guarantees stress working capital.” About 80% of Scotch whisky imports from Britain by volume arrive in bulk, and India is the largest market for Scotch by volume. Most bulk Scotch imports are used to make Indian-Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) whisky by blending a small quantity of Scotch with other spirits. These mass-market products are considerably cheaper than wholly imported whiskies such as Chivas Regal and Johnnie Walker. Whisky tariffs were a sticking point during the years of negotiations leading up to the trade agreement’s implementation on July 15. Britain has said that “iconic UK products”, including whiskies, would benefit from the pact. The UK’s Scotch Whisky Association has forecast that the trade agreement could boost Scotch exports to India by USD 1.34 billion over five years. A confidential memo from Indian investigators, reported by Reuters last week, said that any misclassification under the India-UK trade agreement needed to stop as it had “substantial revenue implications” for New Delhi. Indian liquor industry sources said that while the classification issue was being debated, they had not anticipated the imposition of the additional local tax. “The local tax addition is a googly,” one industry source said, using the cricket term for a deceptive delivery by a bowler. https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.body_zh:

据8名消息人士和一份政府文件所述，在印度与英国贸易协议引发的争端仍未解决之际，印度对散装苏格兰威士忌进口征收了162.5%的实际关税。这引发酒类 companies 的担忧，因为该税率高于协议实施前的150%。

印度与英国贸易协议于7月实施，将苏格兰威士忌关税减半至75%。企业和英国政府此前均将此举誉为重大胜利。保乐力加和帝亚吉欧等企业批量进口苏格兰威士忌，再将其调配成畅销产品，供应当价值650亿美元的印度酒类市场。

然而，在与该贸易协议相关的首起重大争端中，印度调查人员认为，各家公司对散装苏格兰威士忌浓缩液使用了错误的海关分类。这类浓缩液被视作生产混合威士忌等酒饮的原材料。自5月以来，此类进口被归入新设的“复合酒精制剂”海关类别，根据印度调查人员的说法，该类别适用150%的关税。随后，这些进口商品还需缴纳消费税，使总关税达到162.5%。路透社审阅的一份政府文件及8名消息人士证实了这一点，其中包括了解此事的情况的行业管理人员和海关人员。

路透社上周报道称，随着争端持续，保乐力加、帝亚吉欧和百加得旗下共80多个集装箱、数千升散装苏格兰威士忌仍滞留港口。根据调查期间实行的临时放行安排，企业须预付货物价值的75%，其余金额则须由银行担保覆盖。

一名酒类进口业消息人士表示：“印度与英国协议生效时，行业已经下调了市场上苏格兰威士忌产品的价格，如今又面临更高的关税。”

保乐力加、帝亚吉欧及另外数家印度公司认为，无论散装还是瓶装苏格兰威士忌进口，都应依据该贸易协议按75%的税率征税。保乐力加旗下拥有总部位于英国的芝华士兄弟。

英国政府在多份声明中反复表示，正与新德里合作解决这一问题；印度则称争端将很快得到解决。

保乐力加和帝亚吉欧已着手安排银行担保及其他资金，以便为滞留集装箱放行提供保障并确保业务连续运转。3名消息人士称，百加得仍在决定下一步行动。

路透社报道发布后，帝亚吉欧在伦敦的股价和保乐力加在法国的股价均下跌，跌幅分别为1.5%和1.25%。印度是保乐力加按销量计算的最大全球市场；该公司与帝亚吉欧共同主导印度烈酒市场。帝亚吉欧拒绝置评，保乐力加和百加得也未回应置评请求。印度财政部和税务部门同样未予回应。

长期存在的关税争端一直是外国投资者的痛点，并影响了大众和三星等公司。印度官员表示，他们只是在执行法律；但企业高管称，新德里对进口商品进行分类的方式往往令其措手不及。

在孟买上市、进口散装苏格兰威士忌的 Radico Khaitan、Allied Blenders and Distillers 和 Tilaknagar Industries，与保乐力加和帝亚吉欧一样，也正受到审查。

小型公司在安排银行担保方面可能面临更大压力，因为它们可能需要提供抵押品。此类担保还必须作为或有负债进行报告。

一名印度企业高管就散装苏格兰威士忌短缺可能造成市场中断一事表示：“现阶段我们别无选择。满足生产需求至关重要，即便银行担保会挤压营运资金。”

按销量计算，英国对印度的苏格兰威士忌进口中约有80%以散装形式抵达，印度也是按销量计算的最大苏格兰威士忌市场。大多数散装苏格兰威士忌进口用于生产印度制造外国酒（IMFL）威士忌，即将少量苏格兰威士忌与其他烈酒混合调制。这些大众市场产品的价格远低于芝华士 Regal 和尊尼获加等全进口威士忌。

在通往贸易协议于7月15日实施之前的多年谈判中，威士忌关税一直是阻碍协议达成的问题。英国曾表示，包括威士忌在内的“英国标志性产品”将从该协议中受益。苏格兰威士忌协会预计，该贸易协议可在5年内推动对印度的苏格兰威士忌出口额增加13.4亿美元。

路透社上周报道的一份印度调查人员内部备忘录称，必须停止依据印度与英国贸易协议进行任何错误分类，因为这对新德里的“税收收入影响重大”。

印度酒类行业消息人士表示，在分类问题仍在讨论之际，他们没有料到还会额外加征本地税。一名行业消息人士借用板球运动中投球手投出欺骗性投球的说法称：“新增本地税是一记出其不意的球。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-ato-f.body: Deputy Majority Leader and Cape Coast MP, George Kweku Ricketts-Hagan, says President John Dramani Mahama and Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson have turned Ghana's economy around within two years of taking office. He attributed the improvement to what he described as fiscal discipline, prudent spending and a shift towards expenditure-based consolidation. Contributing to the debate on the 2027 Budget Statement in Parliament on Wednesday, November 18, Mr Ricketts-Hagan said the government had made significant progress in stabilising the economy despite inheriting difficult economic conditions. “His Excellency John Dramani Mahama and Dr Ato Forson have turned Ghana's economy around in two years. We still have about seven years to spare from what they told us,” he said. He argued that key macroeconomic and fiscal indicators, including inflation and interest rates, had improved under the current administration. Mr Ricketts-Hagan also challenged figures on Ghana's public debt cited by the former Finance Minister, insisting that the country's debt-to-GDP ratio had declined to 47.5 per cent. He said Ghana's debt stood at $53 billion in 2024, representing nearly 70 per cent of GDP, while the current debt stock was about $59.3 billion. According to him, applying the prevailing exchange rate to the current debt figure gives a debt-to-GDP ratio of 47.5 per cent. He further disputed criticisms of the Bank of Ghana's losses linked to financing gold purchases, arguing that the profitability of the Gold Board's operations should be considered alongside the central bank's financial position. Mr Ricketts-Hagan said the government had also abandoned what he described as "excessive borrowing and revenue-based consolidation pursued by the previous administration". He explained that the current approach focuses on aligning government expenditure with available revenue rather than relying on borrowing to finance spending. “Instead of doing an expenditure-based consolidation, they were doing a revenue-based. They were more interested in borrowing money to fund expenditure,” he said. He added that the government was now matching expenditure to revenue and directing available resources towards priority areas of the economy. “The discipline that we have instilled in this country, the expenditure that we are making sure that we have the revenue to fund, is what has brought us here,” he said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-ato-f.title_zh: 马哈马和阿托·福尔松在两年内扭转了加纳经济
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-ato-f.body_zh: 多数党副领袖兼开普海岸选区议员George Kweku Ricketts-Hagan表示，总统John Dramani Mahama和财政部长Dr Cassiel Ato Forson在上任后的两年内扭转了加纳经济的发展势头。他将这一改善归因于所谓的财政纪律、审慎支出以及转向以支出为基础的财政整合。周三11月18日，他在议会参与2027年预算声明辩论时表示，尽管政府接手的是艰难的经济状况，但已经在稳定经济方面取得了显著进展。他说：“John Dramani Mahama阁下和Ato Forson博士在两年内扭转了加纳经济的发展势头。按照他们告诉我们的情况，我们大约还有七年时间可以争取。”他认为，包括通货膨胀率和利率在内的主要宏观经济和财政指标，在现政府执政期间均有所改善。Ricketts-Hagan先生还质疑前财政部长引用的加纳公共债务数据，坚持认为该国债务与国内生产总值之比已降至47.5%。他说，加纳2024年的债务规模为530亿美元，相当于国内生产总值的近70%，而目前的债务存量约为593亿美元。据他表示，按当前汇率折算目前的债务规模，债务与国内生产总值之比为47.5%。他还反驳了有关加纳中央银行因融资收购黄金而产生亏损的批评，主张在评估黄金局业务的盈利能力时，也应考虑中央银行的财务状况。Ricketts-Hagan先生说，政府还放弃了前政府所称的“过度借贷和以收入为基础的财政整合”。他解释道，现行做法侧重于使政府支出与可用收入相匹配，而不是依靠借贷为支出提供资金。他说：“他们没有进行以支出为基础的整合，而是进行以收入为基础的整合。他们更热衷于借钱来资助支出。”他补充说，政府目前正使支出与收入相匹配，并把可用资源投向经济的优先领域。他说：“我们在这个国家建立的纪律，以及我们确保有收入为支出提供资金的做法，正是我们走到今天这一步的原因。”

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111812.body: (서울·워싱턴=연합뉴스) 고일환 기자 홍정규 특파원 = 미국에서 최근 통신망과 금융망 등 기술 시스템에서 장애가 잇따르면서 사이버 공격설이 확산하자 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 진화에 나섰다. 백악관은 18일(현지시간) 마코 루비오 국무장관 겸 국가안보보좌관과 제이 클레이턴 국가정보국(DNI) 국장이 각각 필리핀 마닐라에서 연 즉석 기자회견과 방송 인터뷰를 통해 잇따른 전산장애에 대한 정부의 공식 입장을 밝혔다고 전했다. 루비오 장관은 "우리는 이러한 사건들 가운데 어느 것도 서로 연관돼 있다고 믿을 만한 징후도, 증거도, 이유도 전혀 가지고 있지 않다"며 "마이크로소프트에서 발생한 사건은 연방항공청(FAA)에서 목격한 사건과 아무런 관련이 없다. FAA에서 발생한 사건도 며칠 전 은행들에서 목격한 사건과 아무런 관련이 없다"고 말했다. 최근 마이크로소프트와 JP모건체이스, FAA의 항공관제 시스템, 미 국가안보국(NSA) 등에서 발생한 장애가 사이버 공격과 관련 없는 '개별적인 기술 장애'라는 취지다. 실제로 마이크로소프트 등 관련 업체와 기관은 소프트웨어 오류나 네트워크·라우터 업그레이드 등이 전산장애의 원인이라고 발표한 바 있다. 루비오 장관은 "개별적이고 독립적인 사건들 가운데 어느 하나라도 사악한 의도를 가진 행위자, 사이버 해커, 범죄자, 다른 국가 또는 어떤 종류의 악의적인 행위자와 관련돼 있다고 믿을 만한 증거나 이유를 전혀 가지고 있지 않다"고 말했다. 클레이턴 국장도 "조직적인 사이버 공격의 징후"나 "(적대) 국가가 지원하는 활동의 징후"를 발견하지 못했다면서 정보당국이 "과거부터 그러한 활동들을 탐지해 왔기 때문에 이 판단에 상당한 확신을 가질 수 있다"고 강조했다. 클레이턴 국장은 잇따른 장애가 시스템 업그레이드 때문이라면서 "시스템을 업그레이드한 후 모든 경우에 시스템이 예상대로 다시 정상 가동되는 것은 아니다. 어떤 경우에는 한 시스템이 다른 시스템으로 작업이나 데이터를 넘겨줘야 하는데, 그러한 시스템 간 인계 과정이 예상대로 복구되지 않고 있다"고 설명했다. 그는 "우리에게는 레거시 시스템, 즉 오래된 기존 시스템들이 있으며, 이 시스템들은 점점 더 서로 연결되고 있고 점점 더 많은 트래픽을 처리하고 있다"며 "우리는 시스템 업그레이드가 필요하다. 패치 작업이 필요하다"고 말했다. 전산장애가 며칠 사이 집중적으로 발생하면서 미 정부가 실제 원인을 숨기고 있다는 의혹이 확산하는 데 대해 "현재 가지고 있는 정보를 바탕으로 우리가 무엇을 알고 있고 무엇을 믿고 있는지 투명하게 공유하고 있다"고 일축했다. 앞서 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 연쇄 전산장애에 대한 기자들의 질문에 "그게 인생이다. 크고 강력하고 돈도 많으면 그런 일이 일어난다"면서 "괜찮다"고 말해 이번 사태를 대수롭지 않게 여기는 듯한 반응을 보였다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/19 02:28 송고 2026년11월19일 02시28분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111812.title_zh: 特朗普政府将集中应对持续升级的“智能”系统故障……“这不是网络攻击”（综合报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111812.body_zh: （首尔·华盛顿＝韩联社）记者高日焕、固定记者洪正奎报道：美国近期通信网络、金融网络等技术系统接连发生故障，网络攻击的猜测扩散之际，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府开始采取行动。白宫官员18日（当地时间）称，马可·鲁比奥国务卿兼国家安全顾问和国家情报总监（DNI）杰·克莱顿分别通过在菲律宾马尼拉举行的即时记者会及广播采访，介绍了政府对接连发生的计算机故障的官方立场。鲁比奥国务卿表示：“我们完全没有任何迹象、证据或理由相信这些事件彼此有关。”他还说：“微软发生的事件与联邦航空管理局（FAA）发生的事件毫无关联。FAA发生的事件也与几天前银行发生的事件毫无关联。”这些事件包括近期微软、摩根大通、FAA航空管制系统和美国国家安全局（NSA）发生的故障，其性质均是与网络攻击无关的“各自独立的技术故障”。事实上，微软等相关企业和机构已宣布，计算机故障的原因是软件错误、网络或路由器升级等。鲁比奥国务卿表示：“我们完全没有任何证据或理由认为，其中任何一个独立事件与怀有恶意的行为者、网络黑客、犯罪分子、其他国家或任何类型的恶意行为者有关。”克莱顿总监也强调称，没有发现“有组织网络攻击的迹象”或“敌对国家支持活动的迹象”，并表示：“情报机构过去一直都在侦测此类活动，因此我们可以对这一判断有相当程度的把握。”克莱顿总监解释接连发生的故障源于系统升级，并说：“系统升级之后，并非在所有情况下都会如预期一样恢复正常运行。有时，一个系统必须把工作或数据移交给另一个系统，但这种系统之间的交接过程并未如预期恢复。”他说：“我们拥有传统系统，也就是旧的既有系统，这些系统正日益相互连接，也承载着越来越多的流量。我们需要对系统进行升级，也需要进行补丁修复。”计算机故障在数日内集中发生，有关美国政府隐瞒真实原因的说法随之扩散。对此，他仅表示：“我们正根据目前掌握的信息，透明地分享我们知道什么、相信什么。”此前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在回答记者关于连环计算机故障的问题时表示：“这就是人生。规模大、实力强、又有钱，就会发生这种事。”他还说：“没关系。”其反应显示，他似乎并未重视此次事件。详情请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和利用。2026年11月19日02:28发布

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/poli.body: The Anambra State Police Command has intensified security operations across the state ahead of President Bola Tinubu’s re-election campaign rally in Awka and a town hall meeting by the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, in Onitsha. The two political engagements are scheduled for Thursday and Friday, respectively, as political activities gather momentum ahead of the 2027 general elections. The Anambra State Presidential Campaign Council for Tinubu’s re-election is scheduled to hold a mega rally tagged “SoluTinubu 2027” on Thursday, November 19, at Dr Alex Ekwueme Square, Awka. Obi, a former governor of the state, is expected to hold a town hall meeting with residents at 2pm on Friday, November 20, at the Archbishop C.J. Patterson Building, All Saints Cathedral, Onitsha. In a statement on Wednesday, the Police Public Relations Officer, SP Tochukwu Ikenga, said the command had strengthened patrols, surveillance and personnel deployment in collaboration with other security agencies to ensure peaceful conduct of the events. He said the measures were aimed at preventing criminal activities, maintaining public order and protecting residents, visitors and participants before, during and after the political engagements. According to him, the command has strengthened operational coordination with sister security agencies, area commands, divisions and tactical units to provide adequate security coverage of strategic locations, public facilities, major roads and identified security flashpoints. The statement said the security arrangements also included enhanced intelligence gathering and improved response capabilities to address emerging threats. The Commissioner of Police, CP Nnanna Ama, was said to have directed operational commanders and personnel to remain vigilant, proactive and professional in the discharge of their duties. Ama also emphasised that security operations must respect human rights and ensure that residents’ movements, businesses and other lawful activities were not unnecessarily disrupted. The command cautioned members of the public, particularly social media users, against inflammatory publications, provocative statements and deliberate dissemination of false information capable of inciting violence or threatening public peace. It, however, acknowledged citizens’ constitutional rights to freedom of expression, peaceful assembly and lawful public engagement, urging individuals and groups to exercise such rights responsibly. “The police will take appropriate lawful measures against individuals whose actions constitute criminal offences, while ensuring that all enforcement activities are guided by due process, professionalism and respect for constitutionally guaranteed rights,” Ikenga said. The command reassured residents, visitors and other members of the public of its commitment to providing a safe environment throughout the period of the scheduled activities. It urged residents to remain calm, continue their lawful activities and cooperate with security personnel, while reporting suspicious movements, criminal activities and emerging threats to the nearest police station or through established emergency communication channels. The police also called on traditional rulers, community leaders, youth organisations, civil society groups and media practitioners to support security efforts by promoting responsible communication, discouraging misinformation and encouraging peaceful coexistence. The Tinubu campaign rally is being organised by the Anambra State Presidential Campaign Council, chaired by Governor Chukwuma Soludo, and is expected to attract supporters of the APC and the All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA). The rally is anchored on the message of “progressives working together”. Obi’s town hall meeting, on the other hand, is part of his nationwide political engagements ahead of the 2027 elections. The former governor, who led Anambra State for eight years, remains a prominent political figure in the South-East. The two events are expected to draw considerable political attention to the state as political parties intensify mobilisation ahead of the presidential election scheduled for January 16, 2027. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/poli.body_zh: 在总统博拉·蒂努布即将于阿瓦卡举行连任竞选集会，以及尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）总统候选人彼得·奥比在奥尼察举行市民大会会议之前，阿纳姆布拉州警察指挥部已加强全州安全行动。两场政治活动分别定于周四和周五举行。随着2027年大选临近，政治活动日益活跃。阿纳姆布拉州总统竞选委员会定于11月19日周四在阿瓦卡的亚历克斯·埃克维梅博士广场举行题为“SoluTinubu 2027”的大型集会。奥比曾任该州州长，预计于11月20日周五下午2时在奥尼察万圣大教堂的C.J.帕特森大主教大楼与居民举行市民大会会议。警方公共关系官SP Tochukwu Ikenga周三发表声明称，指挥部已加强巡逻、监控和人员部署，并与其他安全机构协作，以确保活动和平进行。他说，这些措施旨在预防犯罪活动、维护公共秩序，并在两场政治活动之前、期间和之后保护居民、来访者和参与者。据他介绍，指挥部已加强与兄弟安全机构、地区指挥中心、分局及战术单位的行动协调，为战略地点、公共设施、主要道路和已识别的安全风险点提供充分的安全覆盖。声明称，安全安排还包括加强情报收集和提升应对能力，以应对新出现的威胁。警察局长CP Nnanna Ama据称已指示行动指挥官和人员履行职责时保持警惕、主动和职业。Ama还强调，安全行动必须尊重人权，并确保居民出行、商业经营及其他合法活动不受不必要干扰。指挥部告诫公众，尤其是社交媒体用户，不得发布煽动性内容、发表挑衅性言论或故意散布可能煽动暴力或威胁公共安宁的虚假信息。不过，指挥部也承认公民享有言论自由、和平集会和依法参与公共活动的宪法权利，并敦促个人和团体负责任地行使这些权利。Ikenga说：“警方将对行为构成刑事犯罪的人采取适当的合法措施，同时确保所有执法活动均以正当程序、职业操守和尊重宪法保障的权利为指导。”指挥部向居民、来访者和其他公众保证，将在既定活动期间持续提供安全环境。它敦促居民保持冷静，继续从事合法活动，并配合安全人员，同时将可疑动向、犯罪活动和新出现的威胁报告给最近的警察局，或通过既定紧急通信渠道报告。警方还呼吁传统 rulers、社区领袖、青年组织、公民社会团体和媒体从业者支持安全工作，推动负责任的传播、遏制错误信息并促进和平共处。蒂努布竞选集会由阿纳姆布拉州总统竞选委员会组织，该委员会由州长楚库马·索卢多担任主席，预计将吸引全尼日利亚进步大会党（APC）和全体进步大联盟（APGA）的支持者。集会以“进步人士携手合作”为核心信息。另一方面，奥比的市民大会会议是他2027年大选前在全国范围内开展政治活动的一部分。这位曾领导阿纳姆布拉州8年的前州长，如今仍是尼日利亚东南部的重要政治人物。随着各政党加紧为定于2027年1月16日举行的总统选举开展动员，预计这两场活动将吸引相当多的政治关注。此处表达的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

Unlock these with Subscription India and Canada could be announcing a defence agreement during Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s official visit in December, according to the country’s High Commissioner to Ottawa, Dinesh K. Patnaik. Both countries are also in the final stages of negotiations of a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. “We are on the cusp of finalising it,” Mr. Patnaik said. Addressing a gathering in the Canadian capital organised by the Centre for Strategic Statecraft and the Canadian International Council, he said that both countries cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their extensive mutual interests. Mr. Patnaik took over as India’s High Commissioner to Ottawa in September 2025. Both countries had earlier expelled each other’s High Commissioners and reduced their diplomatic presence following the murder of Sikh Khalistani activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in June 2023. Then Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused India of orchestrating the murder, throwing bilateral relations into a tailspin. Subsequent reports by Canadian agencies also listed India, alongside China and Russia, as an interferer in domestic politics. The turnaround in ties, which began with the mutual reinstatement of High Commissioners, is set to reach a milestone with Mr. Modi’s visit on December 11 and 12. Mr. Patnaik said India and Canada are no longer talking about a reset of their derailed relations, but rather an overarching boost in ties spanning defence, space, nuclear energy, deep tech, trade, and the mobility of people. The two nations have moved from a complete lack of trust over a year ago to an unprecedented degree of mutual trust, he added. “The fact is that in the core strategic concerns of Canada and India, there is no conflict. Still, all it took for the entire bilateral relationship to be derailed was the fringe diaspora issue,” he said, referring to the murder of Nijjar. “The reason was the lack of trust. India believed that Canada was actively promoting separatism in India, and Canada believed India was organising violence in Canada. We had a series of meetings between senior Ministers, NSAs of both countries, and agencies at all levels as we set about rebuilding trust. Today, we have reached the highest levels of trust, where the most sensitive areas of cooperation, such as deep tech, defence, and space, are subjects of mutual cooperation,” Mr. Patnaik said. Cooperation between Canadian and Indian agencies remains at a high level, the High Commissioner added. Unlock these with Subscription City-based start-ups have raised about $85 billion since 2010, 47% of all venture funding raised by Indian start-ups, with $76.5 billion of it in the past 10 years. This milestone was revealed in the Bengaluru Innovation Report 2026, released on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) by Karnataka’s Minister for Home, Electronics, IT & BT, Priyank M. Kharge, during the second day of the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026. Prepared by the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM) and 3one4 Capital, using Tracxn data, the report highlights the city’s evolution into a global deep-tech powerhouse. According to the findings, Bengaluru is unequivocally India’s Artificial Intelligence capital, commanding 36.3% of the country’s native AI start-up funding and housing 71% of India’s AI and deep-tech unicorns created since 2023. Out of 1,556 deep-tech startups founded in the city since 2010, 1,319 are active and funded, raising $3.77 billion. Women entrepreneurs are also driving this wave, with nearly 30% of India’s active, funded women-led deep-tech and AI start-ups originating in the city, raising $323.65 million. The city’s wealth creation metrics remain unmatched nationally. Bengaluru is now the world’s fifth-largest unicorn hub, and the largest outside the US, Europe, and China, with 57 unicorns valued at $211 billion, representing 55.3% of the combined value of all Indian unicorns. Further, as per the report, it leads the nation with 212 “soonicorns” (soon-to-be unicorns). Start-ups here scale faster than anywhere else in India, reaching unicorn status in six years and public exits in 8.2 years, beating the global exit average of 11.1 years. Since November 2024, 16 Bengaluru-linked companies have gone public with a combined listing value of $42 billion. Mr. Kharge emphasised on expanding this success across the State. “The Bengaluru Innovation Report 2026 shows how far Karnataka’s founders have come and how much more they can build from here. Our next task is to make sure a world-class AI, quantum or semiconductor company can grow just as well in Kalaburagi, Hubballi or Mangaluru. Deep tech rewards patience, and Karnataka will stay the course,’’ he stated. The State is backing this vision with aggressive regional initiatives, including the ₹1,000 crore Local Economy Accelerator Programme (LEAP), Global Technology Centres in Mysuru, Hubballi, and Belagavi, and the ELEVATE grant programme, which has already supported 1,479 start-ups across 30 districts. Highlighting the ecosystem’s investor appeal, KDEM chairman B.V. Naidu, a key architect of Karnataka’s IT industry, noted, “This report gives investors, GCCs and founders a data-backed view of what Karnataka, Bengaluru and our emerging clusters, offers.’’ Through the Beyond Bengaluru Mission, BLUE investor days and the Cluster Seed Fund, KDEM would keep connecting capital and companies with talent across the State, Mr. Naidu added. KEONICS chairman Sharath Bachegowda concluded that through continued investments in infrastructure and talent, the state aims to build an ecosystem where enterprises “can innovate, scale and compete globally”. Industry and government leaders echoed the shift toward homegrown capital, noting that 52% of Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) capital now comes from domestic investors. “With 36.3% of India’s native AI funding already in Bengaluru, the next decade belongs to founders building hard technology for the world from Karnataka,” opined Prashant Prakash, chairman of Karnataka’s Vision Group on Startups. Manjula N, secretary of the Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T said, the State’s focus is now on “converting early support into scale: government as a first customer, patient capital for deep tech, and research that moves from our laboratories into the market”. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.title: From Global Blacklist To International Recognition: Tinubu’s Unprecedented Aviation Transformation
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.summary: Nigeria’s aviation industry is undergoing one of the most remarkable transformations in its history, with the administration of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu recording unprecedented milestones in aviation safety, airport infrastructure, international relations, airline operations and the restoration of investor confidence.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.summary_zh: 尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）航空业正经历其历史上最显著的变革之一。总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布政府取得了一系列前所未有的成就，涵盖航空安全、机场基础设施、国际关系、航空公司运营以及重塑投资者信心等方面。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.body: 91.45% ICAO safety rating breaks all previous records; five international airports achieve full certification; $850m trapped airline funds cleared; Emirates returns; indigenous airlines empowered as massive infrastructure renewal takes off. Nigeria’s aviation industry is undergoing one of the most remarkable transformations in its history, with the administration of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu recording unprecedented milestones in aviation safety, airport infrastructure, international relations, airline operations and the restoration of investor confidence. What was once an industry struggling with international credibility, restricted access to aircraft financing, trapped foreign airline revenues, deteriorating infrastructure and regulatory deficiencies is gradually emerging as a more competitive and internationally respected aviation destination. The transformation is not merely reflected in government announcements or policy pronouncements. It is increasingly evident in measurable improvements in safety oversight, the return of major international airlines, renewed access to aircraft leasing markets, the expansion of indigenous carriers and substantial investments in airport infrastructure across the country. Perhaps the most compelling evidence of this turnaround is Nigeria’s historic 91.45 per cent Effective Implementation score in the International Civil Aviation Organisation’s (ICAO) safety oversight assessment conducted in April 2026. The achievement represents Nigeria’s highest aviation safety rating in history, placing the country significantly above the global average of 70.4 per cent and the West African regional average of 61.1 per cent. It is a remarkable departure from the approximately 70 per cent performance that had characterised previous assessments. For an industry where safety standards determine international confidence, investment decisions and operational credibility, the improvement represents a significant national achievement. The administration has also achieved full aerodrome certification of Nigeria’s five international airports in Lagos, Abuja, Kano, Port Harcourt and Enugu for the first time in the country’s history. These accomplishments demonstrate the impact of deliberate regulatory reforms, institutional strengthening and investments in modern aviation infrastructure. Beyond regulatory improvements, the Tinubu administration has embarked on an ambitious programme to modernise the country’s airport infrastructure. The flagship project is the comprehensive reconstruction and modernisation of Terminal 1 at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, with a Federal Government commitment of N712.3 billion. The project, which is more than 50 per cent complete as of November 2026, is designed to transform Nigeria’s busiest international gateway into a modern aviation facility capable of meeting contemporary international standards. The scope includes redesigned passenger movement systems, modern baggage handling facilities, a new overhead bridge and a skywalk connecting passengers to the departure halls of Terminals 1 and 2. Significantly, the project is being financed through the Renewed Hope Infrastructure Development Fund, using savings from subsidy reforms rather than new external borrowing. In Kano, N46 billion has been committed to the resurfacing of the runway at the Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport. The domestic terminal has also been completely remodelled, while a new Hajj terminal was commissioned in July 2026. The administration has equally supported the upgrading of the Muhammadu Buhari Airport in Maiduguri to full international status, including a new international terminal and facilities for immigration, customs and other relevant agencies. The Federal Government has also approved the development of a new international airport at Ubaha Nsulu in Abia State. These projects reflect an emerging national aviation network in which more states can participate meaningfully in international commerce, tourism, cargo transportation and investment. One of the most significant achievements of the Tinubu administration has been its success in addressing the crisis of trapped airline funds that threatened Nigeria’s international aviation relationships. At its peak in June 2023, foreign airlines had approximately $850 million in revenues trapped in Nigerian banks because of foreign exchange liquidity challenges. The situation was so serious that some international airlines suspended operations, while others threatened to withdraw from the Nigerian market. Through coordinated intervention by the Central Bank of Nigeria and the Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development, the backlog was substantially cleared by mid-2024. The International Air Transport Association subsequently acknowledged the progress, while Nigeria was removed from the list of countries with blocked airline funds. As of November 2026, Nigeria has emerged as Africa’s leading country in the repatriation of airline funds. Another significant diplomatic and aviation milestone was the return of Emirates Airlines to Nigeria on October 1, 2024, after suspending operations in 2022. The resumption followed high-level diplomatic engagements between Nigeria and the United Arab Emirates, culminating in a renewed bilateral aviation agreement. The return of Emirates restored an important international connection and demonstrated renewed confidence in Nigeria’s aviation market. For years, Nigerian airlines faced enormous difficulties accessing aircraft through international leasing arrangements. Nigeria’s poor compliance standing under the Cape Town Convention had placed the country on the Aviation Working Group’s non-compliance watchlist, making international lessors reluctant to expose their aircraft to the Nigerian market. The Tinubu administration addressed this challenge through legal and regulatory reforms, including the signing of a Practice Direction by the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court in 2024 and the operationalisation of the Irrevocable De-registration and Export Request Authorisation (IDERA). Consequently, Nigeria’s compliance score improved from 49.5 per cent to 75.5 per cent, leading to its removal from the Aviation Working Group’s watchlist. The practical benefit became evident when Air Peace secured a Boeing 737-700 NG on dry lease from AerCap, one of the world’s leading aircraft leasing companies. To consolidate this achievement, the Federal Executive Council approved the establishment of the Nigeria Aircraft Leasing Company in April 2026. The initiative, which is fully privately funded, is projected to unlock more than $1 billion in aircraft financing capacity for Nigerian airlines through a locally based special-purpose vehicle supported by limited government guarantees. This is a potentially transformative intervention for indigenous carriers that have historically paid significantly higher aircraft leasing costs than their international competitors. The administration has also demonstrated a clear commitment to strengthening Nigerian-owned airlines. Rather than proceeding with the controversial inherited national carrier arrangement involving Ethiopian Airlines, which faced significant legal challenges, the government discontinued the proposed structure and redirected attention towards supporting existing indigenous operators. Air Peace’s entry into the Lagos-London route in March 2024 was a significant demonstration of this policy direction. The airline subsequently expanded its London operations to include Abuja, with services to Heathrow and Gatwick following diplomatic engagements with the United Kingdom. Approval has also been secured for the proposed Owerri-Lagos-London and London-Owerri operations, further strengthening the international aviation prospects of the South-East. In April 2026, President Tinubu also approved a 30 per cent discount on outstanding debts owed by domestic airlines to aviation agencies, following concerns over rising aviation fuel costs and threats of operational shutdowns. These interventions, alongside engagements with major aircraft manufacturers including Boeing, Airbus, Embraer and Bombardier, are aimed at creating a more favourable operating environment for Nigerian carriers. Another major achievement is the resolution of the nearly two-decade dispute between the Federal Government and Bi-Courtney Aviation Services Limited over the operation of Murtala Muhammed Airport Terminal 2. The prolonged disagreement had denied the Federal Government expected revenue from the terminal for almost twenty years and created considerable uncertainty around the public-private partnership arrangement. Following approval by the Federal Executive Council in April 2026, a negotiated settlement was finally signed in October 2026. The resolution represents an important breakthrough in the management of aviation infrastructure and provides a clearer framework for investment and operational responsibilities. The administration has also moved to strengthen Nigeria’s aviation human capital through the commencement of full operations at the African Aviation and Aerospace University in Abuja. The institution is expected to develop specialised manpower in aviation management, engineering and regulatory studies, reducing the country’s dependence on expensive foreign training institutions. Similarly, the government’s policy requiring international airlines operating in Nigeria to source onboard meals for outbound flights from local caterers has created new opportunities for indigenous businesses. The impact is becoming visible in the expansion of local aviation catering companies, including the opening of a N10 billion catering facility in Abuja in October 2026. The administration has equally approved approximately N36 billion for the payment of pensions and severance benefits to more than 3,300 former employees of the defunct Nigeria Airways, with an initial N18 billion already released. This represents a long-awaited resolution of an outstanding obligation that had lingered for more than two decades. Perhaps one of the strongest indications of the country’s improved aviation standing is the growing international recognition of its leadership and regulatory achievements. The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, SAN, was named among Africa’s top four aviation figures by the International Air Transport Association in April 2026. He was also appointed Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the Banjul Accord Group, a regional aviation organisation promoting harmonised safety oversight and regulatory standards among West African countries. Furthermore, the African Development Bank appointed him champion of its $7 billion Integrated Aviation Transformation Programme for Africa, with Nigeria as a pilot country. Nigeria also hosted its first-ever International Airshow in December 2025, attracting international aircraft manufacturers, lessors, airlines and other aviation stakeholders. For a country that had previously struggled with international aircraft leasing restrictions, hosting such an event was a powerful demonstration of its renewed ambition and growing relevance in the global aviation community. Taken together, these developments represent a significant departure from the challenges that confronted Nigeria’s aviation industry in 2023. The record-breaking ICAO safety score, the certification of all five international airports, the return of Emirates, the clearance of trapped airline funds, improved aircraft leasing opportunities, support for indigenous carriers and the extensive airport modernisation programme constitute important milestones in the industry’s development.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.title_zh: 从全球黑名单到国际认可：蒂努布前所未有的航空业转型
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/f.body_zh: 尼日利亚国际民航组织安全评估得分91.45%，打破此前所有纪录；5座国际机场获得全面认证；8.5亿美元滞留航空资金获解冻；Emirates回归；在大规模基础设施焕新启动之际，本土航空公司获得赋能。尼日利亚航空业正经历其历史上最显著的转型之一。总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布政府在空中安全、机场基础设施、国际关系、航空公司运营以及恢复投资者信心等方面创下了前所未有的里程碑。这个行业曾经深陷国际信誉不佳、飞机融资渠道受限、外国航空公司收入滞留、基础设施恶化及监管缺陷等困境，如今正逐步发展成为更具竞争力且更受国际尊重的航空目的地。这一转型不仅体现在政府公告或政策声明中，也日益明显地反映在安全监管的可衡量改善、主要国际航空公司回归、飞机租赁市场重新开放、本土航空公司不断壮大，以及全国范围内对机场基础设施的大规模投资之中。或许最能证明这一扭转的有力证据，是尼日利亚在国际民航组织（ICAO）于2026年4月开展的安全监管评估中取得创纪录的91.45%有效实施得分。这一成绩使尼日利亚获得该国历史最高航空安全评级，明显高于全球平均的70.4%和西非地区平均的61.1%。相比此前历次评估约70%的表现，这一成绩实现了显著跃升。在安全标准决定国际信心、投资决策和运营信誉的行业中，这一改善代表着重大国家成就。尼日利亚政府还首次实现拉各斯、阿布贾、卡诺、哈科特港和埃努格5座国际机场全部获得机场全面认证。这些成就体现了有针对性的监管改革、机构能力强化以及现代航空基础设施投资所产生的成效。除监管改善外，蒂努布政府还启动了一项雄心勃勃的计划，推动全国机场基础设施现代化。旗舰项目是对拉各斯穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场1号航站楼进行全面重建和现代化改造，联邦政府承诺投入7123亿尼日利亚奈拉。截至2026年11月，该项目已完成逾50%，旨在将尼日利亚最繁忙的国际门户改造为符合当代国际标准的现代化航空设施。工程范围包括重新设计旅客流线系统、现代化行李处理设施、新建高架登机桥，以及连接1号和2号航站楼出发大厅的空中走廊。值得注意的是，该项目通过“复兴希望基础设施发展基金”融资，利用补贴改革节省的资金，而非新增外部借款。在卡诺，政府已投入460亿尼日利亚奈拉，对马利阿明·卡诺国际机场跑道进行重新铺装。国内航站楼也已全面改造，新的朝觐航站楼于2026年7月投入使用。政府还支持将迈杜古里的穆罕马杜·布加里机场升级为具备完整国际机场功能的机场，包括新建国际航站楼以及移民、海关和其他相关机构的设施。联邦政府还批准在阿比亚州Ubaha Nsulu建设一座新国际机场。这些项目反映出一个正在形成的全国航空网络，使更多州能够切实参与国际贸易、旅游、货物运输和投资。蒂努布政府最显著的成就之一，是成功化解了威胁尼日利亚国际航空关系的航空公司资金滞留危机。2023年6月达到峰值时，受外汇流动性困难影响，外国航空公司约有8.5亿美元收入被困在尼日利亚银行。局势一度十分严重，一些国际航空公司暂停运营，另一些则威胁撤出尼日利亚市场。经尼日利亚中央银行和航空与航天发展部协同干预，到2024年中期，大部分积压资金已获解冻。国际航空运输协会随后认可了这一进展，尼日利亚也被从存在航空公司资金冻结问题的国家名单中移除。截至2026年11月，尼日利亚已成为非洲航空公司资金汇回速度领先的国家。另一项重要的外交与航空里程碑，是Emirates Airlines于2022年暂停在尼日利亚运营后，于2024年10月1日回归。复航得益于尼日利亚与阿拉伯联合酋长国之间的高层外交磋商，并最终促成双边航空协议续签。Emirates回归恢复了一项重要的国际航线联系，也表明国际社会重新看好尼日利亚航空市场。多年来，尼日利亚航空公司通过国际租赁安排获得飞机面临巨大困难。尼日利亚在《开普敦公约》下的履约情况不佳，被列入航空工作小组的不合规观察名单，使国际出租方不愿将飞机投入尼日利亚市场。蒂努布政府通过法律和监管改革应对这一挑战，包括联邦高等法院首席法官于2024年签署《实践指示》，以及推动不可撤销注销和出口申请授权（IDERA）机制实际运行。结果，尼日利亚的履约得分从49.5%提升至75.5%，并被移出航空工作小组观察名单。当Air Peace从全球领先飞机租赁公司之一AerCap获得一架波音737-700 NG的干租时，这项措施的实际效益得到体现。为巩固这一成果，联邦执行委员会于2026年4月批准成立尼日利亚飞机租赁公司。该计划完全由私人出资，预计将通过一家设在当地的特殊目的载体，在政府有限担保的支持下，为尼日利亚航空公司释放逾10亿美元的飞机融资能力。对于历史上飞机租赁成本显著高于国际竞争对手的本土航空公司而言，这可能是一项具有变革意义的干预措施。政府还明确承诺 strengthening 尼日利亚自有航空公司。政府没有推进涉及Ethiopian Airlines且面临重大法律挑战的国有航空公司继承安排，而是终止了拟议架构，将重点转向支持现有本土运营商。Air Peace于2024年3月投入拉各斯—伦敦航线运营，成为这一政策方向的显著体现。该航空公司随后将伦敦业务扩展至阿布贾，并在与英国开展外交磋商后开通飞往希思罗和盖特威克的航班。拟运营的奥韦里—拉各斯—伦敦以及伦敦—奥韦里航线也已获批，进一步提升尼日利亚东南地区的国际航空前景。2026年4月，蒂努布总统还批准，国内航空公司欠航空相关机构的未偿债务可享受30%的折扣。此前各方担忧航空燃油成本上涨以及运营商面临停航威胁。相关措施连同与波音、空客、巴西航空工业公司和庞巴迪等主要飞机制造商的磋商，旨在为尼日利亚航空公司营造更有利的运营环境。另一项重大成就是，联邦政府与Bi-Courtney Aviation Services Limited围绕穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德机场2号航站楼运营的争议，在持续近20年后得到解决。长期分歧使联邦政府近20年来无法获得该航站楼预期收入，也令公私合作安排长期充满不确定性。经联邦执行委员会于2026年4月批准，双方终于在2026年10月签署协商解决方案。该结果代表航空基础设施管理取得的重要突破，并为投资和运营责任提供了更清晰的框架。政府还着手加强尼日利亚航空业人力资源建设，阿布贾非洲航空与航天大学已全面开始运营。该校预计将培养航空管理、工程和监管研究等领域的专业人才，减少国家对费用高昂的海外培训机构的依赖。同样，政府要求在尼日利亚运营的国际航空公司，其离境航班机上餐食必须从本地供应商采购，这项政策为本土企业创造了新机遇。相关影响已体现在本地航空餐饮企业的扩张上，其中一座价值100亿尼日利亚奈拉的餐饮设施于2026年10月在阿布贾启用。政府还批准约360亿尼日利亚奈拉，用于向已停业的Nigeria Airways超过3300名前员工支付养老金和离职补偿，首笔180亿尼日利亚奈拉已经发放。这项安排兑现了一项悬而未决逾20年的长期义务，或许最能体现尼日利亚航空业地位改善的，是其领导层和监管成就日益获得国际认可。2026年4月，国际航空运输协会将航空与航天发展部长Festus Keyamo SAN列入非洲四大航空人物。他还获任班朱尔协定组织部长理事会主席。该区域航空组织致力于推动西非国家协调安全监管和监管标准。非洲开发银行还任命他为该行面向非洲的70亿美元综合航空转型计划项目牵头人，尼日利亚将作为试点国家。2025年12月，尼日利亚首次举办国际航空展，吸引国际飞机制造商、飞机出租方、航空公司及其他航空业利益相关方参加。对于一个曾受国际飞机租赁限制困扰的国家而言，主办此类活动有力展示了其重振雄心和在全球航空界日益增强的影响力。这些进展总体表明，尼日利亚航空业已显著告别2023年所面临的种种挑战。创纪录的ICAO安全得分、5座国际机场全部获得认证、Emirates回归、滞留航空资金解冻、飞机租赁机会改善、对本土航空公司的支持，以及大规模机场现代化计划，共同构成该行业发展的重要里程碑。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111900.title: APEC 참가 정상들 전세·전용기…멕시코 대통령은 '이코노미'
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111900.summary: (멕시코시티=연합뉴스) 송광호 특파원 = 클라우디아 셰인바움(64) 멕시코 대통령이 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 참석하기 위해 민간 항공기의 이코노미 클래스 항공편을 이용한 사실이 알려지면서 국내외에서 화제를 모으고 있다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111900.summary_zh: （墨西哥城＝韩联社）随着韩国特派记者宋光浩披露，墨西哥总统Claudia Sheinbaum（64岁）事实上乘坐民航班机的经济舱赴中国宣传行程内举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议，此事在国内外引起关注。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111900.body: (멕시코시티=연합뉴스) 송광호 특파원 = 클라우디아 셰인바움(64) 멕시코 대통령이 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 참석하기 위해 민간 항공기의 이코노미 클래스 항공편을 이용한 사실이 알려지면서 국내외에서 화제를 모으고 있다. 18일(현지시간) AFP통신과 현지 언론에 따르면 각국 정상이 전세기나 전용기 등을 타고 선전에 집결한 것과는 달리 셰인바움 대통령은 멕시코시티에서 선전까지 중국남방항공의 이코노미석을 이용했다. 한 번에 가는 완전한 직항도, 단거리 여행도 아니다. 셰인바움 대통령이 탄 항공편은 멕시코 티후아나를 경유해 태평양을 건너 선전으로 향했다. 일반 상업 노선의 경우 비행시간만 20시간 가까이 걸린다. 셰인바움 대통령의 적잖은 나이를 감안하면 쉽지 않은 여정인 셈이다. 2024년 취임한 셰인바움은 이번에 처음으로 중국을 방문했다. 셰인바움 대통령은 탑승 전 영상메시지를 통해 "시차가 14시간이나 나기 때문에 도착하면 이틀 뒤가 되겠다"면서 미소를 지어 보였다. 방문단 규모도 크지 않았다. 마르셀로 에브라르드 경제장관을 비롯한 주요 각료들과 수행단원 몇몇만 단출하게 동행했다고 현지 언론은 전했다. 소탈한 모습도 눈길을 끌고 있다. 탑승 전 승객과 승무원들과 격의 없이 사진을 찍은 셰인바움 대통령은 기내에서도 승객들과 거리낌 없이 소통했다. 이 같은 모습이 중국 웨이보 등으로 확산하면서 관련 해시태그 조회수가 1천만회를 넘기는 등 큰 호응을 얻고 있다. 중국 누리꾼들은 "세금을 낭비하지 않는 검소한 지도자", "허례허식 없는 실용적인 지식인"이라며 찬사를 보내고 있다. 셰인바움 대통령의 이런 행보는 2023년 대통령 전용기를 매각하는 등 긴축 재정을 펼친 전임자 안드레스 마누엘 로페스 오브라도르 전 대통령의 기조를 충실히 이어받은 것으로 평가된다고 AFP는 전했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/19 02:09 송고 2026년11월19일 02시09분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111900.body_zh: （墨西哥城=韩联社）特派记者宋光浩=据报道，墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆（64岁）乘坐民航经济舱航班，前往中国宣传地举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议，此事在国内外引发关注。据18日（当地时间）法新社和当地媒体报道，与各国领导人乘坐专机或专用飞机陆续抵达宣传地不同，辛鲍姆总统从墨西哥城乘坐中国南方航空经济舱座位前往宣传地。这既不是一次抵达目的地的全程直航，也不是短途旅行。辛鲍姆总统乘坐的航班经墨西哥蒂华纳飞越太平洋，前往宣传地。普通商业航线的飞行时间就接近20小时。考虑到辛鲍姆总统年龄已高，这段行程并不轻松。辛鲍姆于2024年就任总统，这是她首次访问中国。辛鲍姆总统登机前通过视频致辞说：“时差相差14小时，到达时应该是后天吧”，并露出微笑。随行团规模也不大。当地媒体称，陪同的主要官员只有经济部长马塞洛·埃布拉德等数名要员及少数随行人员。辛鲍姆总统随和的形象同样引人注目。她登机前与乘客和机组人员亲切合影，在机舱内也与乘客轻松交流。这些画面在中国微博等平台传播开来，相关话题标签的浏览量突破1000万次，获得热烈反响。中国网民称赞她是“不浪费公款的勤俭领导者”和“不搞繁文缛节的务实知识型领导人”。法新社报道称，辛鲍姆总统的上述做法忠实延续了前任总统安德烈斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔的执政方针；前任总统曾通过出售2023年总统专机等方式推行紧缩财政。稿件可在KakaoTalk okjebo查阅。<版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布及用于AI学习和运用> 2026年11月19日02:09发布

In Philippines, that arguably equates to home-grown Jollibee, which has become synonymous to Filipino identity, especially abroad. That was apparently the train of thought of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. when United States President Donald Trump was in town for a brief state visit. In his opening remarks during his bilateral meeting with Trump on Wednesday, November 18, Marcos acknowledged the US leader’s tight schedule in the Philippines. Trump arrived late Tuesday afternoon, November 17, and headed straight to the Philippine International Convention Center to attend the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue meeting , the ASEAN-US Special Summit , and other meetings after the conclusion of the 49th ASEAN Summit. “Your schedule has been packed to the hilt, which is not exactly a surprise because we know how hard you work,” Marcos told Trump. The Philippine leader said this was why he decided to at least give Trump and his delegation a “taste of Manila” and had Jollibee snacks delivered to them. “Jollibee is a very very popular chain, and one of their main products is fried chicken, and we are very proud to say that we have surpassed KFC in the United States in terms of popularity,” Marcos said. “You have been working very hard, Mr. President….So just think of it as providing extra energy for all the work that you have to do, that you have done, and continue to do, and that is in front of you,” Marcos said. Diplomacy via Jollibee is nothing new. In July, Marcos and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney paid a visit to a Jollibee store in Vancouver following their bilateral meeting. The company is operating over 100 stores in North America and plans to reach 500 stores by 2030. (READ: How Jollibee became Filipino food’s biggest ambassador in the US ) In the recently concluded 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits, the Jollibee mascot, wearing a barong, made an appearance at the International Media Center , located at the World Trade Center in Pasay City on Tuesday. That’s days after Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese sampled Chickenjoy and announced that the food chain will also open its doors across New South Wales and Victoria . “Its establishment in Australia will answer the diaspora’s calls to make home-style Filipino dishes more accessible and provide an opportunity for Australians to experience Filipino cuisine and culture firsthand,” according to a news release from Albanese’s website.
