Unlock these with Subscription The initiative, announced on the second day of the 29th edition of Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre, is expected to connect innovators directly with State departments to solve public sector challenges. The State government on Wednesday awarded direct work orders to eight start-ups under its “Government First Initiative” to build technology solutions for the Praja Seva Department and the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB). The initiative, announced on the second day of the 29th edition of Bengaluru Tech Summit (BTS) 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC), is expected to connect innovators directly with State departments to solve public sector challenges. Under the programme, each winning start-up is eligible for a direct work order of up to ₹25 lakh. The total committed project value stands at ₹99.78 lakh (inclusive of GST) for the Praja Seva Department, while it is ₹1 crore for the BWSSB. According to the government, the winners emerged from a competitive pool of 150 applications submitted between October 8 and October 23, 2026, with the Praja Seva receiving 76 entries and the BWSSB receiving 74. The rigorous five-stage selection process included application submission, eligibility screening, selection committee evaluation, discussions with respective department officials, and final budget negotiations. The committee assessed start-ups on innovation, technical soundness, product readiness, scalability, and integration capability. Four start-ups were selected to modernise citizen services and administrative workflows for the Praja Seva Department and each was awarded ₹25 lakh. These include: SanMejora, to develop an AI-enabled grievance management and redressal system; VTT AI Private Limited, to create an AI-powered unified citizen call centre; Datafrontier Innovations Private Limited, to build an AI-enabled e-Office and unified officer workflow platform and Nife Apps Labs, to ensure the uptime and availability of citizen-facing government IT services. Responding to media queries, the Minister said other government departments might also come up with respective problem statements, allowing a large number of start-ups to develop solutions and work with the government. The Government First Initiative is a pioneering policy by the State government that makes the State the first customer for local start-ups developing technology-driven solutions to public sector and governance challenges. 这项倡议于2026年班加罗尔科技峰会第29届会议第二天在班加罗尔国际展览中心宣布，预计将让创新者与邦政府各部门直接对接，以解决公共部门面临的挑战。

邦政府于周三向8家初创企业直接授予工作订单，作为“Government First Initiative”的一部分，由这些企业为Praja Seva Department和Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board（BWSSB）开发技术解决方案。

这项倡议于2026年班加罗尔科技峰会（BTS）第29届会议第二天在班加罗尔国际展览中心（BIEC）宣布，预计将让创新者与邦政府各部门直接对接，以解决公共部门面临的挑战。根据该计划，每家获奖初创企业均可获得金额最高达₹25 lakh的直接工作订单。Praja Seva Department已承诺的项目总值约为₹99.78 lakh（含GST），BWSSB已承诺的项目总值为₹1 crore。

据政府介绍，获奖企业是从2026年10月8日至10月23日提交的150份申请中经竞争性筛选产生的，其中Praja Seva收到76份申请，BWSSB收到74份申请。严格开展的五阶段遴选流程包括提交申请、资格审查、遴选委员会评估、与相关部门官员讨论，以及最终预算谈判。委员会从创新性、技术可靠性、产品成熟度、可扩展性和系统集成能力等方面评估初创企业。

共有4家初创企业入选，负责为Praja Seva Department实现公民服务和行政工作流程现代化，每家企业均获得₹25 lakh。这些企业包括：SanMejora，负责开发一套由人工智能支持的申诉管理和处理系统；VTT AI Private Limited，负责打造由人工智能驱动的统一市民呼叫中心；Datafrontier Innovations Private Limited，负责构建由人工智能支持的电子办公和统一官员工作流程平台；Nife Apps Labs，负责确保面向公民的政府信息技术服务保持正常运行并可用。

部长在回应媒体询问时表示，其他政府部门也可能提出各自的难题，让大量初创企业开发解决方案并与政府合作。

Government First Initiative是邦政府推出的一项开创性政策，使邦政府成为本地初创企业的首位客户，支持它们开发以技术驱动的方案，应对公共部门和治理领域的挑战。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The government has sent a team to Myanmar to inspect the site of a Korean Air Lines (KAL) passenger jet crash in 1987 following a North Korean bombing, officials said Wednesday. The team, comprising officials from the foreign ministry and the Korea Coast Guard, as well as divers and vessel operators, left for Myanmar last week and is conducting an on-site inspection of waters believed to contain the wreckage of KAL Flight 858, according to government officials. Based on the findings, the government plans to assess the feasibility of recovering the wreckage and victims' remains, they added. It marks the first time the South Korean government has conducted an on-site investigation of the suspected crash site, despite previous private-sector efforts to access or investigate the area. The flight, en route from Baghdad to Seoul, exploded over waters near Myanmar on Nov. 29, 1987, killing all 115 passengers and crew members aboard. None of the 115 victims' remains have been recovered. South Korea's then state security agency concluded that two North Korean agents, including Kim Hyon-hui, carried out the bombing. A subsequent reinvestigation under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, completed in October 2007, upheld the conclusion, while the victims' families have continued to call for a full investigation, citing the lack of physical evidence beyond Kim's testimony. The mission follows years of consultations between South Korea and Myanmar, which began around 2019. Plans for the inspection were delayed amid political instability in Myanmar, including the 2021 military coup, the officials said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 官员周三表示，政府已派遣一个小组赴缅甸，调查1987年大韩航空（KAL）客机在朝鲜爆炸后坠毁的现场。该小组由外交部、韩国海岸警卫队以及潜水员和船舶作业人员组成，于上周前往缅甸，正在对据信沉有KAL 858号班机残骸的水域进行现场检查。政府官员称，政府将根据调查结果评估打捞残骸和遇难者遗骸的可行性。尽管此前私营部门曾尝试进入或调查该地区，这是韩国政府首次对疑似坠机现场进行实地调查。该航班于1987年11月29日从巴格达飞往首尔途中，在缅甸附近水域上空爆炸，机上115名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。遇难者遗骸至今无一被寻回。韩国时任国家安全机构认定，包括金贤惠在内的两名朝鲜特工实施了此次爆炸。鲁穆玄政府后来重新开展调查，并于2007年10月完成调查，维持了这一结论；遇难者家属则持续要求进行全面调查，理由是除了金的证词外缺乏其他物证。官员表示，此次行动是韩国与缅甸经过多年磋商后展开的，相关磋商始于2019年左右。由于缅甸政治局势不稳定，包括2021年军事政变在内，检查计划曾被推迟。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title: Seoul, Beijing agree on K-content's freer access to Chinese market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary: Korea will be granted most-favored-nation status in trade with China in the cultural sector, improving market access for Korean films, games and other cultural content. Beijing also agreed to apply nondiscrimination principles to preliminary reviews of online games, films and other content.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 在文化产业贸易中，韩国将获得中国给予的最惠国待遇，从而改善韩国电影、游戏及其他文化内容进入中国市场的机会。北京还同意在网络游戏、电影及其他内容的初步审查中适用非歧视原则。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Korea will be granted most-favored-nation status in trade with China in the cultural sector, improving market access for Korean films, games and other cultural content. On the sidelines of President Lee Jae Myung’s summit with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, Wednesday, the two countries announced the substantial conclusion of follow-up negotiations on services and investment under their bilateral free trade agreement (FTA). The Korea-China FTA took effect in December 2015, but subsequent negotiations on services and investment had remained unresolved despite 17 rounds of talks since March 2018. The negotiations gained momentum after the two leaders agreed during their summit in January to pursue meaningful progress in the follow-up talks within the year. Under the agreement, China pledged to grant most-favored-nation treatment in sectors including films and games, ensuring that Korean content providers receive treatment no less favorable than those from third countries. Beijing also agreed to apply nondiscrimination principles to preliminary reviews of online games, films and other content. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said this is the first time China has included such provisions in a trade agreement, raising expectations that Korean content producers will gain more stable access to the Chinese market. The two countries also agreed to an annex on co-producing audiovisual content, extending the domestic production status previously granted only to government-approved co-produced films to dramas, documentaries, animation and other audiovisual programs. China maintains quotas on imported films and television programs, including restrictions on the number of foreign films and the airtime allocated to overseas content. With the latest agreement, not only co-produced films but also jointly produced dramas, documentaries, animation and other audiovisual programs will be treated as domestic productions in both countries, allowing them to benefit from domestic content quotas rather than being subject to restrictions on foreign content. “The agreement will allow jointly produced content to qualify as domestic productions in both Korea and China,” an industry ministry official said. “This is expected to be one of the most practical benefits of the expanded co-production framework.” In the tourism sector, China agreed to allow Korean travel agencies operating in 23 designated regions of the country to offer outbound travel services to Chinese nationals and foreign residents living in China. The provision will enable Korean travel agencies to directly recruit Chinese group tourists and sell individual travel packages without relying on local intermediaries. The industry ministry said the agreement is expected to create new business opportunities for Korean travel agencies by allowing them to develop and sell travel packages featuring K-pop, beauty, food and regional attractions in Korea. In the legal sector, China agreed to expand the areas where Korean law firms can establish offices and collaborate with Chinese counterparts from the Shanghai Free Trade Zone (FTZ) to include the Tianjin and Qianhai FTZs. In the retail sector, Korean companies will be allowed to independently operate 30 or more stores in China without forming joint ventures with local partners, while restrictions on the types of construction projects Korean firms can undertake will be lifted. On investment protection, the two countries agreed to prohibit forced technology transfers as a condition of investment, and introduce rules preventing the reinstatement of regulations that have already been eased
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 首尔与北京同意让韩国内容更自由地进入中国市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh:
韩国将在文化领域获得中国给予的最惠国贸易待遇，从而改善韩国电影、游戏及其他文化内容进入中国市场的机会。周三，在中国深圳举行的李在明总统与中国国家主席习近平峰会的场边活动上，两国宣布，双方已基本完成《韩中自由贸易协定》框架下服务和投资后续谈判。

《韩中自由贸易协定》于2015年12月生效，但自2018年3月以来举行的17轮会谈均未能解决服务和投资领域的后续谈判问题。今年1月，两国领导人在峰会上同意推动年内后续谈判取得实质性进展，谈判由此加快。根据协议，中国承诺在电影和游戏等领域给予韩国最惠国待遇，确保韩国内容提供商获得的条件不逊于第三国内容提供商。北京还同意对网络游戏、电影及其他内容的预审适用非歧视原则。韩国产业通商资源部表示，这是中国首次在贸易协定中加入此类条款，预计韩国内容制作企业将获得更稳定的中国市场准入。

两国还同意就视听内容联合制作签署附件，将此前仅适用于政府批准的联合制作电影的境内制作资格扩大到电视剧、纪录片、动画片及其他视听节目。中国对进口电影和电视节目实行配额限制，包括限制外国电影数量以及分配给境外内容的播出时段。根据最新协议，不仅联合制作的电影，双方联合制作的电视剧、纪录片、动画片及其他视听节目将在两国均被视为境内制作作品，从而可以享受境内内容配额，而不受外国内容限制。韩国产业通商资源部官员表示：“该协议将使联合制作内容在韩国和中国均具备境内制作资格。这预计将成为扩大联合制作框架带来的最切实成果之一。”

在旅游领域，中国同意允许在中国23个指定地区运营的韩国旅行社向中国公民和居住在中国的外国居民提供出境旅游服务。该条款将允许韩国旅行社直接招揽中国团体游客，并销售个人旅游套餐，而无需依赖当地中介机构。韩国产业通商资源部表示，通过允许韩国旅行社开发和销售以韩国流行音乐、美妆、美食及地方景点为主题的旅游套餐，该协议预计将为韩国旅行社创造新的商业机会。

在法律服务领域，中国同意扩大韩国律师事务所设立办公室并与中国同行开展合作的范围，在上海自由贸易区之外，将天津自由贸易区和前海自由贸易区纳入其中。

在零售领域，韩国企业将获准在中国独立运营30家或更多门店，无需与当地合作伙伴成立合资企业，同时，针对韩国企业可承接的建设项目类型的限制也将取消。

在投资保护方面，两国同意禁止将强制技术转让作为投资条件，并引入相关规则，防止重新实施已经放宽的规定

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea, US discuss facilitating joint all-domain operations at high-level military meeting
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Top military officers of Korea and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on Wednesday discussed efforts to facilitate combined operations across all domains, with a focus on smooth intelligence sharing, the allies' Combined Forces Command (CFC) said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国和驻韩美军（USFK）的最高军事将领周三讨论了推动各领域联合行动的努力，重点是确保情报顺畅共享。盟军联合司令部（CFC）表示。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Top military officers of Korea and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on Wednesday discussed efforts to facilitate combined operations across all domains, with a focus on smooth intelligence sharing, the allies' Combined Forces Command (CFC) said. The South's Joint Chief of Staff Chairman Gen. Jin Yong-sung co-led the meeting with USFK Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson, who doubles as the CFC commander, for discussions on how the combined forces can work together to advance the strategy, known as combined joint all-domain operations (CJADO), the CFC said in a release. CJADO refers to a U.S. military concept to synchronize combat capabilities across land, air, sea, space and cyberspace into a single, networked force with allies like Korea. The topic featured on the agenda for the latest regular high-level strategy and coordination meeting on how the combined forces can better see, decide and act together in real time during modern warfare. At Wednesday's meeting, Jin stressed the need to ensure faster decision-making than the enemy through swift intelligence sharing from across every domain, according to the CFC's release. "Chairman Jin called for advancing command-and-control systems powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and cutting-edge science and technology, while ensuring interoperability through close Korea-U.S. coordination," the CFC said. Noting the importance of "speed" as a key factor that makes the difference on the Korean Peninsula, Brunson called for continuing to push forward with "attribute-based access control"(ABAC) so as to ensure data reaches the right place at the right time, according to the CFC. ABAC refers to a U.S. cybersecurity and data-sharing system that automatically shares sensitive battlefield data based on the user's clearance, role and mission, rather than manual approvals. The CJADO concept has gained traction here after Brunson repeatedly highlighted the need to advance its implementation. He recently made the point at a public event in September, calling for breaking away from the silos-oriented warfare structure and taking tangible steps to adapt to the changing modern warfare. To integrate force capabilities with international allies, how to create a combined network for information sharing and decision-making is regarded as key to CJADO implementation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国与美国在高层军事会议上讨论推动联合全领域行动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国和驻韩美军（USFK）最高军事将领周三讨论了促进各领域联合行动的努力，重点是顺畅共享情报。盟军联合司令部（CFC）表示，韩国联合参谋长会议议长金永成将军与兼任CFC司令的驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军共同主持了会议，讨论联合部队如何协同推进被称为“联合全域联合作战”（CJADO）的战略。CFC在一份声明中表示，CJADO是指美国军事概念，即将与韩国等盟国的陆、海、空、天和网络空间作战能力同步整合为一支互联一体的力量。在最新一次定期举行的高级战略与协调会议上，各方讨论了现代战争期间联合部队如何更好地实时协同感知、决策和行动，该议题被列入会议议程。据CFC的声明，在周三的会议上，金强调，需要通过快速共享各个领域的情报，确保决策速度超过敌人。CFC称：“金议长呼吁推进由人工智能（AI）和尖端科学技术驱动的指挥控制系统，同时通过韩美密切协调确保互操作性。”据CFC介绍，布伦森强调“速度”是决定朝鲜半岛局势成败的关键因素之一，并呼吁继续推进“基于属性的访问控制”（ABAC），确保数据能够在正确的时间送达正确的地点。ABAC是一套美国网络安全与数据共享系统，可根据用户的权限、角色和任务自动共享敏感战场数据，而无需人工审批。在布伦森反复强调推进CJADO落实之后，这一概念在韩国逐渐受到关注。他最近曾在9月举行的一场公开活动中指出，应摆脱以孤立体系为导向的战争结构，并采取切实措施适应不断变化的现代战争。为了与国际盟军整合作战能力，如何建立信息共享和决策综合网络被视为落实CJADO的关键。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 大邱市长朱京浩于周三获判无罪。检方指控他在2024年末担任当时执政的国民力量党（PPP）院内leader时，曾阻挠国民议会投票解除前总统尹锡悦的戒严令。2024年12月3日，尹锡悦宣布戒严后，朱京浩试图阻止议员参加终结紧急状态的议会投票。当时，PPP的108名议员中有90人无法参加解除戒严令的投票。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho was acquitted Wednesday of charges of obstructing a National Assembly vote to lift former President Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law declaration in late 2024, when he was the floor leader of the then ruling People Power Party (PPP). The Seoul Central District Court delivered the verdict in the case against Choo, who stood trial on charges of playing a key role in Yoon's alleged insurrection. Choo was accused of changing the venue of an emergency party meeting three times on Dec. 3, 2024, after Yoon declared martial law, in an attempt to prevent lawmakers from taking part in a parliamentary vote on ending the emergency decree. Of the 108 PPP lawmakers, 90 were unable to attend the vote to lift the martial law at the time. Special counsel Cho Eun-suk's team had requested a 20-year prison term for Choo. Choo, however, maintained his innocence, saying he had no prior knowledge of the martial law imposition and had received no request from Yoon to block the National Assembly vote. The court said it was difficult to conclude that Yoon had asked the defendant to block the vote to lift martial law. Even if Yoon had made such a request, the evidence presented by the special counsel was insufficient to establish that the defendant had agreed to it, the court noted
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 大邱市长妨碍戒严案投票指控获判无罪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 大邱市长秋庆镐周三被宣告无罪，罪名是妨碍国民议会就解除前总统尹锡悦于2024年末发布的戒严令进行表决。当时他是执政的国民力量党（PPP）院内leader。首尔中央地方法院对秋庆镐案作出判决，他受审的罪名包括在尹锡悦涉嫌发动叛乱中发挥关键作用。检方指控，2024年12月3日尹锡悦宣布戒严后，秋庆镐三度更改紧急党内会议地点，试图阻止议员参加终止紧急状态法令的议会表决。当时国民力量党108名议员中有90人无法参加解除戒严的表决。特别顾问赵恩淑团队请求法院判处秋庆镐20年监禁。不过，秋庆镐坚持自己无罪，称他事先并不知道戒严的实施，也未收到尹锡悦提出的阻止国民议会表决的要求。法院表示，很难认定尹锡悦曾要求被告阻止解除戒严的表决。法院指出，即使尹锡悦确曾提出这一要求，特别顾问提交的证据仍不足以证明被告曾同意该要求。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-s.body: Layer 1 American political strategist and media personality, Diana London, has deleted a series of posts detailing her engagement with the Nigerian government and the security cooperation between Nigeria and the United States. The posts, which were no longer available on her X account as of Wednesday morning, included photographs of her at the Presidential Villa in Abuja, where she was seen with President Bola Tinubu and his Chief of Staff, Femi Gbajabiamila. In another post, London described the security partnership between Nigeria and the US as one that was “delivering results”, crediting the relationship between Tinubu and US President Donald Trump. “The U.S.-Nigeria security partnership is delivering results. Peace through strength. None of this happens without the ongoing partnership between President Trump and President Tinubu, their steadfast commitment to eliminating terrorists, and Nigeria’s willingness to work closely with the U.S. government,” she wrote. “Because of the success of their partnership and relationship, the economic and trade opportunities are endless. The best is yet to come. Nigeria is the United States’ greatest ally in Africa,” London stated. In a separate post, she expressed appreciation for the opportunity to work with people representing Nigeria, particularly on efforts to protect religious groups and strengthen relations between the two governments. “It has been an honour to work on the team of people representing Nigeria and helping to protect religious groups and further the relationship between the Trump administration and the Nigerian government,” she wrote. The reason for their deletion was not immediately known, as London had not publicly explained the move as of the time of filing this report. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Edo State House of Assembly has mourned the death of a 12-year-old boy in a gas explosion at Agbado Market, calling for regulatory guidelines to prevent further incidents. The member representing Oredo West State Constituency, Richard Edosa, raised the matter as one of urgent public importance during Monday’s plenary in Benin. Mr Edosa said the explosion injured several others, drawing attention to the dangers associated with gas-related activities. He called for regulatory measures to prevent a recurrence. Other lawmakers who contributed to the debate sympathised with the victims’ families. The Speaker, Yekini Idaiye, expressed condolences to the affected families and urged residents to observe safety precautions. Meanwhile, the House passed a bill seeking to establish the Edo Agency for Education Quality and Accountability. The proposed agency is expected to strengthen quality assurance and maintain educational standards across the state. The bill passed after the Committee of the Whole considered it, and the House took it to a third reading. The Majority Leader, Sunday Ojezele, moved the motion for the House to resolve into the Committee of the Whole to consider the bill. Following its consideration, the House reverted to plenary and passed the bill. Mr Idaiye subsequently directed the clerk to transmit a clean copy of the bill to Governor Monday Okpebholo for assent. In a related development, the House received a message from Governor Okpebholo seeking confirmation of Abbas Suleiman as the state’s auditor-general. Mr Idaiye referred the nomination to the Committee on Rules, Business and Government House for consideration and directed it to report back to the House within two weeks. Meanwhile, consideration of three other bills was deferred to a later date. They include a bill seeking to prohibit unauthorised removal and vandalism of metal structures, fittings and public infrastructure, while regulating scrap metal dealers. Others seek to repeal the Edo State Traditional Medicine Board Law, 2026, and the Edo State Roads Funds Board Law, 2025. The proposed roads fund legislation seeks to establish the Edo State Roads Fund and Board. It is also intended to provide funding for managing, planning, rehabilitating, constructing, reconstructing and maintaining Class C and D roads. The proposed fund will also support the rehabilitation of Class B roads across the state. The House subsequently adjourned sitting until 7 December, 2026

Unlock these with Subscription The actual signing of the India-U.S. trade will still “take some time”, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), adding that the negotiation part and the legal text will be completed soon. The delay in signing, he said, was because it can be done only after the U.S. concludes its Section 301 investigations into its trade partners and finalises its tariff structure. A few days ago, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal asserted that the U.S. has acknowledged that India will receive lower tariffs as compared to its competitors. “This is a deal that has been announced in February, the contours have already been announced as part of the joint statement,” Mr. Agrawal said while speaking at the curtain raiser of the FICCI Annual General Meeting. “The legal agreement has also been negotiated and it is now in final stages and it will be concluded soon.” He was referring to the joint statement between India and the U.S. in February that announced the framework of an interim deal on trade. Also Read | 100% U.S. tariff threat: Can India’s new trade deals reduce its dependence on America? However, Mr. Agrawal explained that the “challenge” is that this framework was announced against the background of the executive tariffs system that the U.S. President Donald Trump had put in place. At the time, the tariff on India was 50%. Later in February, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down the legal foundation of these tariffs. “Now a new tariff architecture is being created by the U.S.,” Mr. Agrawal explained. “So until that tariff architecture comes back in place, the signing of a deal is something that I think will take some time. But concluding the negotiations and having everything ready will be something that we will strive to achieve as soon as possible.” In particular, Mr. Agrawal spoke about the investigations undertaken by the American administration under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. One of these investigations, regarding forced labour, has been completed and a tariff of 10% has been levied on imports from India. The second investigation, looking into excess capacity, is yet to be completed and could come with further tariffs. “There are certain 301 investigations which are already under review,” Mr. Agrawal said. “Those will also be coming to the fore in the next few weeks or months. You can’t have a deal until you have got uncertainty around multiple investigations which are already there.” Also Read | Rubio says India-U.S. trade deal close, urges New Delhi to boost U.S. energy, defence buys Separately, without mentioning the U.S. or any other country, Mr. Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than engaging in a spirit of compromise. “Negotiations are always, to my mind, the art of what is possible,” the Commerce Secretary said. “You try to bring it together and keep it in a mutual win-win position because each party wants to go from the table as a victor and wants to showcase to its people that they have got something good for their business.” As such, he explained that most agreements are not perfect, but instead involve an even trade-off where parties have simultaneously minimized their risk and also taken advantage of what they can. “I think if both sides engage positively with that intent, it’s easy to do agreements,” Mr. Agrawal said. “But if there’s an intent to maximise benefits on any side, the negotiations will carry on for years.” “We need to be patient,” he asserted. “We need to be very clear in what we want and we need to be very clear on what we can give. https://www.thehindu.com/business/econom.body_zh: 订阅可享受《Premium Stories》《Editorials》《Opinions》等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度—美国贸易协定的实际签署仍“需要一些时间”，商务部长拉杰什·阿格拉瓦尔周三（2026年11月18日）表示，并补充说，谈判部分和法律文本将很快完成。他说，签署延迟是因为只有在美国完成针对其贸易伙伴的《贸易法》第301条调查并确定关税结构后才能签署。几天前，商务部长皮尤什·戈亚尔断言，美国已经承认，与竞争对手相比，印度将获得更低的关税。阿格拉瓦尔先生在印度工商联合会年会开幕活动上发言时表示：“这项协议已于2月宣布，框架也已作为联合声明的一部分公布。法律协议也已完成谈判，目前处于最后阶段，很快就会敲定。”他指的是印度和美国2月发表的联合声明，该声明确立了一项临时贸易协议框架。另请阅读｜美国威胁加征100%关税：印度新贸易协议能否降低其对美国的依赖？不过，阿格拉瓦尔先生解释道，“挑战”在于，这项框架是在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已经建立行政关税制度的背景下公布的。当时，对印度征收的关税为50%。2月下旬，美国最高法院推翻了这些关税的法律依据。阿格拉瓦尔先生解释道：“美国正在建立一套新的关税架构。因此，在新的关税架构重新实施之前，我认为签署协议还需要一些时间。但完成谈判并做好各项准备，是我们会争取尽早实现的目标。”阿格拉瓦尔先生尤其谈到了美国政府依据1974年《贸易法》第301条开展的调查。其中一项有关强迫劳动的调查已经完成，美国已对从印度进口的商品征收10%的关税。第二项关于产能过剩的调查尚未完成，可能还会带来额外关税。阿格拉瓦尔先生说：“目前有一些301调查仍在审查中。未来几周或几个月，这些调查也将逐渐浮出水面。在围绕多项调查的不确定性消除之前，你无法达成协议。”另请阅读｜鲁比奥称印美贸易协议接近达成，敦促新德里增加对美能源和国防采购。另外，阿格拉瓦尔先生没有提及美国或其他任何国家，而是断言，当各方试图最大化自身利益，而不是本着妥协精神参与时，贸易协议可能需要很长时间才能敲定。商务部长说：“在我看来，谈判始终是在可能与不可能之间寻找平衡的艺术。你要努力把各方凝聚在一起，使协议保持互利共赢的局面，因为每一方都想以胜利者的身份离开谈判桌，也想向本国人民展示自己为 businesses 争取到了有利成果。”因此，他解释道，大多数协议并不完美，而是基于对等的利益交换，各方在降低自身风险的同时，也充分利用能够获得的条件。阿格拉瓦尔先生说：“我认为，如果双方都本着这一目的积极参与，达成协议并不困难。但如果任何一方都意图最大化自身利益，谈判就会持续多年。”他断言：“我们需要保持耐心。我们必须非常清楚自己想要什么，也必须非常清楚能够给予什么。我认为，这样我们就一定能达成协议。”另请阅读｜在竞争对手国家受到调查并被加征关税前，印美贸易协议不太可能达成。经济／经济（综合）／贸易协议／美国／印度—美国／国际关系。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区准则发布评论。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章讨论。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以查看以前的评论，评论平台为Vuukle。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111818.summary: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 아시아태평양 지역의 경제협력과 세계 주요국 정상외교 무대인 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의가 18일 중국 광둥성 선전에서 본격적인 일정에 들어갔다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 시 주석은 이날 오전 선전 첸하이 국제회의센터에서 열린 APEC CEO 서밋 개막식 기조연설에서 "개방은 진보를 가져오고 폐쇄는 필연적으로 낙후를 초래한다"며 자유롭고 개방적인 무역과 투자를 지지해야 한다고 강조했다. 앤서니 앨버니지 호주 총리는 "우리는 APEC 파트너들과 협력해 AI의 기회를 포착하고 이 지역의 번영을 강화할 준비가 돼 있다"고 말했고, 안와르 아브라힘 말레이시아 총리는 중국을 포함한 모든 당사국과 협력해 평화와 번영을 증진하기 위해 노력할 것이라고 강조했다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111818.body: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 아시아태평양 지역의 경제협력과 세계 주요국 정상외교 무대인 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의가 18일 중국 광둥성 선전에서 본격적인 일정에 들어갔다. 한국을 비롯해 중국과 러시아 등 주요국 정상들은 이날 최고경영자(CEO) 서밋에 참석해 자유무역, 공급망 안정, 인공지능(AI) 협력 등을 강조하며 역내 경제협력 확대를 촉구했다. 정상 간 양자회담도 잇따라 열린 가운데 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령도 선전에 도착하면서 19일 예정된 사상 첫 미중러 3자 정상회담을 앞두고 외교전도 본격화했다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 시 주석은 이날 오전 선전 첸하이 국제회의센터에서 열린 APEC CEO 서밋 개막식 기조연설에서 "개방은 진보를 가져오고 폐쇄는 필연적으로 낙후를 초래한다"며 자유롭고 개방적인 무역과 투자를 지지해야 한다고 강조했다. 이어 "현재 국제정세는 변화와 혼란이 뒤얽혀 있고 세계 경제 성장 동력은 부족하며 일방주의와 보호주의가 극성을 부리고 있다"며 세계무역기구(WTO)를 중심으로 한 다자무역체제 수호를 촉구했다. 시 주석은 중국이 시장 개방을 가속하는 한편 디지털경제와 AI, 친환경·저탄소 전환 분야의 국제협력을 심화하겠다고 밝혔다. 또 선전·홍콩·마카오를 연결하는 웨강아오 대만구(大灣區)처럼 만(灣)을 중심으로 형성된 경제권 간 교류를 확대하기 위해 '세계 만 지역 경제협력 연맹' 창설을 지지한다는 구상도 제시했다. 로이터통신은 시 주석의 연설이 미국의 첨단 반도체 수출통제 강화 등으로 미중 갈등이 이어지는 상황에서 나왔다고 전했다. 이 대통령은 "국제사회가 함께 공급망의 위험을 조기에 파악할 시스템을 구축하고 핵심 광물과 에너지의 안정적 수급을 위해 노력해야 한다"고 말했다. 푸틴 대통령은 러시아가 국제사회의 고립 시도를 극복하고 예상보다 빠르게 성장하고 있다며 "경험을 나눌 준비가 돼 있다"고 말했다. 앤서니 앨버니지 호주 총리는 "우리는 APEC 파트너들과 협력해 AI의 기회를 포착하고 이 지역의 번영을 강화할 준비가 돼 있다"고 말했고, 안와르 아브라힘 말레이시아 총리는 중국을 포함한 모든 당사국과 협력해 평화와 번영을 증진하기 위해 노력할 것이라고 강조했다. 이 대통령과 시 주석은 이날 오전 정상회담을 하고 경제협력 확대, 한반도 정세, 문화 교류 등 양국 현안을 논의했다. 이 대통령은 "한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상의 타결 선언을 계기로 양국 기업들의 상호 진출이 더욱 활발해지도록 함께 노력하자"고 제안했다. 시 주석도 "중한 양국이 정치적 신뢰를 공고히 하는 가운데 호혜적 경제협력을 확대해 나가야 한다"고 화답했다. 이 대통령은 한반도 긴장 완화를 위한 중국의 건설적 역할을 요청했고, 시 주석은 북미대화 등 한반도 긴장 완화를 위한 다양한 노력을 지지한다는 입장을 밝혔다. 시 주석은 중러 관계가 혼란스러운 국제정세 속에서 안정성과 확실성을 제공하고 있다고 평가했고, 푸틴 대통령은 무역·에너지·교육 등 분야의 협력을 확대하고 세계 다극화를 함께 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 시 주석은 공항에 직접 나가 트럼프 대통령을 영접하고 전용기에서 내린 트럼프 대통령과 악수하고 포옹을 나누며 각별한 예우를 보였다. 지난 9월 시 주석의 미국 방문 당시 트럼프 대통령 부부가 공항에서 직접 영접한 데 이어 이번에는 시 주석이 트럼프 대통령을 공항에서 맞이한 것이다. 시 주석이 2013년 국가주석에 취임한 이후 외국 정상을 공항에서 직접 맞이한 것은 이번이 처음인 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령은 19일 시 주석과 양자회담을 갖고 무역갈등과 첨단기술 수출통제 등을 논의한 뒤 푸틴 대통령이 합류하는 사상 첫 미중러 3자 정상회담에 참석할 예정이다. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111818.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）韩种求特派记者＝作为亚太地区经济合作以及世界主要领导人外交舞台的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议18日在中国广东省深圳正式进入议程。包括韩国、中国和俄罗斯等主要国家的领导人当天出席首席执行官（CEO）峰会，强调自由贸易、供应链稳定、人工智能（AI）合作等，并呼吁扩大地区经济合作。领导人之间的双边会谈也接连举行，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达深圳，19日预定举行的美中俄三国领导人首次三方领导人会谈外交活动也正式展开。据中国官方的新华社报道，习近平主席当天上午在深圳国际会议中心举行的APEC CEO峰会开幕式发表主题演讲时表示：“开放带来进步，封闭必然落后”，强调应支持自由开放的贸易和投资。他接着说：“当前国际局势变化与混乱交织，世界经济增长动力不足，单边主义和保护主义愈演愈烈”，呼吁以世界贸易组织（WTO）为核心维护多边贸易体制。习近平主席表示，中国将加快扩大市场开放，同时深化数字经济、人工智能以及绿色低碳转型领域的国际合作。他还提出，支持成立“世界湾区地区经济合作联盟”，扩大深圳、香港、澳门相连的粤港澳大湾区（湾区）等以“湾”为中心形成的经济区域之间的交流。路透社报道称，习近平主席的讲话是在美中矛盾持续之际发表的，美国正加强对先进半导体的出口管制。特朗普总统表示：“国际社会应共同建立尽早识别供应链风险的系统，并为关键矿物和能源的稳定供应而努力。”普京总统表示，俄罗斯正在克服国际社会孤立的企图，并正以超出预期的速度增长，“已准备好分享经验”。澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示：“我们准备与APEC伙伴合作，把握人工智能机遇，增强本地区的繁荣。”马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣强调，将努力与包括中国在内的所有各方合作，促进和平与繁荣。特朗普总统与习近平主席当天上午举行领导人会谈，讨论扩大经济合作、朝鲜半岛局势、文化交流等两国议题。特朗普总统提议：“我们要以中韩自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判达成协议为契机，共同努力推动两国企业更加活跃地相互进入对方市场。”习近平主席回应说：“中韩两国应在政治互信不断增强的同时扩大互利经济合作。”特朗普总统请求中国为缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势发挥建设性作用，习近平主席则表示，支持包括朝美对话在内的 various 努力，以缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势。习近平主席评价说，在国际局势混乱之际，中俄关系为世界提供稳定性和确定性；普京总统表示，将扩大贸易、能源、教育等领域的合作，并共同推动世界多极化。习近平主席亲赴机场迎接特朗普总统，与走下专机的特朗普总统握手并拥抱，给予了特别礼遇。此前9月习近平主席访问美国时，特朗普总统夫妇曾亲赴机场迎接；此次则由习近平主席在机场迎接特朗普总统。据悉，这是习近平主席自2013年出任国家主席以来首次在机场亲自迎接外国领导人。特朗普总统定于19日与习近平主席举行双边会谈，讨论贸易争端、先进技术出口管制等议题，随后出席普京总统加入的史上首次美中俄三国领导人三方会谈。CEO峰会会场深圳国际会议中心周边也配合主要领导人的行程，暂时全面封锁车辆和行人通行。此次APEC领导人非正式会议继2001年上海和2014年北京之后，中国时隔12年第三次举办，会议将于19日上午以“建设亚太共同体、促进共同繁荣”为主题举行全体会议，正式进入全面磋商阶段。报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载或再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用。2026/11/18 20:36发布，2026年11月18日20时36分发布

https://leadership.ng/tinubu-gets-commen.summary_zh: Tinubu在Haliru Abdu Township Stadium举行集会后向记者发表声明称，这位传统头衔持有者表示，总统的访问证明了联邦政府对发展凯比州的承诺。Dogaro将批准Tsamiya内陆旱港形容为释放凯比州商业、农业及跨境贸易潜力的一项重要举措。
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-gets-commen.body: Dogaro also praised the President for what he described as a successful campaign visit to Birnin Kebbi on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. In a statement issued to journalists after Tinubu’s rally at the Haliru Abdu Township Stadium, the traditional title holder said the President’s visit demonstrated the Federal Government’s commitment to the development of Kebbi State. He attributed the large turnout at the rally to the people’s appreciation of the administration’s policies and developmental initiatives. Dogaro described the approval of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port as a major step towards unlocking Kebbi State’s commercial, agricultural and cross-border trade potential. He said the project would attract local and foreign investments while creating thousands of direct and indirect employment opportunities, particularly for young people. The traditional title holder also expressed appreciation for Tinubu’s assurances on critical road infrastructure, particularly the Kalgo-Bunza corridor and roads linking neighbouring border communities. He said the President had also pledged to consider the broader infrastructure demands presented by Kebbi State Governor, Nasir Idris. Dogaro further commended the President’s commitment to addressing economic and social challenges through interventions aimed at improving food affordability, increasing farmers’ incomes, expanding access to quality education and upgrading healthcare facilities. He urged traditional institutions, community leaders, youths and other residents of Kebbi State to support the Tinubu administration and the state government in their efforts to promote peace and economic development. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Lee asks Xi's 'constructive role' over Korean Peninsula issues
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: SHENZHEN, China — President Lee Jae Myung asked China to play a constructive role on the issues facing the Korean Peninsula during a summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping Wednesday, underscoring that its peace and stability are key to building a more mature partnership between Seoul and Beijing.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 中国深圳——周三举行首脑会谈期间，韩国总统李在明请求中国在朝鲜半岛所面临的问题上发挥建设性作用，并强调朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定，是首尔与北京建立更成熟伙伴关系的关键。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — President Lee Jae Myung asked China to play a constructive role on the issues facing the Korean Peninsula during a summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping Wednesday, underscoring that its peace and stability are key to building a more mature partnership between Seoul and Beijing. In response, Xi voiced support for all efforts to ease tensions on the peninsula, including dialogue between the United States and North Korea, according to Cheong Wa Dae. Their talks on the North Korea issue took place on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. “Lee stressed that issues concerning the peninsula are of vital interest to South Korea and that his government has actively sought to ease inter-Korean tensions and achieve peaceful coexistence,” National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said in a written briefing after the summit. “He asked China to play a constructive role on peninsula issues. And Xi acknowledged Seoul’s efforts and said China would continue to play a constructive role in resolving those issues,” he added. Wi explained that Xi briefed Lee on recent developments in China-North Korea relations and expressed support for efforts to reduce tensions on the Korean Peninsula, citing dialogue between Pyongyang and Washington as one example. Lee and Xi’s remarks came as security in Northeast Asia draws renewed attention ahead of the first three-way summit among U.S. President Donald Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the APEC sidelines on Thursday. The North Korea issue is said to be on the agenda for their talks, although neither Seoul nor Pyongyang is part of the meeting. Trump, who expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his Asia tour, is keeping the door open even though no progress on talks has been reported yet. He said whether Kim comes to Shenzhen is “up to President Xi,” calling on Xi to play a mediator role. Lee himself also expressed his hope for Xi to play a role in resolving North Korea issues during their earlier summit in January. It was the third summit between Lee and Xi. They first met on the sidelines of the APEC leaders’ meeting in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, in October 2025 and held their second summit in January during Lee’s state visit to Beijing. Looking ahead to the 35th anniversary of diplomatic ties, the two nations concluded negotiations on services and investment under a bilateral free trade agreement, Wi said. Negotiations for the sectors began in 2018 and Seoul and Beijing virtually reached agreements for this summit, with only minor documentation issues remaining. “The president noted that conclusion would lay the groundwork for more balanced and mutually beneficial economic cooperation,” Wi said. Lee also urged South Korea and China to capitalize on next year’s milestone by building on the progress the two leaders have made over the past year. “I hope we can work together to make this milestone a new driving force for the development of our bilateral ties,” he told Xi. Lee cited a nearly 50 percent year-on-year increase in bilateral trade in the first half of 2026 and said travel between the two countries was expected to surpass 10 million trips this year for the first time since 2019. He also called for expanding cultural and people-to-people exchanges, citing the possibility of bringing pandas to Korea as a way to foster goodwill. Xi pointed to the 35th anniversary as an opportunity to put relations on a steadier footing. “Both sides will use this opportunity to reflect on our experience, plan for the future together and promote the healthy and stable development of China-South Korea relations so that our people can benefit more,” Xi said. He stressed that China will work with South Korea to strengthen communication and coordination, keep global trade and supply chains stable and running smoothly, and work more closely together to build a system of global governance
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 李在明请求习近平在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥“建设性作用”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 中国深圳——李在明总统周三在中国国家主席习近平举行的一次峰会期间，呼吁中国在朝鲜半岛面临的问题上发挥建设性作用，强调朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定是首尔与北京建立更成熟伙伴关系的关键。 据青瓦台消息，习近平对此表示支持为缓解半岛紧张局势而作出的各项努力，包括美国与朝鲜之间的对话。 双方有关朝鲜半岛问题的会谈是在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）经济领导人会议期间进行的。 韩国国家安全 Adviser Wi Sung-lac在峰会后的书面情况说明中说：“李总统强调，有关半岛的问题关系到韩国的重大利益，其政府一直积极寻求缓解朝韩紧张局势、实现和平共处。”“他请中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。习近平对首尔方面作出的努力予以肯定，并表示中国将继续在解决这些问题方面发挥建设性作用。” 他补充说。 Wi表示，习近平向李在明介绍了近期中朝关系的发展情况，并表示支持为降低朝鲜半岛紧张局势而作出的努力，同时以平壤与华盛顿之间的对话为例。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于周四在APEC会议期间举行首次三方峰会之际，李在明和习近平的上述表态正值东北亚安全局势再次受到关注之际。 据称，朝鲜半岛问题在他们的会谈议程之列，尽管首尔和平壤均不是这次会议的参与方。 特朗普在亚洲之行期间表达了会见朝鲜领导人金正恩的兴趣，尽管目前尚未报道会谈取得进展，但他仍为接触保留着大门。 他表示，金正恩是否来到深圳“取决于习近平主席”，并呼吁习近平发挥斡旋作用。 实际上，李在明在今年1月两人早些时候举行的峰会上，也希望习近平在解决朝鲜半岛问题上发挥作用。 这是李在明与习近平之间的第三次峰会。 两人于2025年10月在庆尚北道京畿举行的APEC领导人会议期间首次会面，并在李在明今年1月对北京进行国事访问期间举行了第二次峰会。 Wi表示，展望两国建交35周年，双方已经完成双边自由贸易协定下服务和投资领域的谈判。 这些领域的谈判始于2018年，首尔与北京实际上已为本次峰会达成协议，仅剩少量文件处理问题。 Wi说：“总统指出，达成协议将为更加平衡和互利的经济合作奠定基础。” 李在明还敦促韩国和中国把握明年的里程碑，在两国领导人过去一年取得进展的基础上继续前行。 他对习近平说：“我希望我们能够携手合作，把这一里程碑变成推动我们双边关系发展的新动力。” 李在明提到，2026年上半年双边贸易额同比增长近50%，并称预计今年两国人员往来将首次突破1000万人次，这是自2019年以来的首次。 他还呼吁扩大文化和民间交流，并提到可以将大熊猫引入韩国，以促进友好关系。 习近平指出，35周年是推动两国关系走上更稳健发展轨道的机会。 习近平说：“双方将利用这一机会总结经验、共同规划未来，推动中韩关系健康稳定发展，让两国人民从中获得更多实惠。” 他强调，中国将同韩国加强沟通协调，保持全球贸易和供应链稳定畅通，并更加紧密地合作，共同构建全球治理体系

https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.title: Nigeria’s Care Economy To Generate 17m Jobs, $9.3bn GDP
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.summary: The government said expanding access to universal childcare and closing the country’s care gaps would unlock significant economic opportunities, particularly for women, who account for between 57 and 67 per cent of the projected jobs.
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.summary_zh: 政府表示，扩大普及托育服务并弥合该国的照护服务缺口，将释放重要的经济机会，尤其是对女性而言，因为女性预计将占新增就业岗位的57%至67%。
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.body: The government said expanding access to universal childcare and closing the country’s care gaps would unlock significant economic opportunities, particularly for women, who account for between 57 and 67 per cent of the projected jobs. Speaking at the National Care Forum, themed, ‘Advancing Nigeria’s Care Economy: Jobs, Growth & Productivity’, held on Tuesday in Lagos, the Director of Child Development, Federal Ministry of Women Affairs, Mr. Ali Madugu, who represented the Minister, Hajia Iman Sulaiman-Ibrahim, disclosed that the Federal Executive Council (FEC) approved the National Care Policy and Implementation Plan 2026-2030 on October 28. He said the policy was designed to address the country’s care deficit, create employment opportunities and improve women’s participation in the economy. Madugu added that every $1 invested in childcare could generate $3 in economic returns. Earlier, the Head of Office, Nigeria, International Finance Corporation (IFC), Mr. Christian Mulamula, said Nigeria could unlock up to $22.9 billion in annual GDP by closing its gender gap in care. Describing care as economic infrastructure rather than merely a family responsibility, Mulamula said Nigerian women spend approximately three times as much time on unpaid care work as men, a situation that pushes many out of the workforce. He said about 67 per cent of working parents believed they would be more productive if they had better access to quality childcare. “How do we build a care economy that works for our children, for our families, for our businesses, and for Nigeria’s growth?” he asked. He said investment in quality early childhood programmes could yield returns of up to 13 per cent annually and raise Nigeria’s total factor productivity by as much as two per cent. According to him, 92 per cent of childcare facilities in Nigeria are small and independently owned, while 76 per cent of childcare entrepreneurs lack access to formal financing. Representing the Lagos State Governor, Babajide Sanwo-Olu, the Commissioner for Finance, Mr. Abayomi Oluyomi, said the state had identified care as a priority under its Women Economic Empowerment Policy Roadmap and was developing an investment-oriented care policy framework. He said the state government was working towards building a care economy where families could access reliable and affordable services, care providers could operate viable businesses, and workers in the sector could earn decent livelihoods. Oluyomi, however, warned that government funding alone would not be sufficient to meet the growing demand for care services. Citing Lagos State’s infrastructure financing gap of over N10 trillion against a budget of N4.4 trillion, he said the government needed to establish appropriate regulations, standards and an enabling business environment to attract private investors while ensuring affordability. Also speaking, the Director, Special Duties, Federal Ministry of Budget and Economic Planning, Dr. Gloria Ahmed, said care must be integrated into national and state development plans and budgets. She stressed the need for clear responsibilities, effective coordination and accountability to ensure that the National Care Policy did not become another well-articulated policy without adequate funding. On workforce development and professional standards, the Director, National Board for Technical Education (NBTE), Engineer Sulaiman Yusuf, said the care sector must move beyond its largely informal structure. He disclosed that Nigeria had developed National Occupational Standards for childcare workers, adding that more than 4,500 caregivers, 90 per cent of them women, were already undergoing training. Yusuf called for the establishment of a strong sectoral body to professionalise the workforce without excluding existing informal care workers. Similarly, the UN Women Representative, Ms. Beatrice Eyong, said while unpaid care work was largely undertaken by women, the paid care economy remained dominated by men, with women-led care businesses facing informality and limited access to finance. She called for the provision of labour-saving devices for rural women, improved financial inclusion for women entrepreneurs and greater involvement of men in sharing household care responsibilities. https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.title_zh: 尼日利亚护理经济将创造1700万个就业岗位，并带来93亿美元国内生产总值
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.body_zh: 政府表示，扩大普及型托育服务的可及性并弥合全国照护服务缺口，将释放重要的经济机会，尤其有利于女性，因为预计新增岗位中有57%至67%将由女性承担。联邦妇女事务部儿童发展主任阿里·马杜古先生周二在拉各斯举行的全国照护论坛上发言。该论坛主题为“推进尼日利亚照护经济：就业、增长与生产力”。马杜古代表部长哈贾·伊曼·苏莱曼-易卜拉欣出席活动，并透露，联邦执行委员会已于10月28日批准《2026—2030年国家照护政策及实施计划》。他说，该政策旨在应对全国照护服务短缺、创造就业机会并提高女性参与经济活动的程度。马杜古补充说，每投入1美元用于托育服务，就可能带来3美元的经济回报。尼日利亚国际金融公司驻尼日利亚办公室负责人克里斯蒂安·穆拉穆拉先生此前表示，通过弥合照护领域的性别差距，尼日利亚每年可释放高达229亿美元的经济增加值。穆拉穆拉将照护服务视为经济基础设施，而非仅仅是家庭责任。他表示，尼日利亚女性在无偿照护劳动上花费的时间约为男性的三倍，这导致许多人退出劳动力市场。他说，约67%的在职父母认为，如果能更好地获得优质托育服务，他们的工作效率会更高。他问道：“我们如何建设一个对我们的孩子、家庭、企业以及尼日利亚增长都行之有效的照护经济？”他说，对优质幼儿教育项目进行投资，每年可带来高达13%的回报，并可使尼日利亚的全要素生产率提高最多2%。据他介绍，尼日利亚92%的托育服务机构规模较小且由个人独立经营，76%的托育创业者无法获得正规融资。拉各斯州州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢的代理人、财政专员阿巴约米·奥卢约米先生表示，该州已在《妇女经济赋权政策路线图》中将照护服务列为优先事项，并正在制定以投资为导向的照护政策框架。他说，州政府正努力建设照护经济，使家庭能够获得可靠且负担得起的服务，使照护服务提供者能够经营可持续的业务，并使该行业从业者获得体面的生计。然而，奥卢约米警告，仅靠政府资金不足以满足不断增长的照护服务需求。他援引数据称，拉各斯州基础设施融资缺口超过10万亿奈拉，而州预算为4.4万亿奈拉，因此政府需要制定适当的法规、标准并营造有利的商业环境，以吸引私人投资者，同时确保服务价格可负担。联邦预算与经济规划部特别事务主任格洛丽亚·艾哈迈德博士也发言说，必须将照护服务纳入国家和各州的发展计划及预算。她强调，需要明确责任、有效协调和问责机制，确保《国家照护政策》不会成为又一项表述完善却缺乏充足资金支持的政策。在劳动力发展和专业标准方面，国家技术教育委员会主任苏莱曼·优素福工程师表示，照护行业必须摆脱目前以非正规经营为主的结构。他透露，尼日利亚已经制定了托育服务人员国家职业标准，目前已有4,500多名照护人员接受培训，其中90%为女性。优素福呼吁建立强有力的行业机构，以推动 workforce 专业化，同时不排斥现有的非正规照护人员。联合国妇女署代表比阿特丽斯·埃永女士同样表示，虽然无偿照护劳动主要由女性承担，但有偿照护经济仍由男性主导，女性经营的照护企业面临非正规经营和融资渠道有限的问题。她呼吁为农村女性提供省力设备，改善女性创业者的金融普惠，并推动男性更多分担家庭照护责任。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《领导力新闻》WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取更新 →

MANILA, Philippines – US President Donald Trump on Wednesday, November 18, announced what he described as “the biggest trade deal” between the Philippines and the United States during the final activity of his brief state visit to Manila. Trump disclosed this in his remarks at the state luncheon in his honor in Malacañang Palace following his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr ., but gave no details about the deal. “We’ve just consummated a trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made by far and it’s a fair deal for both countries. We’re very happy with it. We didn’t know that was going to take place but it took place very quickly. It’s a magnificent deal for both,” Trump said. “So today, under the leadership of President Marcos and myself, I’m proud to say that we’re making the alliance between the United States and the Philippines much stronger than it’s ever been before, especially with the consummation of this deal,” he added. Marcos’ office later said both sides reached an understanding on areas of economic cooperation, but made no mention of a trade deal. Trade representatives of both countries will work closely to translate the commitments into concrete initiatives, it said in a statement. “I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different trade deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark, and, in particular, a deal that will be great for our farmers and those in the business of ‘energy,'” Trump said on Truth Social after his Philippine visit, but gave no further details. Negotiations on a trade deal between the two allies were not mentioned in any schedules released by either country. “The US offered for us to diversify our food supply and energy requirements,” said Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez. Asked whether anything was signed, Romualdez said in a text message, “None.” Trump said in his remarks at the start of his bilateral meeting with Marcos that the US is expanding its defense cooperation with the Philippines. The Philippines and the US are treaty allies through the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty, the core of their ties, signed years after Washington recognized Manila’s independence. The treaty covers possible attacks in the South China Sea . In December 2025, the US Congress passed the Philippines Enhance Resilience Act , which authorizes allocating $500 million annually in foreign military financing to the Philippines, totaling $2.5 billion by 2030. Trump also signaled that the US wants deepened collaboration in energy security, particularly nuclear energy. He added that the US may do “something very big” in the civilian nuclear industry. “And for the Philippines to embrace American technology in its first modern nuclear project would underscore the strength of the important relationship,” he said. In February, the US announced several initiatives to help the Philippines in integrating nuclear power into its energy mix by 2032. This was two years after the enforcement of a landmark civil nuclear cooperation agreement between the two countries in 2024. (READ: A nuclear Philippines in six years? OECD’s nuclear chief isn’t convinced. ) While the Philippines and the US have been strong allies, this alliance was tested during the administration of Marcos’ predecessor, Rodrigo Duterte, who sought a pivot to China, but this foreign policy direction had since been reset under Marcos. The years that followed saw an increase in the intensity of military training exercises, as well as the frequency of joint sails in the West Philippine Sea, including near areas that China claims or de-facto controls. 菲律宾马尼拉——11月18日星期三，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在结束对马尼拉短暂国事访问的最后一项活动期间宣布，他所称为菲律宾与美国之间“最大贸易协议”的协议。特朗普是在马拉坎南宫举行的以其名义举行的国事午宴上，在与总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 举行双边会谈后透露这一消息的，但没有透露协议细节。 特朗普说：“我们刚刚完成了一项贸易协议，这是我们迄今达成过的最大贸易协议，而且对双方都是公平的协议。我们对此非常满意。我们事先不知道会达成协议，但协议推进得很快。这对双方来说都是一项极其出色的协议。” 他补充道：“因此，今天，在马科斯总统和我本人的领导下，我感到自豪地说，随着这项协议的达成，我们正在把美国与菲律宾之间的联盟关系加强到前所未有的程度。” 马科斯办公室后来表示，双方在经济合作领域达成了共识，但未提及贸易协议。办公室在一份声明中说，两国贸易代表将密切合作，把各项承诺转化为具体举措。 特朗普结束对菲律宾的访问后在Truth Social上表示：“我高兴地宣布，我们与菲律宾达成了一项全新且完全不同的贸易协议。这将是一项真正的里程碑，尤其是一项对农民以及能源行业从业者大有裨益的协议。”但他没有透露进一步细节。 两国作为盟友就贸易协议开展的谈判，并未出现在任一国家发布的任何日程安排中。 菲律宾驻美国大使何塞·曼努埃尔·罗穆亚尔德斯说：“美国提出要帮助我们实现食品供应和能源需求多元化。”当被问及是否签署了任何文件时，罗穆亚尔德斯在短信中回答：“没有。” 特朗普在与马科斯双边会谈开始时表示，美国正在扩大与菲律宾的防务合作。根据1951年《共同防御条约》，菲律宾与美国是条约盟友。该条约是两国关系的核心，签署时间是在华盛顿承认马尼拉独立多年之后。条约涵盖南海可能发生的袭击。 2025年12月，美国国会通过《菲律宾增强韧性法案》，授权每年向菲律宾拨款5亿美元的外军融资，到2030年累计将达到25亿美元。 特朗普还暗示，美国希望加强在能源安全、尤其是核能领域的合作。他补充称，美国可能在民用核工业领域采取“非常重大的行动”。 他说：“菲律宾在其首个现代核项目中采用美国技术，将凸显这一重要关系的 strength。” 2月，美国宣布多项举措，帮助菲律宾到2032年将核能纳入其能源结构。这是两国于2024年实施一项具有里程碑意义的民用核能合作协议两年后公布的。 （阅读：菲律宾六年后会拥有核能吗？OECD核能负责人并不确信。） 尽管菲律宾与美国一直是Strong盟友，但这段联盟关系在马科斯的前任罗德里戈·杜特尔特执政期间曾受到考验。杜特尔特曾寻求转向中国，但此后这一外交政策方向在马科斯任内得到重新调整。 此后的几年里，军演强度有所提升，在西菲律宾海举行联合巡航的频率也有所增加，其中包括靠近中国声称拥有或实际控制的海域。 加载相关话题 https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Army academy will be relocated to the central Chungcheong region, while the Navy and Air Force academies will be kept in place, the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the government said Wednesday, revising an earlier plan to merge them into a unified military college. To do so, the Korea Military Academy — the Army college — will move out of Seoul and be relocated to a site in the central-western region of Chungcheong.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 执政的朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）和政府周三表示，陆军士官学校将迁至忠清中部地区，海军和空军士官学校则维持原址不变，并修订了此前将三校合并为统一军事学院的计划。为此，陆军士官学校韩国陆军士官学校将迁出首尔，迁至忠清中部西部地区的校址。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Army academy will be relocated to the central Chungcheong region, while the Navy and Air Force academies will be kept in place, the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the government said Wednesday, revising an earlier plan to merge them into a unified military college. The revised plan retains the initial proposal to establish a joint academy at the Jaundae military complex in the central city of Daejeon, about 140 kilometers south of Seoul, but each armed service will keep their existing schools as a regional campus. To do so, the Korea Military Academy — the Army college — will move out of Seoul and be relocated to a site in the central-western region of Chungcheong. The Navy Academy and the Air Force Academy will stay in their current locations -- in the southern coastal county of Jinhae and the central provincial city of Cheongju, respectively. "For specialized training during the second and third years, it is more efficient to keep the Navy and Air Force academies at their current locations, but we needed to find a new location for the Army academy," Rep. Kim Byung-joo told reporters after a policy coordination meeting between party and government officials. The exact relocation site for the Army academy in the Chungcheong region has yet to be decided, Kim added. The revised plan will adopt a so-called 1-2-1 model, where cadets complete shared coursework in their first and final years at the joint military academy and spend their second and third years for branch-specific training at their respective schools. The revision also includes a plan to establish a new graduate school for master's and doctoral courses at the main campus to offer a path for in-depth military education, the defense ministry said in release. The government plans to apply the new system to cadets entering in 2029, with each military branch continuing to recruit cadets separately until then to minimize confusion. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul expressed his commitment to establishing the combined academy to nurture creative talent capable of breaking away from conventional educational frameworks. "By having Army, Navy and Air Force cadets train together and unite as a single warrior community, we will foster them into key leaders of our military capable of prevailing on any battlefield," Kang said during the meeting. Kang also stressed the need to set a "clear and bold direction," while reviewing the implementation process in a "thorough and prudent" manner. The new military academy will operate directly under the ministry, unlike the existing academies that fall under each individual armed service, the ministry said, citing the need for a "consistent and balanced" management and oversight in budget and other related policies. The revised plan marks a retreat from an initial July proposal to merge the three service academies into a single institution inside the Jaundae compound and close down the existing schools. Amid growing opposition to the plan, Kang, a retired Army general, had signaled an adjustment to the initial framework, highlighting that the move is not aimed at abolishing the three academies. Alumni groups have denounced the planned integration as an attempt to weaken the core identity and capabilities of each military branch. Army college graduates, in particular, have argued that it was a politically driven move by the Lee Jae Myung administration to curb the Army's influence over its involvement in past military coups and the short-lived martial law attempt by former President Yoon Suk Yeol in 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 执政党和政府公布修订后的方案，将陆军士官学校迁往忠清地区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）和政府周三表示，将把陆军士官学校迁至忠清中部地区，海军和空军士官学校则维持原址，并修改此前将三校合并为统一军校的方案。修订后的方案保留了在位于大田市中心的驻在台军事基地设立联合学校的最初提议；大田位于首尔以南约140公里，但各军种仍将以地区分校区形式保留现有学校。为此，韩国陆军士官学校将迁出首尔，迁至忠清中西部的某个地点。海军士官学校和空军士官学校将分别继续设在南部沿海的镇海和忠清道的省会清州。执政党与政府官员举行政策协调会议后，议员金炳周对记者说：“二、三年级进行专业训练时，让海军和空军士官学校留在现址更为高效，但我们需要为陆军士官学校寻找新地点。”金补充说，陆军士官学校迁往忠清地区的具体地点尚未确定。修订后的方案将采用所谓的“1-2-1模式”：学员在联合军校完成第一学年和最后一学年的共同课程，第二和第三学年则分别在各自学校接受军种专业训练。国防部在一份声明中说，修订方案还包括在主校区设立新的研究生院，开设硕士和博士课程，为深入军事教育提供途径。政府计划从2029年入学的学员开始实施新制度，在此之前，各军种将继续分别招收学员，以尽量减少混乱。国防部长姜善淳表示，他致力于建立综合性军校，培养能够摆脱传统教育框架的创新型人才。姜在会上说：“让陆军、海军和空军学员共同训练，并团结为一个统一的武士共同体，我们将把他们培养成能够在任何战场上取得胜利的军队中坚领导力量。”他还强调，需要确立“明确而大胆的方向”，并以“全面而审慎”的方式审查实施过程。国防部表示，与现有士官学校分别隶属于各军种不同，新军校将由国防部直接管辖；国防部称，此举是为了确保预算及其他相关政策得到“一致且均衡”的管理和监督。修订后的方案意味着放弃7月最初提出的方案，即把三所军种士官学校合并为驻在台园区内的一所机构，并关闭现有学校。随着反对该计划的呼声日益高涨，退役陆军上将姜善淳曾表示将调整最初框架，强调此举并非旨在废除三所士官学校。校友团体谴责拟议中的整合是企图削弱各军种的核心认同和能力。陆军士官学校毕业生尤其认为，这是李在明政府出于政治目的推动的动作，意在遏制陆军的影响力，尤其是其与过去军事政变以及前总统尹锡悦2024年短暂戒严尝试之间的关联。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — President Lee Jae Myung held bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Wednesday, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ meeting. It is their third summit since Lee took office in June 2025, with two previous meetings in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province in November 2025 and Beijing in January. The leaders will review progress in bilateral relations and discuss ways to expand mutually beneficial economic cooperation, including trade and investment, presidential spokesperson Kim Sung-wan said in a written briefing issued ahead of the meeting. Attention is also on whether Lee and Xi will discuss possible U.S.-North Korea talks, as U.S. President Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and referred to a possible role for Xi. With an upcoming U.S.-China-Russia summit drawing international attention, Lee’s message on Northeast Asian security will also be closely watched given South Korea’s direct stake in the region

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 中国深圳——韩国总统李在明于周三在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议期间，与中国国家主席习近平举行了双边会谈。这是李在明自2025年6月就任以来，两国领导人举行的第三次峰会。此前双方曾于2025年11月在庆尚北道庆州会面，并于今年1月在北京会面。总统发言人金成范在会前发布的书面简报中说，两国领导人将回顾双边关系进展，并讨论扩大互利经济合作的方式，包括贸易和投资。人们还将关注李在明和习近平是否会讨论美朝对话的可能性，因为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次提及与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面的前景，并表示习近平可能发挥一定作用。随着美中俄峰会临近，国际社会高度关注，李在明就东北亚安全发表的讲话也将受到密切审视，因为韩国在该地区利益攸关。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook asked for people's understanding Wednesday in connection with disaster alert messages that the government plans to send as part of efforts to prevent cheating during the nationwide college entrance exam this week.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩成淑总理周三请求民众予以理解。政府计划在本周全国大学入学考试期间发送灾害警报信息，以防止考试作弊。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook asked for people's understanding Wednesday in connection with disaster alert messages that the government plans to send as part of efforts to prevent cheating during the nationwide college entrance exam this week. Alert messages for the highest level of disasters, which are designed to reach all mobile phones and sound a loud alarm even when the phone is muted, will be sent to detect any hidden mobile phones that can be used to cheat with artificial intelligence (AI) during the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) on Thursday. "We recognize that receiving these messages may cause some inconvenience," Han said during a meeting with the ruling Democratic Party of Korea and the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae. "However, we once again ask for your kind understanding as this is an unavoidable step taken to ensure that our children can take the exam under fair conditions." She vowed again to make utmost efforts to make sure the exam goes fairly. "Even though concerns are high over whether measures to prevent cheating will be effective and if they might only end up heightening anxiety among students, the government, the ruling party and the presidential office will put forth our best efforts to alleviate the worries of honest students and their parents," Han said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首相呼吁民众理解大学入学考试期间发送的警报信息
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总理韩升洙周三就政府计划在本周全国大学入学考试期间发送灾害警报信息一事，请求民众予以理解。这是政府为防止作弊而采取的措施之一。最高级别灾害警报信息将发送至所有手机，即使手机处于静音状态，也会发出响亮警报。此举旨在发现周四大学修学能力试验期间可用于借助人工智能作弊的隐藏手机。韩升洙在同执政的韩国民主党和总统府青瓦台举行的会议上说：“我们认识到，接收这些信息可能会给民众带来一些不便。”“不过，我们再次恳请大家予以体谅，因为这是确保我们的孩子们能在公平条件下参加考试而必须采取的一步。”她再次承诺将尽最大努力确保考试公平进行。韩升洙说：“尽管外界非常担忧防作弊措施是否有效，以及这些措施是否会徒增学生的焦虑，政府、执政党和总统府将尽最大努力，缓解诚信考生及其家长的担忧。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/doll.body: Layer 1 The Nigerian naira opened trading on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, under sustained demand pressure across both the official Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market (NFEM) and the parallel market, with the gap between the two segments widening further. At the official window, data published by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) shows that the naira closed the previous session on Tuesday, November 17, at a volume-weighted NFEM rate of ₦1,358.09 per dollar. During Tuesday’s official trading session, the local currency opened at ₦1,355.80 per dollar and fluctuated between an intraday high of ₦1,354.00 and a low of ₦1,364.50 before settling at ₦1,363.00 at the close. Meanwhile, live international interbank spot tracking early Wednesday morning hovered around ₦1,351.25 per dollar. In the parallel market, commonly referred to as the black market, the naira traded significantly weaker. Street dealers and Bureau de Change (BDC) operators in Lagos and Abuja quoted the US dollar at an average of ₦1,440 per dollar early Wednesday morning, with buying and selling rates ranging between ₦1,435 and ₦1,445 per dollar. Based on the latest official NFEM rate of ₦1,358.09 and the parallel market average of ₦1,440.00, the spread between the official and unofficial markets currently stands at approximately ₦81.91 per dollar. Market analysts note that the persistent divergence between both windows reflects heightened seasonal import demand, corporate foreign exchange obligations, and a slowdown in autonomous dollar inflows. Recent market intelligence indicates that while Nigeria’s external reserves slipped slightly by roughly $390 million from their late-October peak of $55.26 billion due to central bank market interventions, the reserve buffer remains over 26 percent higher than the $43.54 billion recorded during the same period in 2025. Financial analysts expect the Central Bank of Nigeria to maintain liquidity support in the official NFEM window to keep official rates anchored near the ₦1,350 to ₦1,365 band, even as retail and unfulfilled demand continues to exert upward pressure on parallel market quotes. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's science ministry advised companies Wednesday to carry out emergency security checks and update their systems after vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used Java programming language. The vulnerabilities found in OpenJDK, an open-source implementation of the Java Platform, could allow malicious actors to execute malware on affected systems, the Ministry of Science and ICT said. Oracle Corp., the company that maintains Java, said it is preparing to release security patches for 11 vulnerabilities, which it evaluates at a CVSS 3.1 severity score of 8.1, the second-highest in its four-tier system. Java is widely used to develop Android applications, banking systems, cloud services and other software. It is also frequently used in the government information systems, with more than 71 percent of such programs created with the Java language as of the end of 2025, according to government data. The latest discovery follows two security vulnerabilities found late last month in PHP, another widely used programming language. Java is more widely used than PHP, raising concerns about the potential impact of the newly discovered vulnerabilities

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 中国日益严重的电动汽车产能过剩，正促使其汽车制造商赴韩国寻找新的增长空间，因为激烈的国内竞争和欧洲更严格的贸易壁垒压缩了其扩张选择。中国汽车制造商不再仅仅把韩国视为出口成车的市场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: China’s mounting electric vehicle (EV) overcapacity is driving its automakers to Korea in search of new growth, as fierce domestic competition and tougher trade barriers in Europe narrow their options for expansion. Chinese automakers are no longer treating Korea simply as a market for exporting finished vehicles. BYD, Zeekr and XPeng are strengthening their local operations and hiring Korean executives with experience at established foreign automakers — in a push to turn Korea into a more permanent overseas market. The shift comes as China’s EV industry faces fierce price competition and a crowded domestic market, leaving automakers under growing pressure to find additional demand abroad. Europe, once a key destination for Chinese EVs, has also become more difficult to penetrate due to higher tariffs and tighter regulatory scrutiny. Against this backdrop, Korea’s mature automotive market and growing EV demand make it an increasingly attractive destination for Chinese automakers looking to expand overseas. BYD Korea has seen its sales surge since launching its passenger vehicle business early last year. It appointed Cho In-chul, a former head of Mini Korea's passenger vehicle business, to lead its passenger vehicle operations. The Chinese EV maker has since seen robust sales growth due to its price competitiveness. According to the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association, BYD Korea registered 21,731 new vehicles in Korea from January to October this year, ranking fourth among imported auto brands in cumulative sales this year, behind Tesla, BMW and Mercedes-Benz. Zeekr Korea has taken a similar approach, appointing Lim Hyun-ki, a former Audi Korea CEO, as its new chief. XPeng has also hired Lee Man-sik, a former Volvo executive, to lead its Korean operations. Zeekr surpassed 1,500 preorders for its midsize electric SUV, the 7X, about three months after opening preorders in June. Customer deliveries began here in October. The appointments mark a notable change from the way Chinese automakers previously approached Korea. Their presence had largely been concentrated in commercial vehicles, particularly electric buses, with local operations focused mainly on importing and selling vehicles. The latest moves, however, suggest they are now seeking to build the local infrastructure needed to absorb a larger volume of passenger vehicles and compete more directly with established brands here in an era of EVs. Hiring Korean executives could also help Chinese automakers overcome a key obstacle in expanding overseas: understanding local consumers and navigating a market dominated by Hyundai Motor, Kia and established European and Japanese brands. “Chinese automakers are under pressure to find markets that can absorb their growing production, and Korea is becoming one of the markets they cannot afford to overlook, as evidenced by the recent success of BYD Korea,” an industry source said. But Chinese brands still face challenges involving brand recognition, resale values, charging infrastructure, after-sales service and consumer concerns over data security, according to the official
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩国正成为中国电动汽车过剩产能的新出口市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 中国日益严重的电动汽车产能过剩，正推动其汽车制造商赴韩国寻找新的增长空间；国内竞争激烈，加之欧洲贸易壁垒收紧，使其扩张选择日益有限。中国汽车制造商不再仅仅把韩国视为成品汽车出口市场。比亚迪、极氪和小鹏正在加强本地业务，并聘请曾在成熟外资汽车企业任职的韩国高管，努力将韩国打造为更长期 海外市场。这一转变正值中国电动汽车行业面临激烈价格竞争和拥挤国内市场之际，汽车制造商承受着越来越大的压力，需要在海外寻找更多需求。欧洲曾是中国电动汽车的重要目的地，但如今也因更高的关税和更严格的监管审查而更难进入。在此背景下，韩国成熟的汽车市场和不断增长的电动汽车需求，使韩国成为中国汽车制造商海外扩张 increasingly 有吸引力的目的地。比亚迪韩国自去年年初启动乘用车业务以来，销量大幅增长。公司任命曾任 MINI 韩国乘用车业务负责人的赵仁哲 leading 其乘用车业务。此后，凭借价格竞争力，这家中国电动汽车制造商的销量实现强劲增长。据韩国汽车进口商与经销商协会称，比亚迪韩国今年1月至10月在韩国登记了21,731辆新车，按今年累计销量在进口汽车品牌中排名第四，仅次于特斯拉、宝马和梅赛德斯-奔驰。极氪韩国采取了类似做法，任命前奥迪韩国首席执行官林贤基为新任负责人。小鹏也聘请了前沃尔沃高管李万锡 leading 其韩国业务。极氪中型电动SUV 7X在6月开启预订约三个月后，预订量突破1,500辆，并于10月在韩国开始交付客户。这些任命标志着中国汽车制造商对韩策略发生显著变化。此前，它们在韩业务主要集中在商用车，尤其是电动巴士，本地运营也主要侧重于进口和销售汽车。然而，最新举措表明，它们如今正寻求建立本地基础设施，以承接更大规模的乘用车销量，并在电动汽车时代更直接地与韩国成熟品牌竞争。聘请韩国高管还有助于中国汽车制造商克服海外扩张中的一项关键障碍：了解当地消费者，以及在由现代汽车、起亚以及成熟欧洲和日本品牌主导的市场中开展经营。一位行业人士表示：“中国汽车制造商正面临寻找能够消化其不断增长产量的市场的压力，而从比亚迪韩国近期取得的成功来看，韩国正成为它们不容忽视的市场之一。”不过，据该官方人士称，中国品牌仍面临品牌认知度、二手车价值、充电基础设施、售后服务以及消费者对数据安全担忧等挑战

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.title: Senate Threatens Disqualification of Candidates Linked to Electoral Violence
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.summary: The upper chamber urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to enforce the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act against electoral offenders, stressing that political violence must attract appropriate sanctions.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.summary_zh: 参议院敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）依据《2026年选举法》的相关规定惩处选举违法者，并强调政治暴力必须受到适当制裁。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.body: •Warns governors against denying opposition access to public facilities The Senate on Tuesday warned that political candidates whose supporters instigate or participate in electoral violence risk disqualification, irrespective of party affiliation, as it moved to check escalating attacks on political leaders and supporters ahead of the 2027 general elections. The upper chamber urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to enforce the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act against electoral offenders, stressing that political violence must attract appropriate sanctions. It also called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to investigate reported attacks on the convoys of President Bola Tinubu, presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, and former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, identify their perpetrators and sponsors, and ensure their prosecution. Leading the debate, Ningi expressed concern that the growing wave of political violence posed serious threats to national security, democratic participation and the peaceful conduct of the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. He recalled the reported attack on Tinubu’s convoy shortly after the president observed Jumu’ah prayers at the Shehu Shagari Central Mosque, Garki, Abuja, on Friday, November 13, when the departing convoy was allegedly pelted with stones and other dangerous objects, damaging vehicles and injuring security operatives. He warned that failure to investigate and prosecute those responsible could embolden further attacks, deepen political divisions and undermine public confidence in the electoral process. Seconding the motion, Senator Ali Ndume (Borno North) described the attack on Tinubu’s convoy as an embarrassment to the country rather than the president. “What happened to Mr. President is not an embarrassment against the president; it is an embarrassment to Nigerians. On a Friday, in a mosque, it is wrong,” he said. Ndume warned that political violence could escalate if decisive measures were not taken, urging the police to prohibit dangerous weapons during campaigns and prosecute anyone caught carrying knives and other harmful objects. He also proposed special courts to ensure speedy prosecution of electoral offenders. However, Senator Kawu Sumaila (Kano South) argued that political candidates should equally be held accountable when their supporters are found carrying dangerous weapons. “It is across all parties. You see candidates with police escorts and thugs. Let the candidates be prosecuted if their supporters are found with dangerous weapons,” he said. Sumaila also proposed reducing the reporting period given to the relevant Senate committees from four weeks to one week. Senator Abba Moro (Benue South) maintained that existing provisions of the Electoral Act were sufficient to address electoral violence if properly enforced. “We have various sections in the Electoral Act to tackle election violence. We need to urge the security agencies to prosecute,” he said. Moro warned that unchecked violence could discourage citizens from participating in the elections. “If this is not nipped in the bud, then certainly, our election and electoral process will be in danger. It will cause voter disenfranchisement; voters will be so scared even to vote. What then will become of our democracy?” he asked. Senator Babangida Hussaini (Jigawa North-west) urged INEC to disqualify candidates linked to political violence, while Senator Binos Yaroe (Adamawa South) called on state governors to guarantee opposition parties access to public facilities for political activities, including campaign rallies. Adopting the motion, Senate President Godswill Akpabio urged the federal government to direct the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, and other security agencies to strengthen security arrangements for political leaders, candidates, supporters and political gatherings nationwide. He also called for effective early-warning and rapid-response mechanisms to prevent attacks before they occur. Akpabio specifically urged INEC to implement the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act, warning that candidates and supporters found to have instigated violence must face the consequences prescribed by law. He said the provisions should apply without discrimination, regardless of the political party involved. The Senate further urged state governors to stop denying opposition parties access to public facilities, including hotels and stadia under their control, for legitimate political activities, warning that such restrictions could undermine the level playing field required for credible elections. It mandated its Committees on National Security and Intelligence, Police Affairs, and INEC to engage relevant institutions and report to the chamber within four weeks on measures to prevent political violence and safeguard the 2027 general elections. The Senate’s intervention comes amid growing concerns over violence accompanying political campaigns across the country. The National Peace Committee, chaired by former Head of State, General Abdulsalami Abubakar, recently reported 109 breaches of the National Peace Accord across 26 states and the Federal Capital Territory between August 19 and October 27, 2026. Political violence and thuggery accounted for 33 of the reported violations. Similarly, the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project documented more than 30 attacks targeting political campaigns, candidates, supporters, convoys and gatherings since presidential and National Assembly campaigns commenced on August 19, with more than 10 deaths and several injuries recorded. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.title_zh: 参议院威胁取消与选举暴力有关候选人的资格
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.body_zh:
•警告州长不得阻止反对派使用公共设施

参议院周二警告称，无论是哪个政党，其政治候选人的支持者若煽动或参与选举暴力，都可能失去参选资格。目前，参议院正采取行动，遏制2027年大选前针对政治人物和支持者的袭击不断升级之势。

上院敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）依据《2026年选举法》的相关规定惩处选举违法者，强调政治暴力必须受到适当制裁。参议院还呼吁尼日利亚警察部队及其他安全机构调查针对以下人员车队的已报告袭击：总统Bola Tinubu、尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）总统候选人Peter Obi，以及前副总统Atiku Abubakar；查明袭击实施者及其指使者，并确保将其起诉。

主导讨论的Ningi表示关切，称日益严重的政治暴力对国家安全、民主参与以及2027年1月16日总统选举和国民议会选举的和平进行构成严重威胁。他提到，据报道，11月13日星期五，总统在阿布贾加尔基Shehu Shagari Central Mosque参加主麻礼拜后不久，Tinubu的车队遭到袭击。离开时，车队据称遭人投掷石块及其他危险物品，车辆受损，安全人员受伤。

他警告称，如果不调查并起诉责任人，可能助长进一步袭击，加深政治分裂，并削弱公众对选举进程的信心。

参议员Ali Ndume（博尔诺州北区）为该动议附议，称袭击Tinubu车队令国家而非总统蒙羞。他说：“发生在总统先生身上的事情不是总统的耻辱，而是尼日利亚人的耻辱。星期五在清真寺里发生这种事是不对的。”

Ndume警告，如果未采取果断措施，政治暴力可能升级，并敦促警方在竞选活动期间禁止携带危险武器，同时起诉任何被抓到携带刀具及其他有害物品的人。他还提议设立特别法庭，以加快对选举违法者的起诉。

不过，参议员Kawu Sumaila（卡诺州南区）认为，如果发现候选人的支持者携带危险武器，候选人同样应承担责任。他说：“这种情况涉及所有政党。你们可以看到一些候选人带着警察护送和打手。如果发现候选人的支持者携带危险武器，就应起诉这些候选人。”

Sumaila还提议，将相关参议院委员会提交报告的期限从4周缩短至1周。

参议员Abba Moro（贝努埃州南区）坚持认为，只要得到适当执行，《选举法》的现有规定已足以应对选举暴力。他说：“《选举法》中有多个条款可用于处理选举暴力。我们需要敦促安全机构予以起诉。”

Moro警告说，暴力若不加遏制，会阻碍公民参与选举。他说：“如果不趁苗头及时制止，我们的选举和选举进程必然处于危险之中。这将造成选民被剥夺投票权；选民会因过度恐惧而不敢投票。那我们的民主又将何去何从？”

参议员Babangida Hussaini（吉加瓦州西北区）敦促INEC取消与政治暴力有关联的候选人的资格；参议员Binos Yaroe（阿达瓦州南区）则呼吁各州州长保障反对党能够使用公共设施开展政治活动，包括竞选集会。

参议院议长Godswill Akpabio在通过动议时，敦促联邦政府指示警察总长Olatunji Disu及其他安全机构，加强针对全国政治人物、候选人、支持者和政治聚会的安全安排。他还呼吁建立有效的早期预警和快速响应机制，防止袭击发生。

Akpabio特别敦促INEC落实《2026年选举法》的相关规定，并警告称，经查实煽动暴力的候选人和支持者必须承担法律规定的后果。他说，这些规定应一视同仁地适用于所有政党，不因涉及不同政党而有所区别。

参议院进一步敦促各州州长停止阻止反对党使用由州政府掌控的公共设施，包括酒店和体育场，以开展正当政治活动。参议院警告称，此类限制可能破坏可信选举所需的公平竞争环境。

参议院责令其国家安全与情报委员会、警务委员会以及INEC委员会与相关机构接洽，并在4周内向议院报告防止政治暴力及保障2027年大选安全的措施。

参议院此次干预之际，全国围绕政治竞选发生的暴力事件日益引发关注。由前国家元首General Abdulsalami Abubakar担任主席的国家和平委员会最近报告称，2026年8月19日至10月27日期间，26个州及联邦首都辖区共发生了109起违反《国家和平协议》的行为。政治暴力和暴徒活动占所报告违规行为的33起。

同样，武装冲突地点与事件数据（ACLED）项目记录，自8月19日总统和国民议会竞选活动启动以来，针对政治竞选、候选人、支持者、车队和聚会的袭击超过30起，并造成10多人死亡及多人受伤。
