https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.summary: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 박성민 특파원 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 오는 18∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석 계기에 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 만날 수도 있다고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀과 중국 등 아시아 순방을 떠나기 전 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 중국에서 "시진핑 중국 국가주석을 만날 예정"이라며 "(러시아 블라디미르) 푸틴 대통령과 만날 예정이며, 김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 언급한 것은 취재진이 질의를 시작하기 전 이번 순방 일정을 간략히 설명하는 과정에서 선제적으로 밝힌 것이다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.summary_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）特派记者朴成民＝唐纳德·特朗普美国总统16日（当地时间）表示，在18日至19日于中国举行、即将出席的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议之际，可能与朝鲜国务委员金正恩会面。特朗普总统当天在前往菲律宾和中国等亚洲 countries 进行访问前，在白宫对记者表示，预计“会在中国会见习近平国家主席”，并称“预计会与（俄罗斯的弗拉基米尔）普京总统会面，也可能与金委员长会面”。特朗普总统提及与金委员长再次会面的可能性，是在记者开始提问前概述此次出访安排时主动透露的。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 박성민 특파원 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 오는 18∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석 계기에 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 만날 수도 있다고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀과 중국 등 아시아 순방을 떠나기 전 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 중국에서 "시진핑 중국 국가주석을 만날 예정"이라며 "(러시아 블라디미르) 푸틴 대통령과 만날 예정이며, 김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 언급한 것은 취재진이 질의를 시작하기 전 이번 순방 일정을 간략히 설명하는 과정에서 선제적으로 밝힌 것이다. 이는 지난주 금요일인 13일 백악관 당국자가 언론에 트럼프 대통령의 이번 순방에서 김 위원장과의 만남은 계획돼 있지 않다고 밝힌 것과는 달라진 것이다. 이에 따라 14∼15일 주말을 거치면서 상황이 변하면서 이번 APEC 정상회의를 계기로 북미 정상회담을 개최할 가능성이 좀 더 커진 것 아니냐는 관측도 나온다. 아니면 달라진 상황이 없는 데도 트럼프 대통령이 재차 김 위원장에게 이번 기회에 북미 회담을 해보자는 메시지를 던졌을 가능성도 있다. 트럼프 대통령은 김 위원장과 중국에서 만날 가능성을 얘기했지만, APEC 정상회의 개최지인 선전인지, 최근 김 위원장이 깜짝 방문했던 단둥인지 등 구체적인 장소를 밝히지 않았다. 아울러 김 위원장 방중 여부가 APEC 정상회의 주최국이자 북미회담 주선 역할을 할 수 있는 중국에 달려 있다며 공을 넘긴 것으로 미뤄볼 때 방중 기간 북미 회담 가능성을 계속 타진하며 불씨를 살려놓을 것으로 예상된다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과 다시 만난다면 2019년 6월 판문점에서 당시 문재인 대통령과 함께 회동한 이후 7년 5개월만에 북미회담이 이뤄지는 것이다. 트럼프 대통령은 그간 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정하는 듯한 발언을 내놓으면서 올해 안에 김 위원장과 만나고 싶다는 뜻을 공개적으로 피력해왔다. 트럼프 대통령이 이날 다시 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 띄운 것은 여당인 공화당이 미국 중간선거에서 참패하면서 남은 임기 2년간 급속한 레임덕에 빠지는 정치적 위기에 놓인 상황에서 내치보다는 외교를 앞세워 집권 2기의 업적을 남기려는 포석으로도 풀이된다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀 마닐라로 출발해 17∼18일 쿼드(Quad·미국, 일본, 호주, 인도의 안보협의체) 정상회의 및 미·아세안(ASEAN) 정상회의에 참석한다. 그는 이어 중국 선전으로 이동, 18∼19일 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 참석하며, 이 기간 미·중·러 3자 정상회담도 열린다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/17 00:51 송고 2026년11월17일 00시51분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）特派记者朴成敏报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普16日（当地时间）表示，在18日至19日于中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间，可能会见朝鲜国务委员金正恩。特朗普总统当天在前往菲律宾和中国等亚洲国家进行访问前，在白宫向记者表示，他“预计会见中国国家主席习近平”，“预计会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，也可能会见金正恩委员长”。特朗普总统在记者开始提问前介绍此次访问行程时，主动提到了与金正恩委员长再次会面的可能性。这与白宫官员上周五13日向媒体表示，此次访问期间没有安排与金正恩委员长会面的说法有所不同。随着14日至15日周末局势发生变化，外界也开始推测，此次APEC领导人非正式会议期间举行美朝领导人会谈的可能性是否有所增加。也可能出现另一种情况，即即使局势没有变化，特朗普总统仍有意再次向金正恩委员长传达利用此次机会举行美朝会谈的信息。特朗普总统谈到可能在中国与金正恩委员长会面，但未透露具体地点，例如是APEC领导人非正式会议举办地山东，还是金正恩委员长近期突然访问过的丹东。他还表示，是否安排金正恩委员长出访中国，取决于作为APEC领导人非正式会议主办国、并可能斡旋美朝会谈的中国，因此可判断，他将继续探询访问期间举行美朝会谈的可能性，并维持这一议题的活力。如果特朗普总统再次与金正恩委员长会面将是2019年6月在板门店与当时的文在寅总统共同现身后，时隔7年5个月举行的美朝会谈。特朗普总统此前曾多次公开表示，希望在年内与金正恩委员长会面，并发表仿佛承认朝鲜为核武国家的言论。特朗普总统当天再次提出可能与金正恩委员长重逢之际，执政共和党在美国中期选举中惨败，面临在剩余两年任期内迅速陷入跛脚鸭困境的政治危机。也可将其解读为，特朗普总统没有采取守势，而是希望以外交优先，为第二个任期留下政绩。特朗普总统当天出发前往菲律宾马尼拉，将出席17日至18日举行的四方安全对话（Quad·美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度的安全磋商机制）领导人会议及美国—东盟（ASEAN）领导人会议。他随后将前往中国，出席18日至19日举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议，期间还将举行美中俄三国领导人会谈。报道可通过KakaoTalk发送给okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月17日00:51发布

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung has approved requests for parliamentary confirmation hearings for Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol and Ahn Duk-su, his pick to head the National Tax Service (NTS), the presidential office said Monday. Their confirmation hearings are expected to focus on their qualifications and policy positions on key government issues, including prosecution reform and tax administration. Lee Yong-cheol worked on prosecution reform while serving as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs and legal affairs under former President Roh Moo-hyun, who served from 2003 to 2008. Lee also served on the transition team after Lee Jae Myung was elected mayor of Seongnam, south of Seoul, in June 2010. Before his nomination, he headed the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA). Questions are expected to focus on allegations surrounding his role in the 2015 Daejang-dong development project, which was launched while Lee Jae Myung was mayor of Seongnam. Ahn is a career tax official with extensive experience in tax investigations and administration. He has headed the Seoul Regional Tax Office since July and previously oversaw investigations into companies suspected of tax evasion. As head of the NTS' Investigation Bureau, Ahn was recognized for cracking down on tax evasion involving stock market manipulation and other unfair trading practices that harmed retail investors. His hearing is expected to focus on his plans to promote tax fairness and strengthen efforts to combat tax evasion. The National Assembly is required to complete the hearings within 20 days of receiving the president's requests

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 马尼拉——美国专家周一表示，尽管美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人本周将举行前所未有的峰会，但朝鲜的核武计划不太可能在会上成为突出议题。不过，这场聚会可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are scheduled to hold their first-ever trilateral summit Thursday in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, where nuclear arms reduction is expected to be discussed. Although Trump has previously expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un again, a U.S. administration official said last week that there are no plans for engagement with Pyongyang during the president's Asia trip. The White House has not responded to a Yonhap News Agency inquiry on whether North Korea will be discussed during the trilateral summit. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said North Korea's nuclear program is unlikely to be discussed at the summit, citing considerable differences between Washington and Moscow over Pyongyang's nuclear ambitions. "Any mention of nuclear arms reduction from the three leaders will be a generally worded and vague statement," Yeo told Yonhap News Agency. Ellen Kim, a senior fellow at the Korea Economic Institute of America (KEI), said the three leaders might briefly discuss North Korea behind closed doors, possibly at Trump's initiative, but other issues would likely take precedence. "However, nuclear arms control among the U.S., Russia and China, along with the war in Iran, will likely take priority at the meeting," she said. Scott Snyder, president and chief executive officer (CEO) of KEI, shared a similar assessment. "I doubt that North Korea's nuclear program will be accepted as a discussion topic among the three leaders," Snyder said. Despite the limited prospects for substantive discussions on North Korea, some suggest the summit could create an indirect opening for renewed diplomatic engagement between Trump and Kim. Yeo said the trilateral meeting itself would not have much bearing on a Trump-Kim meeting but noted that Kim may consider a future meeting with Trump if he views the trilateral gathering positively. Kim of KEI said the summit could, at best, help open diplomatic channels between Washington and Pyongyang, but is unlikely to lead directly to renewed engagement between Trump and the North Korean leader. "Xi and Putin could convey Trump's messages to Kim," she said. "But they may be reluctant to support U.S.-North Korea negotiations for fear of losing their influence over North Korea." Sydney Seiler, a former U.S. national intelligence officer for North Korea, suggested Xi and Putin could encourage Trump to continue reaching out to Pyongyang and consider incentives, including possible sanctions relief, without assuming a direct mediating role. "It is most unlikely that either Xi or Putin is interested in taking a more active role in mediating a U.S.-DPRK summit," Seiler said, referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The experts generally dismissed comparisons between the upcoming summit and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union discussed the postwar international order without the participation of other countries directly affected by their decisions. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, described such comparisons as misleading and said major differences among the three countries would make meaningful agreements difficult. "Unlike Yalta, this meeting is not deciding the world order," Rapson said. "It's largely symbolic and performative, albeit not without some consequences." Despite expectations of limited substantive results, Rapson warned that U.S. allies, including South Korea, should closely monitor the discussions to ensure their security interests are not compromised. "As for allies and partners, including Seoul, they are somewhat out in the cold and will have to look to Trump's key senior advisers, to the extent possible, to keep them apprised of developments and to help ensure the president does not go off the rails with respect to their core interests," Rapson said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 马尼拉消息：美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人定于本周举行的史无前例峰会不太可能重点讨论朝鲜核武计划，不过美国专家周一表示，这次会晤可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于周四在中国深圳举行首次三方峰会，地点安排在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间，届时预计将讨论削减核武的问题。尽管特朗普此前曾表示有兴趣再次会见朝鲜领导人金正恩，但美国政府官员上周表示，总统亚洲之行期间没有与平壤接触的计划。白宫尚未回应韩联社关于三方峰会是否会讨论朝鲜问题的询问。布鲁金斯学会高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，由于华盛顿与莫斯科对平壤核野心存在巨大分歧，朝鲜核计划不太可能在峰会上成为讨论议题。约对韩联社说：“三位领导人若提及削减核武，措辞通常会较为笼统和模糊。”美国韩国经济研究院（KEI）高级研究员艾伦·金表示，三位领导人可能会在闭门会议上简要讨论朝鲜问题，也可能是由特朗普主动提出，但其他议题很可能更受重视。她说：“不过，美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的核军备控制，以及伊朗战争，预计将在会议期间占据优先位置。”KEI总裁兼首席执行官斯科特·斯奈德也作出了类似评估。斯奈德说：“我怀疑朝鲜核计划会被列为三位领导人的讨论议题。”尽管就朝鲜问题展开实质性讨论的前景有限，但一些人认为，此次峰会可能为特朗普与金正恩恢复外交接触创造间接机会。约表示，三方会议本身不会对特朗普与金正恩会晤产生太大影响，但他指出，如果金正恩对三方峰会的评价积极，他可能会考虑未来与特朗普会面。KEI的金表示，峰会至多有助于打通华盛顿与平壤之间的外交渠道，但不太可能直接促成特朗普与朝鲜领导人恢复接触。她说：“习近平和普京可以向金正恩转达特朗普的信息。不过，他们可能不愿支持美朝谈判，因为他们担心会失去对朝鲜的影响力。”美国前朝鲜国家情报官员悉尼·塞勒认为，习近平和普京可以鼓励特朗普继续向平壤伸出手，并考虑提供激励措施，包括可能放松制裁，而无需承担直接斡旋的角色。塞勒在提及朝鲜官方名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”时说：“习近平或普京都不太可能有意在促成美朝峰会方面扮演更积极的斡旋角色。”这些专家普遍否定将即将举行的峰会与1945年雅尔塔会议相提并论。在那次会议上，美国、英国和苏联讨论了战后国际秩序，而没有其他受其决定直接影响的国家参与。美国前驻韩国代办罗伯特·拉普森称，此类比较具有误导性，并表示三国之间的重大分歧将使达成有意义的协议十分困难。拉普森说：“与雅尔塔会议不同，这次会议并不是在决定世界秩序。它在很大程度上具有象征和表演性质，尽管并非毫无后果。”尽管预计实质成果有限，拉普森仍警告，美国的盟友和伙伴，包括韩国，应密切关注相关讨论，以确保自身安全利益不受损害。拉普森说：“至于包括首尔在内的盟友和伙伴，他们在某种程度上被冷落了，只能尽可能依靠特朗普的高级幕僚，让他们及时了解事态进展，并帮助确保总统不会在他们的核心利益方面偏离轨道。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal. The ministry made the request to rebuild the building, which was erected in 1954, in 2023, last year and this year due to safety issues, limits to performing diplomatic activities in the aging facilities and concerns about the impact on the national image, it said. The budget subcommittee of the National Assembly's finance, economy, planning and budget committee did not discuss the embassy reconstruction issue in a recent budget deliberation session, an official at the legislature's foreign affairs committee said, a sign that the project could again fail to move forward this year. Major reconstruction projects for overseas diplomatic missions are funded through the finance ministry's state property management fund rather than the foreign ministry's general account budget. Thus the reconstruction issue falls under the jurisdiction of the Assembly's finance committee. In 1990, Korea bought the current embassy building from another country that used it as its military attache's office

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 外交部周一表示，该部一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿、年久失修的大使馆大楼，项目估算耗资264.6亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但其资金申请尚未列入明年的政府预算提案。该部表示，由于安全问题、陈旧设施限制外交活动以及担忧影响国家形象，于去年和今年再次提出重建这栋建于1954年的大楼。国民议会财政、经济、规划和预算委员会的预算小组委员会在最近一次预算审议会议上没有讨论大使馆重建问题。议会外交事务委员会的一名官员称，这表明该项目今年可能再次无法推进。驻外外交机构的大型重建项目通过财政部的国家财产管理基金而非外交部的一般账户预算提供资金。因此，大使馆重建问题属于国民议会财政委员会的管辖范围。1990年，韩国从曾将现有使馆大楼用作武官办公室的另一国家手中买下该建筑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 外交部与韩国航天航空管理局于周一首尔四季酒店联合主办第二届全球新太空论坛，汇聚了约40家韩国企业以及来自18个国家和国际组织的代表与政府官员。韩国航天航空管理局副局长权贤俊表示，由私营部门主导的太空时代已使太空成为国际合作的新舞台。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Korea's space industry seeks to turn its growing technological capabilities into international business opportunities as government officials and industry representatives from 18 countries gather in Seoul for a forum focused on commercial space cooperation. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Korea AeroSpace Administration jointly hosted the second Global New Space Forum at the Four Seasons Hotel Seoul on Monday, bringing together representatives of about 40 Korean companies and government officials from 18 countries and international organizations. The gathering aims to connect Korean space companies with overseas agencies and identify opportunities for joint research, technology demonstrations and commercial partnerships. The forum follows the successful fifth launch of Korea's Nuri rocket in October and builds on diplomatic efforts to expand the country's international space network, the organizers said. Kim Jin-a, second vice foreign minister, said in a video address that the growing role of private companies in space exploration had created new diplomatic challenges involving technology cooperation, market access, safety and sustainability. She highlighted three priorities for space diplomacy: creating practical cooperation opportunities between governments and businesses, contributing to the development of international space rules and helping Korean companies enter overseas markets through diplomatic missions and global networks. Kwon Hyun-joon, deputy administrator of the Korea AeroSpace Administration, said the private-sector-led space era had made space a new arena for international cooperation. He called for strengthening Korea's position as a responsible partner in the global space community, accelerating international space exploration projects and building commercial space supply chains with trusted partners. Ibrahim Al Qasim, deputy director-general of the United Arab Emirates Space Agency, delivered the keynote address on the role of governments in encouraging private sector innovation and international cooperation. Two panel discussions examined how geopolitical changes are affecting space partnerships and what policies are needed to expand commercial cooperation. More than 70 one-on-one business-to-government meetings were arranged between Korean companies and overseas officials, offering opportunities to discuss specific projects. The organizers said they would continue supporting Korean companies through overseas business delegations, including planned visits to Mexico and Brazil in December. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国寻求全球太空合作伙伴关系，私营部门发挥主导作用
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国正力图将其不断增强的技术能力转化为国际商业机遇。18个国家政府官员和业界代表齐聚首尔，参加一场聚焦商业航天合作的论坛。外交部与韩国宇宙航空厅于周一首尔四季酒店联合主办第二届全球新空间论坛，汇集韩国约40家企业的代表、18个国家政府官员以及国际组织代表。此次会议旨在为韩国航天企业牵线海外机构，并寻找联合研究、技术示范和商业合作机会。主办方表示，此次论坛承接韩国“阿里三号”火箭于10月成功完成第五次发射，并延续了扩大韩国国际航天网络的外交努力。外交部次官金振娥在视频致辞中表示，私营企业在航天探索中的作用日益增强，带来了涉及技术合作、市场准入、安全和可持续发展的新外交挑战。她提出航天外交的三项重点：创造政府与企业之间务实合作机会，推动国际空间规则制定，并通过外交使团和全球网络帮助韩国企业进入海外市场。韩国宇宙航空厅副厅长权贤俊表示，由私营部门主导的航天时代使太空成为国际合作的新舞台。他呼吁加强韩国作为全球航天共同体负责任伙伴的地位，加快国际航天探索项目，并与值得信赖的合作伙伴共同构建商业航天供应链。阿拉伯联合酋长国航天局副局长易卜拉欣·卡西姆发表主旨演讲，探讨政府如何鼓励私营部门创新与国际合作。两场专题讨论分析了地缘政治变化如何影响航天伙伴关系，以及扩大商业合作需要哪些政策。活动还安排了70多场韩国企业与海外官员之间的一对一会谈，为讨论具体项目提供机会。主办方表示，将继续通过海外商务代表团支持韩国企业，其中包括计划于12月组织赴墨西哥和巴西的访问。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

His remarks came as China continued to exert maritime pressure in the South China Sea, a strategic waterway through which trillions of dollars in trade pass annually and where Philippine and Chinese vessels have been involved in recurring collisions and confrontations. Beijing’s claim is based on a nine-dash line map dating to the 1940s that encompasses the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ), part of which Manila calls the West Philippine Sea. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism will host a forum Tuesday on how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used in culture, sports and tourism and on how these sectors should shift to AI. The ministry said Monday the fourth Culture, Sports and Tourism Digital Innovation Forum, themed “New Culture Through AI,” will be held at L Tower in Seoul’s Seocho District. About 400 people from government, public institutions and the private sector are expected to attend. State-affiliated bodies are co-organizing the event, including the Korea Culture Information Service Agency, Arts Council Korea, the Korea Sports Promotion Foundation, the Korea Tourism Organization and the Korea Creative Content Agency. The forum will open with an awards ceremony for 15 winners of an AI and cultural data contest. They were chosen in five categories across three fields: new technology, cultural data use and data analysis. Five winners will receive the culture minister’s award. Winning entries include an AI service that lets users talk with historical figures based on historical records and an AI service that rearranges music for people with cochlear implants. Another is a customized AI service for children based on traditional folk tales. A Sungkyunkwan University professor will give the keynote speech on how to live in a world being reshaped by AI. Four breakout sessions will follow on AI in culture and sports, the arts, tourism and content. Topics include responsible use of AI in artistic creation, robots and real-time translation in tourism and AI strategies for visual effects and gaming. At booths in the venue, visitors can try generative AI photo services, AI-based body shape analysis with personalized workout recommendations and real-time interpretation. “The ministry will continue to expand the use of cultural data and support the AI transition in the field to spread digital innovation that people can feel,” a ministry official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 文化部将举办人工智能在文化、体育和旅游领域应用的论坛
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 韩国文化、体育和旅游部将于周二举办一场论坛，讨论人工智能如何应用于文化、体育和旅游领域，以及这些领域应如何转向人工智能。该部周一表示，第四届文化、体育和旅游数字创新论坛将以“人工智能赋能新文化”为主题，在首尔瑞草区L Tower举行。预计约400名政府、公共机构和私营部门人士出席。韩国文化信息院、韩国艺术委员会、韩国体育振兴基金会、韩国观光公社和韩国创意内容 agency's等国有机构将联合主办活动。论坛将以人工智能与文化数据竞赛15名获奖者的颁奖典礼开幕。获奖者来自新技术、文化数据应用和数据分析三个领域的五个类别。其中5名获奖者将获得文化部长奖。获奖作品包括一项人工智能服务，用户可依据历史记录与历史人物交谈；另一项人工智能服务，可为使用人工耳蜗的人重新编排音乐；还有一项面向儿童的定制人工智能服务，基于传统民间故事创作。成均馆大学的一名教授将发表主旨演讲，探讨如何在一个正被人工智能重塑的世界中生活。随后将举行四场分组会议，议题包括文化与体育领域的人工智能、艺术、旅游和内容。讨论主题包括负责任地将人工智能用于艺术创作、旅游领域的机器人应用和实时翻译，以及用于视觉特效和游戏的人工智能战略。现场展台上，参观者可以体验生成式人工智能照片服务、基于人工智能的体型分析及个性化健身建议，以及实时口译。该部官员表示：“该部将继续扩大文化数据的应用，并支持各领域向人工智能转型，推动让民众切实感受到的数字创新。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Pulmuone Food & Culture opened its first overseas contract catering operation in the United States, bringing Korean food to a workplace in Arizona as the company looks to expand its food service business across North America. The food service subsidiary of Pulmuone said Monday that it began operating a cafeteria at a Korean conglomerate's facility in Queen Creek, Arizona, marking its first overseas contract catering operation. The operation is run through Pulmuone FNC USA, the company's U.S. subsidiary established in January, and occupies 175 pyeong, or about 578 square meters, including dining and kitchen areas. The cafeteria currently serves lunch and dinner, with menus designed for both Korean employees and local staff. Its offerings follow a dual-track approach, combining traditional Korean dishes with familiar American meals. Korean options include galbijjim, or braised short ribs, and kimchi jjigae, a stew made from the pungent cabbage pickle, along with side dishes, gimbap and instant noodles. The facility also features a Korean Station serving restaurant-style dishes, a Grab & Go section for convenient Korean meals and a Private Dining Room offering full Korean meal sets. An American Station provides familiar local dishes for employees who prefer Western-style food. The company said the approach is intended to give Korean employees convenient access to familiar meals while introducing American workers to the cuisine amid growing local interest in Korean food culture. Lee Dong-hoon, CEO of Pulmuone Food & Culture, said the opening marked an important step in bringing the company's domestic catering expertise to overseas markets. “Launching our first North American operation is highly significant because it marks our first step into overseas markets, backed by recognition of the contract catering capabilities and menu competitiveness we have developed in Korea,” Lee said. “We will work to establish our first overseas operation quickly and grow into a competitive food service company in global markets,” he said. Pulmuone Food & Culture plans to use the Arizona operation as a base for expanding into facilities run by other Korean companies in North America. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Pulmuone Food & Culture在美国开设了首个海外合同餐饮业务，将韩国料理带到亚利桑那州的一处工作场所，该公司正谋求将餐饮服务业务拓展至北美各地。Pulmuone旗下餐饮服务子公司周一表示，已开始在亚利桑那州皇后克里克一家韩国大型企业的设施内运营食堂，标志着其首个海外合同餐饮项目投入运营。该业务通过公司今年1月成立的美国子公司Pulmuone FNC USA运营，占地175坪，约合578平方米，包括用餐区和厨房区域。食堂目前供应午餐和晚餐，菜单同时面向韩国籍员工和当地员工设计。其餐饮采用双轨模式，将传统韩国菜式与美国人熟悉的餐食结合起来。韩国料理包括烤牛排（galbijjim）和泡菜汤（kimchi jjigae），后者是一种以辛辣泡菜制成的炖菜，此外还供应各种小菜、紫菜包饭和即食面条。设施内还设有供应餐厅式菜肴的Korean Station、方便购买韩国料理的即取即走区（Grab & Go），以及提供完整韩式套餐的独立包间（Private Dining Room）。American Station则为偏爱西式餐饮的员工供应当地熟悉的菜肴。公司表示，这一运营模式旨在让韩国籍员工方便地吃到熟悉的饭菜，同时让美国员工接触韩国餐饮文化；目前当地对韩国饮食文化的兴趣正不断上升。Pulmuone Food & Culture首席执行官Lee Dong-hoon表示，此次开业标志着将公司在国内积累的餐饮服务经验推广至海外市场的重要一步。Lee说：“在北美启动首个运营项目意义重大，因为这是我们迈入海外市场的第一步，其背后是我们凭借在韩国积累的合同餐饮能力和菜单竞争力所获得的认可。我们将努力迅速建立首个海外运营项目，并成长为全球市场上具有竞争力的餐饮服务公司。”Pulmuone Food & Culture计划以亚利桑那州业务为据点，拓展至北美地区其他韩国企业运营的设施。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: NNPC’s ₦210 trillion question: Not missing is not the same as accounted for, By Posi Olatubosun
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 委员会审查了尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表，发现约₦103万亿被记作应计费用，约₦107万亿被记作其他应收款。尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官向委员会表示，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此为证，说明不可能有₦210万亿不翼而飞。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: The facts are not in dispute. Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. The accrued expenses, according to lawmakers, covered items such as retention fees, legal fees and audit fees without specific breakdowns, and NNPC linked part of them to joint venture cash calls. The committee rejected that explanation, noting that the cash call regime had been abolished with effect from January 2017. The receivables, NNPC said, were owed by defunct banks and other entities, yet no debtors or amounts were named. At about $117 billion, the receivables alone are larger than the economy of many African countries. To understand why both sides can claim to be right, we must be clear about what these accounting terms mean, and this is where the public debate has gone astray. Accrued expenses are liabilities: costs the company says it has incurred but not yet paid. Receivables are assets: amounts the company says others owe it. Neither represents cash that has left the company. In that narrow sense, the former officials are correct that ₦210 trillion has not “disappeared”. But the narrow sense is the wrong test. The real test in accounting is whether a balance is supported by evidence. A liability nobody can itemise and an asset nobody can identify are not bookkeeping details; they are red flags. Consider the scale. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing. Yet the same figure raises a harder question. How can a company accrue unpaid expenses of ₦103 trillion, almost twice its total revenue over seven years? How can it claim receivables of ₦107 trillion from debtors it will not name? Either these balances include large items that are not what their labels suggest, or they reflect unreconciled entries that have accumulated, possibly on both sides of the balance sheet, over many years. Neither explanation inspires confidence. The first concern, therefore, is the quality of the accounts. Under the International Financial Reporting Standards that NNPC applies, receivables must be assessed for recoverability. A debt owed by a bank that no longer exists is, by definition, unlikely to be collected, and should be impaired. If ₦107 trillion of receivables cannot be traced to identifiable debtors, the asset side of NNPC’s balance sheet may be materially overstated. Equally, accrued liabilities must be supported by obligations the company can identify and measure. Unsupported accruals are not prudence; they are a failure of control. The second concern is the role of the external auditors. The committee chairman put the question bluntly: if reconciliation was not done, why did the auditors sign off on the financial statements? International Standards on Auditing require auditors to obtain sufficient, appropriate evidence for material balances, including confirmations for significant receivables and support for accounting estimates. Where they cannot, they are expected to modify their opinion. In July, the committee gave NNPC’s auditors one week to provide a complete schedule of every component of the receivables and payables, and rejected their claims of confidentiality. Auditors are paid to stand behind the figures they certify. Nigerians are entitled to know what evidence supported these balances and what opinion was given. The third concern is governance. The dispute has dragged on for months, with written explanations rejected, summonses ignored and, in June, a warrant of arrest issued against Mr Kyari after he failed to appear. Whatever the merits of each side’s arguments, a public company that cannot produce a schedule of its own receivables after months of parliamentary scrutiny has a governance problem. The committee has raised other queries too, including about ₦5 trillion charged as direct production costs between 2017 and 2021 and an alleged ₦3.8 trillion duplication of subsidy deductions. Each deserves a documented answer, not a press statement. The fourth concern is the market. NNPC has signalled its intention to list on the stock exchange. After the success of the Dangote refinery offer, Nigerians have shown real appetite for owning shares in national energy assets. But no serious investor will buy into a company whose balance sheet contains ₦210 trillion of unexplained entries. Credible accounts are not a favour to the Senate; they are the price of access to capital. What should happen now? Four steps are needed, and each addresses a distinct weakness this dispute has exposed. First, NNPC should publish a full reconciliation of both balances, itemised by counterparty, date and nature, with supporting evidence. This is the starting point because every other step depends on it. A reconciliation turns two aggregate numbers into a list of specific claims that can be checked: who owes NNPC money, whom NNPC owes, since when and for what. It would quickly separate genuine obligations, such as amounts due from joint venture partners or government agencies, from legacy entries that no longer have any basis. Publication matters as much as preparation. NNPC manages the nation’s oil wealth on behalf of all Nigerians, so its accountability runs not only to the Senate but to the public. Months of written explanations exchanged behind closed doors have not settled the matter; open disclosure would. Second, an independent forensic audit, by a firm with no prior relationship with NNPC, should verify that reconciliation. A reconciliation prepared by management is only as credible as those who prepare it, and the same institution produced the balances now in question. A statutory audit tests whether financial statements are fairly presented; a forensic audit goes further, tracing transactions to their source documents and establishing whether any loss, error or misconduct occurred. Independence is essential. Firms that audited or advised NNPC during the affected years cannot credibly review their own work. Only an investigator with no stake in the outcome can produce an answer the public will accept. Third, the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria should review the conduct of the audits for the affected years and act where standards were not met. Audit exists to give users of accounts reasonable assurance that material balances are supported by evidence. If auditors certified ₦210 trillion of balances without sufficient evidence, the failure is not only NNPC’s; it is a failure of the assurance system on which investors, lenders and citizens rely. The Council is the regulator charged with overseeing audit quality. Holding auditors to account in a case of this prominence would send a clear signal to the profession and strengthen confidence in every audited account in Nigeria, not just NNPC’s. Fourth, any receivables that cannot be substantiated should be impaired and any unsupported accruals reversed, with the effect on past results disclosed transparently. Financial statements must reflect economic reality. Carrying uncollectable receivables overstates assets and equity, while unsupported accruals distort liabilities and past profits. Both give a misleading picture of the company’s financial health and of what it should be remitting to the Federation Account. Correcting the balances under the relevant standards, including restating prior periods under IAS 8 where the errors are material, would give NNPC a clean starting point. Disclosing the effect openly would show that the company is prepared to confront its past rather than bury it, which is the minimum any future investor will expect. Ultimately, the issue is not whether ₦210 trillion was stolen; it is whether the national oil company’s accounts can be trusted at all. An entity that manages the country’s most valuable resource on behalf of every Nigerian must meet the highest standard of financial reporting, not the lowest. “Bookkeeping issues” on this scale are not a technicality to be explained away. They are a failure of accountability that must be fixed, transparently and in full, before NNPC asks Nigerians to trust it with their savings. Posi Olatubosun is a UK-based academic faculty member in accounting and finance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司的210万亿奈拉之问：未失踪并不等于已有交代，作者：波西·奥拉图博松
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
事实并无争议。审查尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表后，委员会发现约₦103万亿被记为应计费用，约₦107万亿被记为其他应收款。据议员称，这些应计费用包括保留费、律师费和审计费等项目，但没有具体明细；尼日利亚国家石油公司则将其中一部分与合资项目资本催缴款挂钩。委员会驳斥了这一解释，指出资本催缴制度自2017年1月起已经废除。尼日利亚国家石油公司称，这些应收款是已倒闭银行及其他实体所欠，但既未列明债务人，也未列明金额。仅应收款一项就约合1170亿美元，超过许多非洲国家的经济规模。要理解双方为何都能声称自己正确，就必须弄清楚这些会计术语的含义，而公众辩论的偏差恰恰在于此。应计费用是负债，即公司声称已经发生但尚未支付的成本。应收款是资产，即公司声称他人欠付给自己的款项。两者均不代表已经离开公司的现金。从这个狭义角度看，前任官员的说法是正确的，即₦210万亿并没有“消失”。但狭义标准并非正确标准。会计领域的真正标准，是一项余额是否有证据支持。无人能够逐项列明的负债和无人能够确认的资产，并非无关紧要的记账细节，而是危险信号。

Consider the scale. 尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官告诉委员会，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此证明₦210万亿不可能不翼而飞。然而，同一个数字也提出了一个更难回答的问题。一家公司怎么可能计提₦103万亿的未付费用，这几乎相当于其七年总收入的两倍？它又怎么可能声称拥有₦107万亿的应收款，却拒绝透露债务人身份？这些余额要么包含与其标签所示含义不符的大额项目，要么反映了多年来累积、且可能同时出现在资产负债表两侧的未核对分录。两种解释都无法令人信服。

因此，第一项关切是账目的质量。根据尼日利亚国家石油公司采用的《国际财务报告准则》，应收款必须评估可收回性。一家已不复存在的银行所欠债务，按定义就不太可能收回，因此应当计提减值。如果₦107万亿的应收款无法追溯至可识别的债务人，那么尼日利亚国家石油公司资产负债表的资产端可能被严重高估。同样，应计负债必须由公司能够识别和计量的义务提供支持。缺乏依据的应计项目不是审慎，而是控制失效。

第二项关切是外部审计师的作用。委员会主席直截了当地提出问题：如果没有进行核对，审计师为何仍会在财务报表上签字？《国际审计准则》要求审计师为重大余额获取充分、适当的证据，包括对重大应收款实施函证，以及取得会计估计的支持证据。在无法取得这些证据时，审计师应当修改审计意见。7月，委员会要求尼日利亚国家石油公司的审计师在一周内提供应收款和应付款各项组成部分的完整明细表，并驳回了他们以保密为由提出的异议。审计师领取报酬，就应当为自己所认证的数字负责。尼日利亚人民有权知道，这些余额得到了哪些证据支持，以及审计师出具了何种意见。

第三项关切是治理。这场争端已持续数月，书面解释遭到驳回，传票无人理会；6月，Kyari先生因未出庭而被签发逮捕令。无论双方论据的实质如何，一家公众公司在接受议会数月审查后，仍无法提供自身应收款的明细表，就存在治理问题。委员会还提出了其他疑问，包括2017年至2021年计入直接生产成本的₦5万亿，以及据称重复计算补贴扣减的₦3.8万亿。每项疑问都应得到有文件依据的答复，而不是新闻声明。

第四项关切是市场。尼日利亚国家石油公司已表示有意在证券交易所上市。丹格特炼厂发行获得成功后，尼日利亚人民已表现出持有国家能源资产股票的强烈意愿。但任何认真的投资者都不会投资一家资产负债表含有₦210万亿无法解释分录的公司。可信的账目不是参议院的恩惠，而是获得资本的代价。

现在该怎么办？需要采取四个步骤，每一步都针对这场争端暴露出的不同弱点。第一，尼日利亚国家石油公司应公布对两项余额的完整核对结果，并按交易对手、日期和性质逐项列明，同时提供支持证据。这是起点，因为其他每一步都依赖于此。核对会把两个汇总数字转化为可核查的具体债权清单：谁欠尼日利亚国家石油公司钱，尼日利亚国家石油公司欠谁的钱，欠了多久，因何而产生。它能迅速将合资伙伴或政府机构应付的款项等真实义务，与已经毫无依据的历史遗留分录区分开来。公布与编制同样重要。尼日利亚国家石油公司代表全体尼日利亚人民管理国家石油财富，因此它不仅对参议院负责，也对公众负责。数月来在闭门情况下 exchanged 的书面解释未能解决争端；公开披露则可以。

第二，应由一家与尼日利亚国家石油公司此前没有任何关系的公司开展独立法证审计，核验上述核对结果。由管理层编制的核对结果，其可信度取决于编制者，而相关余额正是同一机构形成的。法定审计检验财务报表是否得到公允列报；法证审计则更进一步，将交易追溯至原始凭证，并确定是否发生了损失、差错或不当行为。独立性至关重要。在受影响年度为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供审计或咨询服务的公司，无法令人信服地审查自己的成果。只有对调查结果没有任何利害关系的调查者，才能给出公众接受的答案。

第三，尼日利亚财务报告委员会应审查受影响年度审计工作的执行情况，并在审计标准未得到遵守时采取行动。审计的存在，是为了向账目使用者合理保证重大余额有证据支持。如果审计师在没有充分证据的情况下认证了₦210万亿的余额，失责的就不仅是尼日利亚国家石油公司，也是投资者、贷款人和公民赖以信赖的审计保证体系的失败。委员会是负责监督审计质量的监管机构。在如此引人注目的案件中追究审计师责任，将向审计行业发出明确信号，并增强公众对尼日利亚所有经审计账目的信心，而不只是对尼日利亚国家石油公司账目的信心。

第四，任何无法得到证实的应收款都应计提减值，任何缺乏支持的应计项目都应予冲销，并透明披露其对以往业绩的影响。财务报表必须反映经济现实。结转无法收回的应收款会高估资产和权益，而缺乏支持的应计项目会扭曲负债和以往利润。两者都会对公司财务健康状况及其应向联邦账户上缴的款项作出误导性描绘。依据相关准则更正这些余额，包括在错误金额重大时依据《国际会计准则第8号》重述以前期间，将为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供一个干净的起点。公开披露相关影响，将表明公司愿意面对过去，而不是将其掩盖；这也是未来任何投资者都会提出的最低要求。

归根结底，问题不在于₦210万亿是否遭到盗用，而在于国家石油公司的账目究竟能否信赖。一家代表每一位尼日利亚人民管理国家最宝贵资源的实体，必须达到财务报告的最高标准，而不是最低标准。如此规模的“记账问题”不是可以用技术性理由搪塞过去的细节，而是必须透明、彻底予以修复的失责问题，然后尼日利亚国家石油公司才能要求人民继续信任它管理自己的积蓄。Posi Olatubosun是一名常驻英国的会计与金融学教师。

MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Monday, November 16, hailed what he called “truly extraordinary” achievements of China and Southeast Asia in the face of global trade restrictions, expressing Beijing’s commitment to free trade at a summit ahead of US President Donald Trump’s arrival. In remarks to leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila, Li said that at a time of growing unilateralism and protectionism and recurring geopolitical conflict, economic relations between China and ASEAN had only strengthened. “The past five years have been truly extraordinary, and the achievements we scored have not come easily,” he said, citing annual trade with the 11-member ASEAN last year of more than $1 trillion and cumulative two-way investment of more than $500 billion. “We remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade and endeavor to make the pie bigger,” he said. China is ASEAN’s biggest trading partner and a key source of investment, but the biggest economies of the bloc — which has a combined GDP of more than $3.9 trillion – are keen to expand ties with the United States amid trade and diplomatic uncertainty under the Trump administration. Trump is due to arrive in Manila on Tuesday, November 17, towards the end of the summit ahead of his trip to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, where a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled. Anti-Trump protests are expected when he arrives in Manila, after four days of demonstrations and the burning of Trump effigies by leftist groups, students, and workers demanding an end to the Middle East war and the scrapping of the US-led Pax Silica initiative. In Manila, Trump will meet ASEAN leaders and attend his first meeting of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific powers — the US, Japan, Australia, and India — the first such gathering in two years. His predecessor Joe Biden saw the Quad as a signature foreign policy achievement and stressed the importance of maintaining it during his six meetings with the group. The Quad is widely considered an attempt to counterbalance China’s influence in the region, including by Beijing, although its members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country. ASEAN held talks on Monday with the leaders of Australia, South Korea and the United Nations, whose Secretary-General Antonio Guterres reiterated calls for a ceasefire in Ukraine and for greater humanitarian access in war-torn Myanmar. Referring to trilateral talks planned in Shenzhen on Thursday, Guterres also said the UN was ready to fully engage on any denuclearization initiative between the United States, Russia and China, despite a lack of certainty about such an outcome. Trump has previously said he thought a denuclearization deal with Russia and China was possible. China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday said the trilateral talks would “promote world peace and stability”. “This is what we would like to see,” Guterres said about denuclearization. “It’s not yet guaranteed that we will get there.” South Korean President Lee Jae-myung on Monday proposed new initiatives on AI and creative industries to ASEAN and said negotiations to expand their free trade deal were progressing. “We must respond proactively to the changing global trade environment and move forward together towards an era of $300 billion in annual trade,” he said. The ASEAN leaders’ summit ended on Sunday without completing a protracted code of conduct with Beijing to try to manage disputes over the South China Sea, which ASEAN chair the Philippines had hoped could be wrapped up this year. ASEAN also resolved to continue its policy of excluding Myanmar’s leaders from its summits, but left the door open for a return if “sustained and concrete progress” on a peace plan agreed long ago with ASEAN can be demonstrated. https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.body_zh: 你于2026年11月16日晚上6:10（PHT）关注了此话题 路透社 你关注了这位作者 收听本文 升级即可收听 由Speechify提供支持 已经拥有Rappler+？登录以收听开创性新闻报道。 中国领导人在东盟峰会上。 在马尼拉举行的第29届东盟—中国峰会暨东南亚国家联盟（东盟）第49届峰会期间，中国总理李强向菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 示意，越南总理黎明兴和新加坡总理黄循财在一旁观看拍照环节。 中国总理李强赞扬中国与东盟之间牢固的经济联系，强调尽管全球贸易面临挑战，双方贸易额仍超过1万亿美元，投资额达到5000亿美元。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普准备抵达马尼拉之际，预计将有人抗议其政府的政策；与此同时，东盟领导人讨论区域合作以及推动无核化的工作。 本文由人工智能生成。 阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 马尼拉，菲律宾——中国总理李强于11月16日星期一赞扬了他所称中国与东南亚“真正非凡”的成就，表示尽管全球贸易限制不断增多，北京仍承诺推动自由贸易。 东盟峰会在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达前举行。李强在马尼拉向东盟各国领导人发表讲话说，在单边主义和保护主义日益抬头、地缘政治冲突反复出现的情况下，中国与东盟之间的经济关系只会更加紧密。 “过去五年真正非同寻常，我们取得的成就来之不易，”他说。去年，他所在的11成员国东盟与中国的年贸易额超过1万亿美元，双向累计投资额超过5000亿美元。 “我们仍坚定致力于维护多边主义并促进自由贸易，努力把蛋糕做大，”他说。 中国是东盟最大的贸易伙伴和重要投资来源，但特朗普政府治下贸易与外交形势不确定，这个集团中最大的经济体都希望扩大与美国的关系。 特朗普预计于11月17日星期二抵达马尼拉，在峰会接近尾声时启程前往深圳参加亚太经济合作论坛；他将在那里参加与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行的三方会议。 左翼团体、学生和工人持续进行了四天示威，并焚烧特朗普塑像，要求结束中东战争以及废弃美国主导的“Pax Silica”倡议，预计特朗普抵达马尼拉时将发生反特朗普抗议。 在马尼拉，特朗普将会见东盟领导人，并出席 Indo-Pacific 四大国集团——美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度——的首次会议，这是两年来该集团首次举行此类集会。 他的前任乔·拜登将四方安全对话视为其标志性外交政策成果，并强调在六次集团会议中维持这一机制的重要性。 外界普遍认为，四方安全对话是制衡中国在地区影响力的努力，包括对北京施加影响，不过其成员表示，该集团并非针对任何单一国家。 东盟星期一与澳大利亚、韩国和联合国的领导人举行会谈。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯再次呼吁在乌克兰实现停火，并呼吁加强对战火破坏的缅甸的人道主义准入。 古特雷斯谈及计划于星期四在深圳举行的三方会谈时还说，尽管结果尚不确定，联合国仍准备全面参与美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的任何无核化倡议。 特朗普此前曾表示，他认为俄罗斯与中国达成无核化协议是可能的。 中国外交部星期一表示，三方会谈将“促进世界和平与稳定”。 谈及无核化，古特雷斯说：“这正是我们希望看到的。但目前还不能保证我们能够实现这一目标。” 韩国总统李在明星期一向东盟提出有关人工智能和创意产业的新倡议，并称扩大双方自由贸易协定的谈判正在取得进展。 “我们必须主动应对不断变化的全球贸易环境，共同迈向年贸易额3000亿美元的时代，”他说。 东盟领导人峰会于星期日结束，未能与北京完成旨在管控南海争端争议的长期行为准则。 担任东盟轮值主席国的菲律宾原本希望今年能够完成该准则。 东盟还决定继续将缅甸领导人排除在峰会之外，但表示，如果能够证明在东盟多年前达成一致的和平计划上取得“持续和具体进展”，仍为其重返峰会保留空间。 会议期间，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比anto还就持续数月的野火造成的跨境烟霾影响，向邻近的新加坡和马来西亚道歉。 ——Rappler.com 加载 相关话题 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。以上选择由人工智能生成。阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。升级至Rappler+，获取独家内容和无限访问权限。

https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. should prioritize trade, investment, and regional economic integration at the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China, moving beyond geopolitical issues to advance the Philippines’ interests. China is the world’s second-largest economy by nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and the largest by purchasing power parity. Hosting the Apec meeting will help set the tone for how member economies pursue economic growth and cooperation. READ: Marcos to CEOs at Apec Summit: ‘PH open, ready, and eager’ After concluding the Philippines’ hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summits and Related Summits on Nov. 17 in Manila, Marcos will fly to China’s “Silicon Valley,” Shenzhen, on Nov. 18 to represent the nation at the economy-centered meeting. Apec serves as a regional economic forum that leverages the growing interdependence of the Asia-Pacific. It aims to ensure that goods, services, investment, and people move easily across borders. In November 1989, the Philippines and 11 other founding countries—Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, and the United States—established it in Canberra, Australia. Hong Kong, China, and Chinese Taipei joined in 1991, followed by Mexico and Papua New Guinea in 1993, and Chile in 1994. Four years later, Peru, Russia, and Viet Nam joined as well, bringing the full membership to 21. This year marks China’s third time hosting the meeting, following Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. Apec chose Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub in South China, as its host city. What started as a humble fishing village has transformed into an economic and technology center. Now, it will showcase China’s economic modernization, technological prowess, and reform and opening-up policy. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together,” China set the core priorities: open trade, digital economy and AI growth, and regional connectivity and inclusion. At the 37th Apec Ministerial Meeting in Beijing, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said China is ready to collaborate with member economies to build a progressive Asia-Pacific community. READ: China, ASEAN make progress on SCS pact but can’t finish talks this year The 21 Apec member economies account for around 61 to 62 percent of the global gross domestic product. In this context, Wang called on members to uphold the multilateral trading system under the World Trade Organization. He also underscored the importance of collective efforts to build an innovation ecosystem, accelerate digital and intelligent transformation, and open up new areas for cooperation. For his part, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao said member economies should pursue the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific and eliminate trade and investment obstacles. Additionally, he said member economies should explore a trust-based partnership in the digital and AI economies. China, along with the United States, is a leading country in AI, and its roadmap for the years ahead will be a main topic at the leaders’ meeting. Various meetings have already occurred ahead of the leaders’ meeting on November 18 to 19. These include the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the 12th Apec Transport Ministers’ Meeting in Beijing. The 4th Apec Business Advisory Council Meeting runs from November 14 to 16, followed by the Apec Ministerial Meeting on November 16 and 17 and the APEC CEO Summit on November 17 and 18. READ: AFP to VP: Defending PH rights isn’t ‘picking a fight with China’ Like Marcos, US President Donald Trump will head to Shenzhen after the 49th Asean Summit for potential bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Similarly, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung will also reportedly attend the event. While details of Marcos’ agenda on the sidelines of the Apec Leaders’ Meeting have yet to be provided, the public is watching for the possibility of bilateral meetings with Xi and Trump, although these remain long shots. To recall, Marcos met with the host country’s leader, Lee, during the 32nd Apec meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea, in 2025. Also, Marcos will likely use the economy-focused Apec CEO Summit to woo investors to the Philippines amid global turbulence. Member economies will release an Apec Leaders’ Declaration, a document that outlines their collective agreements, commitments, and strategic goals. They will also announce their commitments on regional trade and investment while updating the public on the agreements reached regarding AI and digital trade. Meanwhile, the public eagerly anticipates hearing about the concerns Filipino businesses raise regarding regional economic integration and whether Marcos will address maritime issues during his meetings. /pai

https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body_zh: 马尼拉，菲律宾——菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 应在中国举行的第33届亚太经合组织经济领导人会议上优先推动贸易、投资和区域经济一体化，超越地缘政治问题，以促进菲律宾利益。中国按名义国内生产总值计算是世界第二大经济体，按购买力平价计算则位居第一。主办此次亚太经合组织会议将有助于为各成员经济体追求经济增长与合作确立方向。阅读：马科斯在亚太经合组织峰会上对首席执行官们表示：“菲律宾开放、准备就绪，充满期待”。菲律宾于11月17日在马尼拉结束东南亚国家联盟峰会及相关峰会的承办工作后，马科斯将于11月18日飞往中国“硅谷”深圳，代表国家出席这场以经济为中心的会议。亚太经合组织是一个区域经济论坛，利用亚太地区日益增强的相互依存关系。其目标是确保货物、服务、投资和人员跨境自由流动。1989年11月，菲律宾与另外11个创始国——澳大利亚、文莱达鲁萨兰、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新西兰、新加坡、泰国和美国——在澳大利亚堪培拉共同创立了该组织。1991年，中国香港和中华台北加入，随后墨西哥和巴布亚新几内亚于1993年加入，智利于1994年加入。四年后，秘鲁、俄罗斯和越南也加入，使正式成员数量增至21个。今年是中国第三次主办该会议，此前曾于2001年和2014年分别在上海和北京举行。亚太经合组织选择中国南方重要的技术和制造业中心深圳作为主办城市。这个曾经不起眼的渔村如今已转型为经济和科技中心。现在，深圳将展示中国的经济现代化、技术实力以及改革开放政策。中国以“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”为主题，确定了核心优先事项：推进贸易开放、数字经济和人工智能增长，以及加强区域互联互通与包容。在北京举行的第37届亚太经合组织部长级会议上，中国外交部长王毅表示，中国愿与各成员经济体合作，建设开放进步的亚太共同体。阅读：中国与东盟在南海行为准则问题上取得进展，但今年无法完成谈判。亚太经合组织21个成员经济体约占全球国内生产总值的61%至62%。在此背景下，王毅呼吁成员维护世界贸易组织框架下的多边贸易体系。他还强调，要通过集体努力建设创新生态系统、加快数字化和智能化转型，并开辟新的合作领域。商务部长王文涛则表示，各成员经济体应推进亚太自由贸易区建设，消除贸易和投资障碍。他还表示，各成员经济体应探索建立数字经济和人工智能经济中的互信伙伴关系。中国与美国是人工智能领域的领先国家，未来数年的发展路线图将是领导人会议的主要议题之一。在11月18日至19日的领导人会议之前，各场会议已陆续举行，其中包括在香港特别行政区举行的2026年亚太经合组织财长会议，以及在北京举行的第12届亚太经合组织交通部长会议。第4届亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会会议于11月14日至16日举行，随后是11月16日至17日的亚太经合组织部长级会议，以及11月17日至18日的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会。阅读：法新社致菲律宾副总统：捍卫菲律宾权利并非“与中国发生冲突”。与马科斯一样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将在第49届东盟峰会后前往深圳，可能与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈。据报道，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、日本首相高市早苗和韩国总统李在明也将出席该活动。尽管亚太经合组织领导人会议边会活动的安排尚未公布，但公众仍在关注马科斯是否可能与习近平和特朗普举行双边会谈，尽管这种可能性仍然不大。回顾一下，2025年亚太经合组织会议在韩国庆州举行时，马科斯曾与东道国领导人李在明会面。此外，在全球经济动荡之际，马科斯很可能利用以经济为重点的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会吸引投资者赴菲律宾。各成员经济体将发布《亚太经合组织领导人宣言》，概述各方共同达成的协议、承诺和战略目标。各方还将宣布在区域贸易和投资方面的承诺，并就人工智能和数字贸易达成的协议向公众通报。与此同时，公众也热切期待了解菲律宾企业对区域经济一体化的关切，以及马科斯是否会在会议期间处理海上问题。 /pai

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The unification ministry said Monday it is closely watching a senior North Korean official's trip to Moscow, which comes just days before a planned summit of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia. Jo Yong-won, a secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), has been visiting Moscow since Saturday as the head of a party and government delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). He is known as a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The KCNA said the visit comes as the "militant friendship" and "relations of alliance" between Pyongyang and Moscow grow stronger "with each passing day." The purpose and schedule of the trip have not been disclosed. "It is a high-level exchange between North Korea and Russia right before this week's planned summit," ministry spokesperson Yoon Min-ho said at a regular briefing Monday. "We will watch closely what Jo's role would be as head of both a party and a government delegation," he said, drawing a contrast with Kim Song-nam, a member of the WPK's Political Bureau and party secretary, who traveled to China earlier this month on a party-to-party visit. Jo's trip comes days before U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are due to meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. It is the latest in a run of high-level overtures from Pyongyang to China and Russia. It has fueled speculation that the North is seeking to build diplomatic leverage ahead of any talks with Washington
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 特朗普、习近平和普京会晤前，首尔将密切监测朝鲜官员访俄行程
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 朝鲜统一部周一表示，正密切关注朝鲜劳动党中央委员会秘书赵容元（Jo Yong-won）访问莫斯科的行程；此次访问发生在美国总统、中国和俄罗斯领导人计划举行峰会前几天。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，统治朝鲜的劳动党（WPK）中央委员会秘书赵容元自周六起以党和政府代表团团长的身份访问莫斯科。他是朝鲜领导人金正恩的亲密助手。朝鲜中央通讯社称，平壤与莫斯科之间的“战斗友谊”和“联盟关系”正“日益加强”，此次访问正是在这一背景下进行的。此次访问的目的和日程尚未公布。统一部发言人尹民浩周一在例行记者会上说：“这是本周计划举行的峰会前夕，朝鲜与俄罗斯之间的一次高层交流。”他说：“我们会密切关注赵容元以党和政府代表团双重身份出访所发挥的作用。”他同时将此次访问与劳动党政治局委员、党中央秘书金松南早些时候本月对中国的党际访问作比较。赵容元的行程安排在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京计划于周四在中国深圳出席亚太经济合作组织峰会期间会晤前几天。这是平壤近期一系列对华和对俄高层接触活动中的最新一次。它引发了外界猜测：朝鲜可能正寻求在与华盛顿举行任何会谈之前积累外交筹码

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: HD Hyundai targets North American energy market with solar, battery technologies
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: HD现代是韩国一家涵盖造船、重型机械和能源业务的大型企业集团。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新光伏发电、储能和电网技术，同时寻求扩大自身在快速增长的美国能源市场中的影响力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions and HD Hyundai Electric will jointly participate in RE+ 2026, which runs from Tuesday through Thursday at Las Vegas Convention Center, company officials said Monday. The two affiliates will present technologies spanning solar power generation, energy storage and conversion, and electricity transmission and distribution, highlighting their integrated capabilities across energy infrastructure. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions will unveil its G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut solar module in North America for first time, featuring technology that divides large-area solar cells into smaller sections to reduce power losses during current transmission. The technology enables module efficiency of 24.4 percent by increasing power density, with company planning to gradually introduce advanced Multi-Cut technology across its production lines. HD Hyundai Electric will showcase battery energy storage systems (BESS) and technologies designed to stabilize power grids, including its 96-megawatt Anjwa Island project in Korea’s Sinan County and 100-megawatt Rutile project in Texas. It will also introduce grid-forming technology, which actively controls grid voltage and frequency to improve electricity supply stability, alongside power equipment targeting North American electricity networks and data centers. “Technical capabilities of products, as well as stable supply capacity and project execution capabilities, are emerging as key competitive factors in North American market,” an HD Hyundai official said. “Through this exhibition, we will expand cooperation with local customers and partners and identify tangible business opportunities,” the official said. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding its North American manufacturing operations and BESS business through its Texas subsidiary, while HD Hyundai Energy Solutions is leveraging its integrated domestic solar cell and module production system to address changing U.S. supply chain regulations, including foreign entity of concern requirements. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: HD现代利用太阳能和电池技术瞄准北美能源市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: HD Hyundai是一家韩国的造船、重型机械和能源综合企业。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新的太阳能发电、储能及电网技术。目前，这家工业集团正寻求扩大在快速发展的美国能源市场中的业务存在。公司官员周一表示，HD Hyundai Energy Solutions与HD Hyundai Electric将联合参加RE+ 2026，展会将于周二至周四在拉斯维加斯会展中心举行。两家关联公司将展示涵盖太阳能发电、储能与能量转换以及输配电领域的各项技术，重点突出其在能源基础设施方面的综合能力。HD Hyundai Energy Solutions将首次在北美发布G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut太阳能组件。该技术将大面积太阳能电池片分割成更小的部分，以减少电流传输过程中的功率损耗。通过提高功率密度，该技术可使组件效率达到24.4%，公司还计划逐步在各条生产线引入先进的Multi-Cut技术。HD Hyundai Electric将展示电池储能系统（BESS）以及旨在稳定电网的技术，包括其位于韩国 신안郡的96兆瓦Anjwa Island项目和位于得克萨斯州的100兆瓦Rutile项目。该公司还将推出构网型技术，通过主动控制电网电压和频率来提高供电稳定性，并展示面向北美电网和数据中心的电力设备。HD Hyundai一名官员表示：“产品的技术能力、稳定的供应能力以及项目执行能力，正逐渐成为北美市场的关键竞争因素。”该官员说：“我们将通过这次展览扩大与当地客户和合作伙伴的合作，并发掘切实可行的商业机会。”HD Hyundai Electric正通过其得克萨斯州子公司扩大北美制造业务和BESS业务；与此同时，HD Hyundai Energy Solutions正利用其一体化国内太阳能电池片和组件生产体系，应对美国不断变化的供应链法规，包括受关注外国实体要求。本文由生成式人工智能协助创作，并由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: LS Electric said Monday it has won a $93.83 million (130 billion won) order to supply power distribution equipment for a hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data center. LS Electric said “time to power,” the time it takes for a data center to secure electricity and start operating, has become a key competitive factor as AI grows rapidly.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: LS Electric周一表示，公司已获得一项价值9383万美元（1300亿韩元）的订单，将为一座超大规模人工智能（AI）数据中心供应配电设备。LS Electric表示，随着人工智能迅速发展，“通电时间”，即数据中心获得电力供应并开始运营所需的时间，已成为一项关键竞争因素。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: LS Electric said Monday it has won a $93.83 million (130 billion won) order to supply power distribution equipment for a hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data center. The center is being built by a U.S. Big Tech company, and the order adds to LS Electric’s run of contracts in North America. Under the deal, the Korean power equipment maker will deliver 38-kilovolt high-voltage switchgear and low-voltage switchgear in stages. Switchgear takes in electricity, distributes it among circuits and cuts off faulty lines, which makes it a core part of a data center’s power network. Hyperscale data centers are very large facilities that technology companies run to handle cloud and AI workloads. The company did not name the client. It said it has supplied high-voltage switchgear to the customer’s project from its first phase through the current expansion. LS Electric said “time to power,” the time it takes for a data center to secure electricity and start operating, has become a key competitive factor as AI grows rapidly. It credited the repeat orders to its product quality and its ability to meet tight delivery schedules. The company pointed to its production network: a smart factory in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, LS Electric Utah and the Bastrop Campus in Texas. LS Electric also aims to grow beyond the alternating current systems that dominate the market and into direct current distribution, which it sees as a next-generation technology. It runs a factory in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, which it says is the world’s first manufacturing plant to operate commercially on direct current power. The site tests solid-state transformers, solid-state circuit breakers and energy storage systems for future grids and data centers. “This order once again recognizes the quality of our power equipment and our project capabilities in the North American market,” a company official said, noting that LS Electric recently signed a long-term supply deal with another Big Tech firm. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: LS Electric赢得9400万美元订单，为美国人工智能数据中心供应电力设备
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: LS Electric周一表示，公司获得了一份价值9383万美元（1300亿韩元）的订单，将为一座超大规模人工智能数据中心供应配电设备。该中心由一家美国大型科技公司建设，此次订单进一步增加了LS Electric在北美市场的连续中标记录。根据协议，这家韩国电力设备制造商将分阶段交付38千伏高压开关设备和低压开关设备。开关设备用于接入电力、将电力分配至各条线路并切断故障线路，因此是数据中心电力网络的核心组成部分。超大规模数据中心是科技公司运营的超大型设施，用于处理云计算和人工智能工作负载。LS Electric没有透露客户名称，但表示已从客户项目的一期工程开始，持续为其当前扩建项目供应高压开关设备。LS Electric表示，随着人工智能迅速发展，数据中心获得供电并开始运营所需的“供电准备时间”已成为一项关键竞争因素。公司将连续获得订单归功于其产品质量以及按严格交付周期完成供货的能力。公司还介绍了其生产网络，包括位于忠清北道清州的智能工厂、LS Electric Utah以及位于得克萨斯州的Bastrop园区。LS Electric还希望拓展业务，突破目前占据市场主导地位的交流电系统，进入其视为下一代技术的直流配电领域。公司在忠清南道天安运营一座工厂，并称该厂是全球首家采用直流电进行商业化运营的制造工厂。该场地测试固态变压器、固态断路器和储能系统，为未来电网和数据中心提供技术支撑。公司一名官员表示：“这项订单再次印证了我们的电力设备质量以及我们在北美市场的项目能力。”他还指出，LS Electric近期与另一家大型科技公司签署了长期供应协议。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Container shipping costs from Korea to the Middle East fell month-on-month in October, while those to the United States rose, the customs agency said Monday. The average shipping charge for a 40-foot container from Korea to the Middle East fell 4.2 percent from a month earlier to 8.63 million won ($6,460) in October, according to data from the Korea Customs Service. The figure had been rising since March before beginning to fluctuate in August. The average shipping charge for containers bound for the US west coast edged up 0.01 percent to 9.37 million won, while that for containers bound for the east coast rose 1.2 percent to 9.45 million won. Shipping costs to the European Union, meanwhile, dropped 9.2 percent to 4.54 million won. The figures include freight rates, commissions and other charges reported by local exporters, according to the agency

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: According to the report, titled Open Doors Report on International Educational Exchange, the latest decline was driven largely by a 34% drop in Indian students pursuing graduate programmes, whose numbers fell from 177,892 in 2024–25 to 116,609. However, the number of Indian students participating in OPT, which allows international graduates to gain work experience in the US after completing their degrees, rose 27% to 182,201.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 据题为《国际教育交流开放之门报告》的报告称，最近的下降主要是因为攻读研究生课程的印度学生人数大幅减少34%，从2024—2025年的177,892人降至116,609人。不过，参与OPT的印度学生人数增加了27%，达到182,201人。OPT允许国际毕业生在完成学位后赴美国积累工作经验。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: It was released to the public on Monday. HT was given early access to a copy of the report. According to the report, titled Open Doors Report on International Educational Exchange, the latest decline was driven largely by a 34% drop in Indian students pursuing graduate programmes, whose numbers fell from 177,892 in 2024–25 to 116,609. Undergraduate enrolments also dipped marginally to 39,711 from 40,135. However, the number of Indian students participating in OPT, which allows international graduates to gain work experience in the US after completing their degrees, rose 27% to 182,201. Across all academic levels, 57% of international students were enrolled in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) fields. Mathematics and computer science, with 286,168 students, and engineering, with 214,193, were the most popular fields. Meanwhile, OPT participation among international students rose 14% to 335,785. The number of new international students — those enrolling at a US institution for the first time — fell 18% to 228,123. The report’s fall 2026 snapshot, based on responses from more than 800 US higher education institutions, points to a further slowdown. Overall international student numbers declined 9%, with new enrolments falling 15%. Graduate enrolments dropped 15%, undergraduate numbers 3% and OPT participation 6%. The decline comes amid tightening US immigration measures and visa-related uncertainties. HT reported on October 23 that arrivals of Indian students in the US on F and M category visas had plunged 39% year-on-year to 25,321 in August 2026. Experts and study-abroad consultants cited stricter visa screening, delays in appointments and processing, higher rejection rates and uncertainty over post-study employment opportunities, including OPT, as factors affecting student mobility

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 该报告于周一对外发布。《今日印度斯坦时报》（HT）提前获得了报告副本。报告题为《国际教育交流开放之门报告》，最新降幅主要源于攻读研究生课程的印度学生减少34%，人数从2024—2025年的177,892人降至116,609人。本科生注册人数也小幅降至39,711人，此前为40,135人。不过，参与OPT的印度学生人数增长27%，达到182,201人；OPT允许国际毕业生完成学位后在美国积累工作经验。在所有学习层次中，57%的国际学生就读于科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）领域。数学与计算机科学专业共有286,168名学生，工程专业有214,193名学生，这两大领域最受欢迎。与此同时，国际学生参与OPT的人数增长14%，达到335,785人。新入读国际学生，即首次注册美国高等教育机构的学生人数减少18%，降至228,123人。报告中的2026年秋季数据快照基于800多所美国高等教育机构的反馈，显示进一步放缓。国际学生总数下降9%，新生注册人数下降15%。研究生注册人数下降15%，本科生人数下降3%，OPT参与人数下降6%。这一降幅出现在美国收紧移民措施以及签证问题不确定的背景下。《今日印度斯坦时报》于10月23日报道，持F类和M类签证抵达美国的印度学生人数在2026年8月同比骤降39%，降至25,321人。专家和留学顾问指出，签证审查趋严、预约及办理延误、拒签率上升，以及包括OPT在内的毕业后就业机会存在不确定性，均是影响学生流动的因素

https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.summary: The meeting provided an opportunity for AETC to share the Centre’s strategic initiatives while exploring areas of collaboration that align with the Ministry’s vision of empowering young people through innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership development and sustainable job creation. https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.summary_zh: 此次会议为AETC分享该中心的战略举措提供了机会，同时双方还探讨了符合该部通过创新、创业、领导力培养和可持续创造就业来赋能年轻人这一愿景的合作领域。她还指出，该项目与该部通过创新、创业和领导力培养赋能年轻人的职责高度契合。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.body: The engagement reaffirmed AETC’s commitment to working alongside government and key stakeholders to equip young people with the skills, opportunities and support systems required to become drivers of Africa’s energy transition and economic transformation. The delegation was received by the George Opare Addo, Minister for Youth Development and Empowerment, who welcomed AETC’s vision and acknowledged the important role that indigenous Pan-African institutions can play in supporting Ghana’s development priorities. The meeting provided an opportunity for AETC to share the Centre’s strategic initiatives while exploring areas of collaboration that align with the Ministry’s vision of empowering young people through innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership development and sustainable job creation. She emphasised that empowering young people must remain central to Africa’s long-term development strategy, particularly as the continent seeks to accelerate industrialisation, innovation and inclusive economic growth. Ms. Akumah also highlighted the vision of the Youth Energy Entrepreneurship & Incubation Programme (YEEIP), one of AETC’s flagship initiatives designed to nurture the next generation of African entrepreneurs, innovators and business leaders. She explained that the programme seeks to provide young people with technical capacity building, entrepreneurship training, mentorship, business incubation and strategic industry partnerships that will enable them to develop innovative solutions while creating sustainable employment opportunities within the energy and technology sectors. She further noted that the programme closely aligns with the Ministry’s mandate to empower young people through innovation, entrepreneurship and leadership development. Building on this, Ms. Akumah introduced the Africa Building on this, Ms. Akumah introduced the Africa Energy Youth Forum (AEYF), an initiative of the YEEIP that gives young people a voice of their own in the energy, oil and gas and technology sectors. She explained that the Forum provides a dedicated platform for young professionals, students, entrepreneurs and innovators to engage directly with policymakers, industry leaders and investors, to share their perspectives on the issues shaping these sectors, and to contribute ideas and solutions for Africa’s energy future. Through the AEYF, AETC seeks to ensure that young Africans are not only beneficiaries of the continent’s energy transition, but active participants in shaping the policies, investments and innovations that will define it. The Minister commended AETC for its strategic vision and expressed appreciation for the Centre’s growing contribution towards youth development and innovation. He underscored the importance of creating sustainable pathways that enable young Ghanaians to develop practical skills, build successful enterprises and actively contribute to the country’s socio-economic development. He further encouraged stronger collaboration between government and indigenous institutions whose programmes complement national development priorities and create meaningful opportunities for young people. A key outcome of the engagement was the mutual commitment to commence the development of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Youth Development and Empowerment and the Africa Energy Technology Centre. The proposed framework is expected to establish a long-term strategic partnership that will provide a structured platform for implementing practical, measurable and sustainable interventions aimed at advancing youth empowerment across Ghana. implementation roadmap and facilitate effective coordination between the Ministry and AETC. Both parties reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining close engagement as technical teams work towards formalising the proposed partnership framework. The envisioned collaboration reflects a shared commitment to developing innovative, youth-centred programmes that create sustainable livelihoods, strengthen entrepreneurship ecosystems and position young people as active contributors to Ghana’s economic transformation
https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.title_zh: 青年发展部与非洲电子青年中心签署谅解备忘录，以加强战略合作，推动青年创新与创业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.body_zh: 此次接洽重申了AETC承诺与政府及关键利益相关方携手合作，为年轻人提供成为非洲能源转型和经济转型推动者所需的技能、机会和支持体系。代表团受到青年发展与赋权部长George Opare Addo的接见，他欢迎AETC的愿景，并认可本土泛非机构在支持加纳发展重点方面能够发挥的重要作用。此次会晤为AETC介绍该中心的战略举措提供了机会，同时双方探讨了符合该部通过创新、创业、领导力培养和创造可持续就业来赋权年轻人这一愿景的合作领域。他强调，赋权年轻人必须继续成为非洲长期发展战略的核心，尤其是在非洲大陆寻求加快工业化、创新和包容性经济增长之际。Akumah女士还介绍了青年能源创业与孵化计划（YEEIP）的愿景，这是AETC的旗舰举措之一，旨在培养下一代非洲企业家、创新者和商业领袖。她解释道，该计划旨在为年轻人提供技术能力建设、创业培训、导师指导、企业孵化和战略行业伙伴关系，使他们能够开发创新解决方案，同时在能源和技术领域创造可持续的就业机会。她进一步指出，该计划与该部通过创新、创业和领导力培养来赋权年轻人的职责高度契合。在此基础上，Akumah女士介绍了非洲能源青年论坛（AEYF），这是YEEIP的一项倡议，让年轻人能够在能源、石油天然气和技术领域发出自己的声音。她解释道，该论坛为年轻专业人士、学生、企业家和创新者提供专门平台，让他们直接与政策制定者、行业领袖和投资者交流，分享对这些行业所面临问题的看法，并为非洲能源未来贡献创意和解决方案。通过AEYF，AETC seeks to ensure that young Africans are not only beneficiaries of the continent’s energy transition, but active participants in shaping the policies, investments and innovations that will define it.部长赞扬AETC具有战略眼光，并感谢该中心在推动青年发展和创新方面日益作出的贡献。他强调，为加纳年轻人建立可持续路径十分重要，使他们能够培养实用技能、建立成功企业，并积极为该国社会经济发展作出贡献。他进一步鼓励政府与本土机构加强合作，因为这些机构的项目与国家发展重点相辅相成，并为年轻人创造切实机会。此次接洽的一项主要成果是双方共同承诺启动青年发展与赋权部与非洲能源技术中心之间谅解备忘录（MoU）的制定工作。拟议框架预计将建立长期战略伙伴关系，为实施切合实际、可衡量且可持续的干预措施提供结构化平台，从而推动整个加纳的青年赋权。该框架还将制定实施路线图，并促进该部与AETC之间的有效协调。双方重申，在技术团队努力将拟议伙伴关系框架正式化期间，双方将保持密切沟通。 envisioned collaboration reflects a shared commitment to developing innovative, youth-centred programmes that create sustainable livelihoods, strengthen entrepreneurship ecosystems and position young people as active contributors to Ghana’s economic transformation

https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body: In a statement, Ridon said: “With the opening of the Asean [Association of Southeast Asian Nations] Summit today, it is important to clarify: The West Philippine Sea belongs to the Philippines. The West Philippine Sea is for the Filipinos.” “Although we have relations with China in different aspects, from diplomatic, economic, trade, cultural, and other areas, there is a red line in discussions about the WPS,” he added. Ridon issued the statement as Asean member states meet again to discuss several matters, including security concerns over the region, especially since several nations have claimed ownership of different portions of the South China Sea. “Ang sovereign rights of the WPS, the use of resources under the seabed, islands, and waters of the WPS are for the Philippines only. These are for Filipinos only,” he noted. The Philippines is hosting the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17, for regional leaders to discuss key political, security, and economic issues. The main events will be held at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City. Chinese President Xi Jingping will not attend, but Premier Li Qiang will be in Manila for the summit. Li’s attendance, however, comes as Manila and Beijing’s ties were strained due to tensions over the disputed portions of the South China Sea, and the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines’ dispute with several local officials, including Philippine lawmakers. Last October, some members of the Philippine House of Representatives called out Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan for saying that while China can easily win in a military contest, it seeks a peaceful resolution to the dispute. READ: China can ‘easily win’ using force, but wants peace, says envoy to PH The envoy warned that the Philippines faced a greater risk of confrontation if it did not reestablish direct military-to-military communications, which have been suspended by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. for about three years now. According to members of the House’s Young Guns bloc, true peace will not be attained if one side makes threats, saying that Jing’s statements carry a threat, not an assurance of peace. “Threat is not an assurance of peace,” Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V said last Oct. 16. “When a larger power tells a smaller nation that it could easily win if it chose force, it is not offering security. It is asserting dominance and expecting silence in return. That is the opposite of peace.” READ: Solons to Chinese envoy: No peace if one party uses threats Due to this squabble, former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers and Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima separately warned the Philippines about the possibility of China suddenly playing negotiator when Asean member-states convene for the 49th summit. Barbers said last Oct. 29 that Philippine authorities should be wary of the possible “double-talk” from China, noting that it cannot be a good negotiator if it cannot even peacefully settle differences over the WPS. The former lawmaker clarified that he is not prejudging China’s intentions. Rather, he would prefer authorities to be on guard, considering the said country’s aggressive actions over disputed waters. In 2016, the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) ruled in its award that the Philippines has exclusive rights over its waters, including the WPS, as China’s nine-dash line claim lacks legal or historical basis. This means that the WPS, a body of water that forms part of the South China Sea, belongs to the Philippines as it sits inside the country’s exclusive economic zone. China has insisted, however, on ownership of many islands inside the WPS, despite the award. Philippine-Chinese ties recovered during the administration of President Rodrigo Duterte, who once called the PCA award a piece of paper that can be thrown in the waste bin. But since President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assumed office in 2022, relations have been strained again, as his administration insists that the Philippines will not cede an inch of its territory to foreign powers. Several incidents between the two countries’ water assets have been well-documented: just this July, the Armed Forces of the Philippines reported that a Navy man was injured after members of the Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) assaulted him during a confrontation at Ayungin Shoal. https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.title_zh: 里登：我们尊重与中国的关系
https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body_zh: 在一份声明中，Ridon表示：“随着东盟[东南亚国家联盟]峰会今天开幕，有必要澄清：西菲律宾海属于菲律宾。西菲律宾海属于菲律宾人。”他补充说：“虽然我们与中国在外交、经济、贸易、文化及其他领域都有关系，但在有关西菲律宾海的讨论中有一条红线。”东盟成员国再次会晤，讨论包括地区安全关切在内的多项事务，尤其是因为多个国家声称南海不同部分的所有权。Ridon是在这一背景下发表声明的。他指出：“西菲律宾海的主权权利、海床下的资源以及西菲律宾海内的岛屿和海域，只属于菲律宾。这些只属于菲律宾人。”菲律宾正主办11月15日至17日举行的第49届东盟峰会及相关峰会，供地区领导人讨论重要的政治、安全和经济问题。主要活动将在帕赛市的菲律宾国际会议中心举行。中国国家主席习近平不会出席，但国务院总理李强将赴马尼拉参加峰会。然而，在马尼拉与北京因南海争议海域紧张局势而关系趋紧之际，中国驻菲律宾大使馆与包括菲律宾议员在内的多名地方官员发生争执，而李强的出席恰逢此时。去年10月，菲律宾众议院部分议员指责中国驻菲律宾大使景泉，称尽管中国在军事对抗中很容易获胜，但寻求和平解决争端。阅读：中国可用武力“轻易获胜”，但希望和平，该国驻菲律宾大使警告说 这位大使警告，如果菲律宾不恢复直接军事沟通，对抗风险将更大；菲律宾国防部长Gilberto Teodoro Jr.已经暂停这种沟通约三年。据众议院“青年枪手”集团成员称，如果一方发出威胁，真正的和平就无法实现；他们表示，景泉的言论是一种威胁，而不是和平保证。众议院副议长Paolo Ortega V于去年10月16日说：“威胁不是和平保证。当一个更大的强国告诉一个小国，如果它选择使用武力就很容易获胜时，它提供的不是安全，而是在宣示支配地位，并期待对方保持沉默。这与和平背道而驰。”阅读：议员向中国特使表示，一方使用威胁就不会有和平 由于这场纷争，前北苏里高省众议员Robert Ace Barbers和自由党-list众议员Leila de Lima分别警告菲律宾，在东盟成员国举行第49届峰会之际，要防范中国突然扮演谈判者的可能。Barbers于去年10月29日表示，菲律宾当局应当警惕中国可能发出的“两面话”，并指出，如果中国连西菲律宾海的分歧都不能以和平方式解决，就不可能成为合格的谈判者。这位前议员澄清，他并非预判中国的意图，而是希望当局保持警惕，因为该国在争议水域采取了强硬行动。2016年，常设仲裁法院（PCA）在其裁决中认定，菲律宾对其水域拥有专属权利，包括西菲律宾海，因为中国的“九段线”主张缺乏法律或历史依据。这意味着西菲律宾海作为南海的一部分，位于菲律宾专属经济区内，因此属于菲律宾。然而，尽管有该项裁决，中国仍坚称拥有西菲律宾海内许多岛屿的所有权。菲律宾总统Rodrigo Duterte执政期间，菲中关系有所恢复；他曾称PCA裁决不过是一张可以扔进垃圾桶的废纸。但自总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.于2022年就任以来，两国关系再次紧张，因为其政府坚持菲律宾不会向外国力量让出任何领土。两国海上力量之间的数起事件已有充分记录：就在今年7月，菲律宾武装部队报告称，在Ayungin Shoal发生的一场冲突中，中国海警局（CCG）人员袭击了一名海军人员，导致其受伤。阅读：议员称，中国在水域问题上表现得像“并骑作案”的罪犯 2023年8月，中国海警局船只向菲律宾船只使用水炮，而菲律宾船只当时只是试图向BRP Sierra Madre上的士兵运送物资。您的订阅无法保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。针对这一事件，中国声称，前一届政府曾承诺将BRP Sierra Madre撤出Ayungin，但该承诺尚未落实。Marcos随后表示，他本人没有达成这项协议；如果存在这样的协议，也已经终止。/atm 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们关于西菲律宾海最新动态的专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点了解最新信息
